来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第43页／PDF第76页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 43 / PDF p. 76. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

开环增益要除以真正的输入压差Divide by the actual input difference

题目原文Transcribed question

图题2.1.1所示电路中，假设v_i=0时，有v_o=0；而当v_i=20 mV时，测得v_o=4 V。求该运算放大器的开环电压增益A_vo。In the circuit of Figure 2.1.1, assume v_o=0 when v_i=0. With v_i=20 mV, the measured output is v_o=4 V. Find the op amp open-loop voltage gain A_vo.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

R₁=1 MΩ与接地R₂=1 kΩ将v_i分压后送同相端v_P；反相端v_N接地，输出接R_L。R₁=1 MΩ and shunt R₂=1 kΩ divide v_i into v_P; v_N is grounded and R_L loads the output.

本题图在书第43页／PDF第76页。The source figure is on printed p. 43 / PDF p. 76.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

分压；开环增益定义；输入电流可忽略。Voltage division; the open-loop gain definition; negligible input current.
没有输出回接输入的反馈通路。先算v_P−v_N，不能把外部20 mV直接当成运放输入压差，也不能在开环中套用虚短。There is no output-to-input feedback path. Calculate v_P−v_N first; the external 20 mV is not the op amp input difference, and an open-loop amplifier does not justify a virtual short.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求同相端分压Find the noninverting voltage

忽略运放输入电流，R₁与R₂构成串联分压；反相端接地。With negligible input current, R₁ and R₂ form an unloaded divider; the inverting input is grounded.

vP=viR2R1+R2=20mV1001=19.98001998μV,vN=0

由增益定义反求Recover the open-loop gain

题设零输入时零输出，排除了本次测量中的直流输出偏移；输出4 V按线性开环关系计算。Zero output at zero input removes a DC output offset from this measurement; the measured 4 V is interpreted through the linear open-loop relation.

Avo=vovP−vN=40.020/1001=200200≈2.002×105

A_vo=200200≈2.002×10⁵ V/V；运放输入压差仅约19.98 μV。A_vo=200200≈2.002×10⁵ V/V; the op amp input difference is only about 19.98 μV.

易错点Common errors

  • 4 V/20 mV=200是整个输入分压器加运放的增益，不是开环运放增益。4 V/20 mV=200 is the gain including the input divider, not the op amp open-loop gain.
  • 此题只让增益有限，仍按默认模型忽略输入电流；若另计有限输入电阻，R₂须与其并联。Only the gain is treated as finite here; input current is neglected under the default model. A specified finite input resistance would load R₂ in parallel.

核验依据Verification

输入电阻无限大、输出处于线性开环区、输出4 V未被电源或负载限幅；题目未给有限输入电阻或电源限制。Infinite input resistance and linear open-loop operation; neither supply nor load clips the measured 4 V. No finite input resistance or supply limit is specified.

独立检查输入节点KCL：(v_i−v_P)/R₁=v_P/R₂，再代回v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N)。Independently check input-node KCL, (v_i−v_P)/R₁=v_P/R₂, and reconstruct v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N).

2.1.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第43页／PDF第76页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 43 / PDF p. 76. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

把输出摆幅折算到输入压差Refer output swing back to the input difference

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图2.1.3所示，运放的开环电压增益A_vo=10⁶，输入电阻r_i=10⁹ Ω，电源电压V_+=+10 V、V_−=−10 V。当运放输出电压的极限值为电源电压时，求线性区输入压差(v_P−v_N)的范围，以及对应其极限值的输入电流i_i。For the circuit in body Figure 2.1.3, the op amp has open-loop gain A_vo=10⁶, input resistance r_i=10⁹ Ω, and supplies V_+=+10 V and V_−=−10 V. When the output limits equal the supply voltages, find the linear-region range of v_P−v_N and the input current i_i at those limits.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

正文图2.1.3：两输入端间有输入电阻r_i，输出模型为受控电压源A_vo(v_P−v_N)，另画出r_o及正负供电。Body Figure 2.1.3: r_i lies between the inputs; the output is modeled by controlled voltage source A_vo(v_P−v_N), with r_o and both supplies shown.

本题图在书第20页／PDF第53页。The source figure is on printed p. 20 / PDF p. 53.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

开环线性关系；欧姆定律；微伏与飞安单位。Open-loop linear transfer; Ohm’s law; microvolt and femtoampere units.
有限开环增益使线性输入范围非常窄。先用输出极限除以A_vo，再用输入压差除以跨接两输入端的r_i。Finite open-loop gain makes the linear input range very narrow. Divide the output limits by A_vo, then divide the resulting input difference by the resistance between the two inputs.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

线性输入范围Linear input range

在线性区v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N)。等号处是线性区与饱和区的交界；严格在线性区时用开区间。In the linear region, v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N). Equality marks the transition to saturation; strictly linear operation uses an open interval.

−10<106(vP−vN)<10⟹−10μV<vP−vN<+10μV

极限处输入电流Input current at the limits

输入电阻两端承受的是输入差分电压，并非10 V电源电压。电流符号按从P端流向N端取正。The input resistance sees the differential input voltage, not the 10 V supply. Define positive current from P to N.

ii=vP−vNri=±10×10−6109=±10−14A=±10fA=±0.01pA

线性区输入压差的边界为±10 μV；严格线性范围为−10 μV<v_P−v_N<+10 μV。边界输入电流为±10 fA（±0.01 pA）。The input-difference boundaries are ±10 μV; strictly linear operation requires −10 μV<v_P−v_N<+10 μV. The corresponding boundary currents are ±10 fA (±0.01 pA).

易错点Common errors

  • 10⁹ Ω是1 GΩ；10 μV/1 GΩ=10 fA，不是10 pA。10⁹ Ω is 1 GΩ; 10 μV/1 GΩ is 10 fA, not 10 pA.
  • 有有限增益就不能把差分输入机械地设成零。Finite gain requires a nonzero differential input for a nonzero output.

核验依据Verification

按题设，输出极限等于电源电压；采用正文简化模型，无另外的偏移、共模项、输出负载压降或输出限流。The output limits equal the supplies as stated. Use the body’s simplified model without additional offset, common-mode contribution, output-load drop, or current limiting.

分别把±10 μV代回开环传输式得到±10 V，再由i_i r_i恢复相同输入压差。Substitute ±10 μV into the open-loop transfer to obtain ±10 V; reconstruct the same input difference using i_i r_i.

2.1.3全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第44页／PDF第77页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 44 / PDF p. 77. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

差模与共模分开算，并保留未给的符号Separate differential and common-mode contributions

题目原文Transcribed question

设某集成运放开环差模电压增益A_vd=10⁵，共模抑制比为80 dB，电源电压V_+=+15 V、V_−=−15 V，输出极限电压±V_om=±14 V。现测得v_P=6.025 mV、v_N=6.055 mV，求此时运放的输出电压。An op amp has open-loop differential gain A_vd=10⁵, common-mode rejection ratio 80 dB, supplies V_+=+15 V and V_−=−15 V, and output limits ±V_om=±14 V. Measured inputs are v_P=6.025 mV and v_N=6.055 mV. Find the output voltage.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

v_id=v_P−v_N；v_ic=(v_P+v_N)/2；电压比dB换算；输出叠加。v_id=v_P−v_N; v_ic=(v_P+v_N)/2; voltage-ratio decibels; output superposition.
先看两输入之差决定主要输出，再看共模是否能忽略。正文CMRR定义用了绝对值，因此80 dB只确定共模增益大小，不提供其正负。The input difference sets the main output; then assess the common-mode contribution. The body defines CMRR with an absolute value, so 80 dB specifies common-mode gain magnitude but not its sign.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

分解两输入Decompose the inputs

差模信号为负的30 μV，而共同的直流电平为6.040 mV。The differential signal is −30 μV and the common-mode level is 6.040 mV.

vid=6.025−6.055=−0.030mV=−30μV;vic=6.025+6.0552=6.040mV

由CMRR求共模增益大小Find common-mode gain magnitude

正文印刷p22–23/PDF55–56，式(2.1.10)为差模与共模输出叠加，式(2.1.11)定义K_CMR=|A_vd/A_vc|；绝对值不能给出A_vc的符号。On printed pp22–23/PDF55–56, equation (2.1.10) adds differential and common-mode outputs, while (2.1.11) defines K_CMR=|A_vd/A_vc|. Its absolute value does not determine the sign of A_vc.

KCMR=1080/20=104,|Avc|=105104=10

完整条件化输出与工作区Conditional output and operating-region check

差模输出为−3 V，共模项的绝对值为0.0604 V。若A_vc=+10，输出−2.9396 V；若A_vc=−10，输出−3.0604 V。两种都远未达到±14 V，无饱和。若忽略共模，常用近似为−3 V。The differential output is −3 V and the common-mode contribution has magnitude 0.0604 V. A_vc=+10 gives −2.9396 V; A_vc=−10 gives −3.0604 V. Both are well inside ±14 V. Neglecting common mode gives the usual −3 V approximation.

vo=Avdvid+Avcvic=−3±0.0604V;|vo|<14V

差模近似v_o≈−3 V。若保留给定有限CMRR，题目未给共模增益符号，不能确定唯一精确值：A_vc=+10时v_o=−2.9396 V；A_vc=−10时v_o=−3.0604 V。均在线性区。The differential-only approximation is v_o≈−3 V. With finite CMRR retained, the common-mode gain sign is unspecified, so no unique exact value follows: v_o=−2.9396 V for A_vc=+10, or −3.0604 V for A_vc=−10. Both remain linear.

易错点Common errors

  • 共模抑制比的分贝值用20 log₁₀，不用10 log₁₀。A voltage-gain ratio in decibels uses 20 log₁₀, not 10 log₁₀.
  • 大CMRR不等于共模输出严格为零；也不能从|A_vd/A_vc|擅自选A_vc的正号。Large CMRR does not make the common-mode output exactly zero, and |A_vd/A_vc| does not justify choosing positive A_vc.
  • 负差模输入产生负输出；不能因为两个输入端都为正而判输出正饱和。A negative differential input gives the dominant negative output; two positive input voltages do not imply positive saturation.

核验依据Verification

准静态线性叠加、无未给定失调项。CMRR只给增益大小比；未给A_vc的极性。−3 V仅为忽略共模项的近似，非唯一精确解。Quasistatic linear superposition with no unspecified offset. CMRR gives a magnitude ratio only; common-mode gain polarity is absent. −3 V is the differential-only approximation, not a uniquely determined exact answer.

目视正文式(2.1.10)与绝对值定义(2.1.11)，分别重建A_vc=±10两种输出，并逐一核对±14 V限制。Visually verify body equations (2.1.10) and absolute-value definition (2.1.11), reconstruct both A_vc=±10 outputs, and check each against ±14 V.

题目原文Transcribed question

同相放大电路如图题2.3.1所示。设v_s=1 V，（1）求闭环电压增益A_v=v_o/v_s、输出电压v_o、各支路电流i_i、i₁、i₂、i_L和i_o；（2）求电流增益A_i=i_L/i_i和功率增益A_p=P_L/P_i；（3）在保持输入电压和闭环电压增益不变的情况下，要求流过R₂的电流为100 μA，请再求R₁、R₂的值。For the noninverting amplifier in Figure 2.3.1, let v_s=1 V. (1) Find closed-loop voltage gain A_v=v_o/v_s, output voltage v_o, and branch currents i_i, i₁, i₂, i_L, and i_o. (2) Find current gain A_i=i_L/i_i and power gain A_p=P_L/P_i. (3) Keep input voltage and closed-loop gain unchanged, but require 100 μA through R₂. Find the new R₁ and R₂.

同相端接v_s，R₁=1 kΩ反相端接地，R₂=9 kΩ输出反馈到反相端，R_L=1 kΩ输出接地；所有电流箭头均保留。v_s drives the noninverting input. R₁=1 kΩ connects the inverting input to ground, R₂=9 kΩ provides feedback, and R_L=1 kΩ loads the output; all current arrows are retained.

本题图在书第44页／PDF第77页。The source figure is on printed p. 44 / PDF p. 77.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放负反馈；同相增益；KCL；功率。Ideal op amp with negative feedback; noninverting gain; KCL; power.
先由虚短得反相端1 V，再沿R₁、R₂及R_L算电流。运放输出电流包含反馈电流和负载电流。Set the inverting node to 1 V, then calculate currents through R₁, R₂, and R_L. Op amp output current supplies both the feedback path and the load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 电压增益与输出(1) Voltage gain and output

同相端为1 V；理想负反馈使反相端也为1 V，且输入电流为零。The noninverting node is at 1 V; ideal negative feedback places the inverting node at 1 V with zero input current.

Av=1+R2R1=10,vo=10V,ii=0

(1) 按原图箭头计算电流(1) Branch currents in the original directions

i₁向下流过R₁，i₂从输出向左流过R₂，i_L向下流过负载，i_o由运放向右流出。两次KCL都要闭合。i₁ flows downward through R₁, i₂ leftward through R₂, i_L downward through the load, and i_o outward from the op amp. Check KCL at both nodes.

i1=11kΩ=1mA;i2=10−19kΩ=1mA;iL=101kΩ=10mA;io=i2+iL=11mA

(2) 理想模型没有有限电流、功率增益(2) No finite ideal current or power gain

负载功率为100 mW，而信号源输入电流及输入功率均为零。两个增益的分母为零，因而没有有限实数值；通常以理想极限趋于无穷大表示。输出能量来自运放电源。Load power is 100 mW, while source input current and input power are zero. The two ratios have zero denominators and no finite real value; they are conventionally described as unbounded ideal limits. Output energy comes from the op amp supplies.

PL=vo2RL=0.10W,Pi=vsii=0,Ai, Ap unbounded in the ideal limit

(3) 保持比例，按目标电流定阻值(3) Preserve the ratio and set the current

输出仍为10 V、反相端仍为1 V。R₂两端9 V对应100 μA，所以R₂=90 kΩ；R₁同流100 μA且压降1 V，所以R₁=10 kΩ。The output remains 10 V and the inverting node remains 1 V. The 9 V across R₂ at 100 μA requires 90 kΩ; R₁ carries the same current at 1 V, requiring 10 kΩ.

R2=9V100μA=90kΩ,R1=1V100μA=10kΩ

(1) A_v=10，v_o=10 V；按原图方向i_i=0、i₁=i₂=1 mA、i_L=10 mA、i_o=11 mA。(2) A_i与A_p无有限值，理想极限无界；P_L=100 mW，P_i=0。(3) R₁=10 kΩ、R₂=90 kΩ。(1) A_v=10 and v_o=10 V. In the original directions, i_i=0, i₁=i₂=1 mA, i_L=10 mA, and i_o=11 mA. (2) A_i and A_p have no finite value and are unbounded in the ideal limit; P_L=100 mW and P_i=0. (3) R₁=10 kΩ and R₂=90 kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 同相增益为1+R₂/R₁；输出电流为11 mA，不能只报负载电流10 mA。Noninverting gain is 1+R₂/R₁; output current is 11 mA, not just the 10 mA load current.
  • 电流增益的输入电流是同相信号端的i_i，不是R₁或R₂中的电流。The input current in A_i is the signal-input current i_i, not the current through R₁ or R₂.
  • 理想无穷大功率增益不表示输出能量来自零输入功率，供电电源提供能量。Unbounded ideal power gain does not create energy from zero input power; the supplies provide it.

核验依据Verification

理想运放，负反馈线性工作，电源及输出驱动能力足以提供10 V和11 mA。电流与功率增益在理想模型中为无界极限，不能当作有限除法结果。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback with sufficient supply headroom and drive for 10 V and 11 mA. Current and power gains are unbounded ideal limits, not finite quotients.

独立求解反相节点KCL与v_N=v_P，再核对i₂=i₁及i_o=i_L+i₂；新电阻同时检查100 μA目标与增益10。Independently solve inverting-node KCL with v_N=v_P, check i₂=i₁ and i_o=i_L+i₂, and verify both the 100 μA target and gain 10 with the new resistors.

指定要求：2.3.2Assigned requirement: 2.3.2

含电压源的反馈电路：先定输入端电位Feedback with voltage sources: find input-node voltages first

题目原文Transcribed question

试分别求出图题2.3.2中各运放电路的V_O电压值。Find the output voltage V_O of each op-amp circuit in Fig. 2.3.2.

四种负反馈电路。(a)同相端接地，反相端与10 kΩ、20 kΩ分压节点V₁之间串联2 V源（V₁为正端）；(b)同相端接+2 V，反相端接同一分压节点；(c)同相端接地，输出经20 kΩ和2 V源反馈到反相端，源上端为正；(d)同相端接+2 V，输出经20 kΩ反馈到反相端。Four negative-feedback circuits. (a) The non-inverting input is grounded; a 2 V source, positive at divider node V₁, connects V₁ to the inverting input; V₁ is between 10 kΩ to ground and 20 kΩ to the output. (b) The non-inverting input is at +2 V and the inverting input connects directly to the same divider. (c) The grounded non-inverting input is paired with feedback through 20 kΩ and a 2 V source positive at its upper terminal. (d) The non-inverting input is at +2 V and feedback uses 20 kΩ.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放虚短和虚断；电压源极性；KCL。Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; voltage-source polarity; KCL.
不要先套同相/反相放大器增益公式。先由同相端求反相端电位，再沿反馈路径用电压源极性和零输入电流求输出。First infer the inverting-input potential from the non-inverting input. Then use source polarity and zero input current along the feedback path to find the output.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

共同起点：虚短、虚断Start with ideal-input conditions

四图都为负反馈。理想线性运放满足V_N=V_P，且流入两个输入端的电流均为零。串在反馈中的独立电压源仍保留其规定电压。All four circuits use negative feedback. In ideal linear operation, V_N = V_P and both input currents are zero. An independent voltage source in the feedback path retains its specified voltage.

VN=VP,iN=iP=0

(a)：电压源使分压节点为2 V(a): the source sets the divider node to 2 V

V_P=0，所以V_N=0。2 V源正端在V₁，故V₁=2 V。在V₁列KCL，流入运放支路电流为零，得到V_O=6 V。V_P = 0 implies V_N = 0. The 2 V source is positive at V₁, so V₁ = 2 V. KCL at V₁, with no current into the input branch, gives V_O = 6 V.

V1=VN+2=2V,210kΩ+2−VO20kΩ=0⇒VO=6V

(b)：直接由虚短确定分压节点(b): the virtual short sets the divider node

同相端为2 V，故V₁=V_N=2 V。与(a)相同的分压网络给出V_O=6 V。The non-inverting input is 2 V, so V₁ = V_N = 2 V. The same divider as in (a) gives V_O = 6 V.

VO=(1+2010)2=6V

(c)：反馈电阻没有压降(c): the feedback resistor has no voltage drop

V_N=V_P=0。反相端支路没有其他通路，电流为零，所以20 kΩ上压降为零。2 V源上端比V_N高2 V，因此输出为2 V。V_N = V_P = 0. The inverting-input branch has no other current path, so its current is zero and the 20 kΩ resistor has no voltage drop. The upper source terminal is 2 V above V_N, hence the output is 2 V.

IR=0,VO=VN+2=2V

(d)：有反馈电阻的电压跟随器(d): a voltage follower with a feedback resistor

V_N=V_P=2 V，反馈电阻电流为零，输出与反相端电位相等，故V_O=2 V。V_N = V_P = 2 V. With zero current in the feedback resistor, the output equals the inverting-input potential, giving V_O = 2 V.

VO=VN=VP=2V

(a)6 V；(b)6 V；(c)2 V；(d)2 V。(a) 6 V; (b) 6 V; (c) 2 V; (d) 2 V.

易错点Common errors

  • 虚短是两个输入端电位相等，不是把串联的2 V源短路。A virtual short equates the input potentials; it does not short the series 2 V source.
  • (c)(d)反馈电阻电流为零；不能把它们错当作带接地输入电阻的普通放大器。The feedback-resistor current in (c) and (d) is zero; these circuits do not have the grounded input resistor of a conventional gain network.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

逐图检查电压源长线正端和实际反馈连接；独立代回KCL：(a)(b)两电阻电流均为0.2 mA，(c)(d)反馈电流均为0。所有结果同时满足V_N=V_P。未声称与外部参考答案对照。Inspected each source positive terminal and actual feedback connection. Independent substitution into KCL gives 0.2 mA in both divider resistors for (a) and (b), and zero feedback current for (c) and (d). All results satisfy V_N = V_P. No external-answer-key comparison is claimed.

题目原文Transcribed question

同相放大电路如图题2.3.3所示，除输出端最大电流为±40 mA外，运放其他特性如同理想运放。已知运放的电源电压为±15 V，v_i=0.2 sin ωt V。（1）当R_L=500 Ω时，求v_o波形；（2）当R_L=100 Ω时，再求v_o波形；（3）运放选用μA741（输出端最大电流为±40 mA），v_i正弦波频率为100 Hz，用SPICE分别绘出（1）和（2）情况下的v_i和v_o波形。In the noninverting amplifier of Figure 2.3.3, the op amp is ideal except for maximum output current ±40 mA. Its supplies are ±15 V and v_i=0.2 sin ωt V. (1) Find v_o for R_L=500 Ω. (2) Repeat for R_L=100 Ω. (3) Select a μA741 (maximum output current ±40 mA), set the input frequency to 100 Hz, and use SPICE to plot v_i and v_o for both load cases.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

同相端接v_i，反相端经R₁=1 kΩ接地、经R₂=59 kΩ接输出，输出经R_L接地。v_i drives the noninverting input; R₁=1 kΩ grounds the inverting input, R₂=59 kΩ provides feedback, and R_L loads the output.

本题图在书第44页／PDF第77页。The source figure is on printed p. 44 / PDF p. 77.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

同相增益；总输出电流；电流限幅；SPICE模型边界。Noninverting gain; total output current; current limiting; SPICE model boundaries.
先画未限幅的12 V正弦，再同时检查15 V电压边界与40 mA电流边界。反馈支路也消耗输出电流，必须与负载并联计入。Start with the unclipped 12 V sine, then check both the 15 V voltage limit and 40 mA current limit. Include the feedback path in parallel with the load because it also draws output current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一的增益与限流边界Gain and current-limit boundary

线性增益为60。输入电流为零时，无论是否限流，R₁与R₂都是从输出到地的串联60 kΩ支路；因此限流时仍可求v_N=v_o/60，但不能令v_N=v_i。The linear gain is 60. With zero input current, R₁ and R₂ remain a series 60 kΩ path from output to ground even during current limiting. Thus v_N=v_o/60 remains valid, but v_N=v_i does not.

Av=1+59kΩ1kΩ=60;vo,lin=12sinωtV;io=vo(1RL+160kΩ);Vlim=min(15,0.0401/RL+1/60000)

(1) 500 Ω负载：不削顶(1) 500 Ω: no clipping

12 V峰值时负载电流24 mA、反馈电流0.2 mA，总计24.2 mA，小于40 mA；12 V也小于15 V。At a 12 V peak, the load draws 24 mA and the feedback path 0.2 mA, totaling 24.2 mA, below 40 mA. The 12 V peak is also below 15 V.

RL=500Ω:vo=12sinωtV,|io|max=24.2mA

(2) 100 Ω负载：正负削平(2) 100 Ω: symmetric current clipping

未限幅时需要120.2 mA，超出40 mA。严格题设模型的平顶高度为3.993344 V，常忽略反馈支路而近似成4 V。输入幅度超过66.5557 mV时进入限流。The unclipped demand is 120.2 mA, exceeding 40 mA. The exact textbook-model plateau is 3.993344 V; 4 V is the approximation that neglects feedback current. Current limiting begins when input magnitude exceeds 66.5557 mV.

Vlim=0.0401/100+1/60000=2400601=3.993344426V;vo(t)={12sinωt,|12sinωt|≤VlimVlimsgn(sinωt),|12sinωt|>Vlim

(3) 已运行的100 Hz SPICE波形(3) Executed 100 Hz SPICE waveforms

已实际运行ngspice 47，保留网表、数值数据及两种负载的输入/输出图。自写严格±40 mA模型与上面分段式的最大误差小于3 μV：500 Ω输出约±12 V，100 Ω输出±3.993344 V。厂商μA741宏模型另作器件对照。ngspice 47 was actually run; netlists, numerical data, and input/output plots for both loads are retained. A self-authored strict ±40 mA model agrees with the piecewise expression within 3 μV: about ±12 V at 500 Ω and ±3.993344 V at 100 Ω. Manufacturer μA741 macro-model runs provide a separate device comparison.

vi(t)=0.2sin(200πt)V,T=10ms;transient: 0–40ms, Δtmax=2μs

(3) μA741宏模型的限流参数不能混同(3) Distinguish μA741 macro-model current limits

TI官方SLOJ138中的UA741.301用VLP/VLN=25，100 Ω下仿真平顶约±2.55622 V。为对照题目的40 mA设定，仅把这两个控制参数改成40的研究副本得到约±4.05367 V，实测软限流约±40.6043 mA；它不是严格40 mA硬限幅。500 Ω时两个厂商模型都约为−11.98878到+11.99954 V。题设(1)(2)的精确结论仍采用严格40 mA模型；器件宏模型的有限带宽、偏置和软限流解释了细小差异。TI SLOJ138 supplies UA741.301 with VLP/VLN=25; its simulated 100 Ω plateaus are about ±2.55622 V. A research copy changing only those two controls to 40 gives about ±4.05367 V and measured soft limiting near ±40.6043 mA, rather than an exact 40 mA hard limit. At 500 Ω, both manufacturer variants span approximately −11.98878 to +11.99954 V. The exact answers to (1) and (2) still use the strict 40 mA model; finite bandwidth, bias, and soft limiting account for macro-model differences.

100 Hz实际SPICE：严格±40 mA题设模型在500 Ω与100 Ω负载下的v_i与v_o；分别为12 V正弦与±3.993344 V削顶。Executed 100 Hz SPICE input/output waveforms for the strict ±40 mA textbook model at 500 Ω and 100 Ω: a 12 V sine and clipping at ±3.993344 V, respectively.

实际SPICE对照严格40 mA题设模型、原TI μA741模型（25控制值）及仅改40控制值的软限流副本；100 Ω的平顶分别约3.993、2.556、4.054 V。Executed SPICE comparison of the strict 40 mA textbook model, original TI μA741 model (25 controls), and soft-limit research copy with 40 controls; 100 Ω plateaus are approximately 3.993, 2.556, and 4.054 V.

(1) v_o=12 sin ωt V，无削顶。(2) v_o为12 sin ωt在±3.993344 V处对称削平，约±4 V。(3) 100 Hz的SPICE网表、数据与输入/输出波形已提供；严格40 mA模型复现上述结果。μA741厂商宏模型的原始25 mA参数版与改40控制参数的软限流版已另图对照，不能把其平顶当作题设精确硬边界。(1) v_o=12 sin ωt V without clipping. (2) Clip 12 sin ωt symmetrically at ±3.993344 V, approximately ±4 V. (3) Executed 100 Hz SPICE netlists, data, and input/output plots are supplied; the strict 40 mA model reproduces these answers. Separate plots compare the original manufacturer model with 25 mA controls and the version with controls set to 40; their soft-limit plateaus are not the exact textbook hard boundary.

易错点Common errors

  • i_o不是只有v_o/R_L，还包括输出反馈电阻支路的电流。i_o includes the feedback-resistor path as well as v_o/R_L.
  • 进入限流后虚短失效；电阻分压关系v_N=v_o/60仍然成立。A virtual short fails in current limiting; the resistor-divider relation v_N=v_o/60 still holds.
  • 不能把官方UA741宏模型的25 mA控制值或改40后的软限流结果，未经说明直接当作题设±40 mA硬限幅。Do not silently equate either the official model’s 25 mA controls or the modified model’s soft limit with the exercise’s strict ±40 mA boundary.

核验依据Verification

(1)(2)为除±40 mA硬限流外的理想运放，供电±15 V。严格SPICE模型采用大跨导1e6 A/V及min/max限流，结果均小于电源边界。(3)TI宏模型原版及仅调整VLP/VLN的研究副本分别记录；其二极管软限流、有限增益/带宽与偏置不属于题设硬限流模型。Parts (1) and (2) use an otherwise ideal op amp with strict ±40 mA limiting and ±15 V supplies. The strict SPICE implementation uses large transconductance 1e6 A/V with min/max current clamping; every output stays inside the rails. Part (3) separately records the original TI macro model and a research copy changing only VLP/VLN; their diode soft limiting, finite gain/bandwidth, and bias differ from the textbook hard-limit model.

先独立以输出节点KCL求电流极限，再逐点检查分段波形的线性误差/限流条件及±15 V边界。实际执行6个ngspice瞬态任务，保存全部网表、日志、原始数据，逐样本核验输出节点KCL；严格模型对解析波形最大误差<3 μV。Independently derive the current boundary by output-node KCL, then check the linear-error/current-limit conditions and ±15 V limits pointwise. Execute six ngspice transients and retain every netlist, log, and dataset; verify output KCL sample by sample. The strict model differs from the analytical waveform by <3 μV.

2.3.4全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

输入分压、同相增益、供电和带载能力Input division, gain, supply, and load capability

题目原文Transcribed question

放大电路如图题2.3.4所示。（1）试求电路的电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i和输入电阻R_i；（2）若运放的饱和压降为2 V，要求v_o能在−10～+10 V范围内变化，那么电源电压应为多少？（3）在（2）的基础上，若运放输出端最大电流为±20 mA，且已知输出最大电压时，R₂中的电流为500 μA，那么电路对负载阻值有何要求？For the amplifier in Figure 2.3.4: (1) Find voltage gain A_v=v_o/v_i and input resistance R_i. (2) With 2 V output saturation headroom, what supply voltages allow v_o to span −10 to +10 V? (3) Under (2), the maximum output current is ±20 mA and current through R₂ at maximum output voltage is 500 μA. What requirement must the load resistance satisfy?

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

v_i经R₃接同相端，同相端经R₄接地；反相端经R₁接地、经R₂反馈至输出。输入电阻由v_i端看入。v_i reaches the noninverting input through R₃ with shunt R₄; R₁ grounds the inverting input and R₂ feeds back from the output. R_i is measured looking into the v_i terminal.

本题图在书第45页／PDF第78页。The source figure is on printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无载输入分压；同相放大；输出摆幅与电源压差；KCL。Unloaded input division; noninverting gain; supply headroom; KCL.
R₃、R₄先把输入衰减，R₁、R₂再同相放大。负载能力问题要从总输出电流中扣掉反馈电流。R₃ and R₄ attenuate the input before R₁ and R₂ provide noninverting gain. Subtract feedback current from total output-current capability to obtain load capacity.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 电压增益(1) Voltage gain

运放同相端不吸收电流，R₃与R₄为纯分压；负反馈运放再放大1+R₂/R₁倍。Zero noninverting input current makes R₃–R₄ an unloaded divider; the feedback amplifier then multiplies by 1+R₂/R₁.

vP=R4R3+R4vi,Av=(1+R2R1)R4R3+R4

(1) 输入电阻(1) Input resistance

输入源的电流只能依次流过R₃与R₄，不能流进运放输入端。Source current must pass through R₃ and R₄ in series because none enters the op amp.

ii=viR3+R4,Ri=R3+R4

(2) 电源至少±12 V(2) Supplies of at least ±12 V

正、负输出极限都要离相应电源轨2 V，因此每侧供电的幅值至少12 V。Each output extreme must remain 2 V away from its respective rail; each supply magnitude must therefore be at least 12 V.

V+≥+12V,V−≤−12V;minimum symmetric supplies: ±12V

(3) 剩余输出电流供给负载(3) Allocate remaining current to the load

在|v_o|=10 V时，反馈支路已占0.5 mA，留给对地电阻负载最多19.5 mA；正负峰值对称。At |v_o|=10 V, the feedback branch draws 0.5 mA, leaving at most 19.5 mA for a resistive load to ground; the positive and negative peaks are symmetric.

10RL+0.5mA≤20mA⟹RL≥100.0195=512.820513Ω

(1) A_v=(1+R₂/R₁)R₄/(R₃+R₄)，R_i=R₃+R₄。(2) 对称供电最低±12 V。(3) 对地电阻负载R_L≥512.82 Ω；若要求留余量，应取更大值。(1) A_v=(1+R₂/R₁)R₄/(R₃+R₄), and R_i=R₃+R₄. (2) The minimum symmetric supplies are ±12 V. (3) A resistive load to ground requires R_L≥512.82 Ω; a larger value provides margin.

易错点Common errors

  • 同相端有R₄对地，因此从v_i端看到的输入电阻不是无穷大。Because R₄ shunts the noninverting node, input resistance at v_i is not infinite.
  • 10 V输出加2 V饱和压降，对应每侧12 V，双电源总差为24 V。A 10 V output plus 2 V headroom requires 12 V on each rail, or 24 V rail-to-rail.
  • R_L≥500 Ω会忽略0.5 mA反馈电流，在10 V峰值处超过总电流上限。R_L≥500 Ω neglects the 0.5 mA feedback current and exceeds the total-current limit at the 10 V peak.

核验依据Verification

理想运放线性负反馈；第(2)问额外计入2 V饱和压降，第(3)问再加入对称±20 mA限制。负载为输出到地的无源电阻；输入共模范围足够。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, augmented by 2 V saturation headroom in (2) and symmetric ±20 mA limiting in (3). The load is a passive resistor from output to ground; input common-mode range is sufficient.

用独立三节点方程检查输入分压及反馈比；在负载边界计算i_L=19.5 mA、i_f=0.5 mA，总计20 mA，并由i_f检查R₁+R₂=20 kΩ。Check input division and feedback ratio with independent three-node equations; at the load boundary verify i_L=19.5 mA and i_f=0.5 mA total 20 mA, and infer R₁+R₂=20 kΩ from i_f.

2.3.5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

有限开环增益的跟随误差Follower error with finite open-loop gain

题目原文Transcribed question

若运放的开环差模电压增益为A_vo，共模抑制比为无穷大。（1）求电压跟随器输出电压与输入电压的实际关系；（2）若要求跟随误差不超过0.01%，A_vo至少要达到多少？An op amp has open-loop differential gain A_vo and infinite common-mode rejection ratio. (1) Find the actual voltage-follower output/input relation. (2) How large must A_vo be to keep following error at or below 0.01%?

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

开环传输式；单位负反馈；相对误差。Open-loop transfer; unity negative feedback; relative error.
此题要算有限增益误差，必须保留v_i−v_o。直接使用虚短会把要求计算的误差消掉。The finite-gain error is the quantity of interest, so retain v_i−v_o. Imposing an exact virtual short would erase that error.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 保留输入差，再解闭环关系(1) Keep the differential input and solve

跟随器同相端接v_i，反相端直接接v_o；共模项为零。The noninverting input receives v_i and the inverting input receives v_o directly; there is no common-mode contribution.

vo=Avo(vi−vo)⟹vovi=Avo1+Avo=1−11+Avo

(2) 按输入值定义跟随相对误差(2) Define relative following error with respect to input

对正的准静态开环增益，输出略小于输入。0.01%=10⁻⁴；这里采用|v_i−v_o|/|v_i|的通常定义。For positive quasistatic open-loop gain, output is slightly smaller than input. Since 0.01%=10⁻⁴, use the usual error definition |v_i−v_o|/|v_i|.

ε=|1−vovi|=11+Avo≤10−4⟹Avo≥9999≈104

(1) v_o=[A_vo/(1+A_vo)]v_i。(2) 按相对于输入的跟随误差，精确下限A_vo=9999 V/V，工程上约取10⁴ V/V（约80 dB）。(1) v_o=[A_vo/(1+A_vo)]v_i. (2) For error relative to the input, the exact minimum is A_vo=9999 V/V, commonly rounded to 10⁴ V/V (about 80 dB).

易错点Common errors

  • 本题不能先令v_o=v_i；那相当于把有限A_vo重新理想化成无穷大。Do not start from v_o=v_i; that would replace the specified finite A_vo with infinity.
  • 若把误差改定义成|v_i−v_o|/|v_o|，结果是1/A_vo，下限为10000；分母必须写清。本解采用常见的输入归一化定义。If error were instead defined as |v_i−v_o|/|v_o|, it would equal 1/A_vo and require 10000. State the denominator; this solution uses the usual input-normalized definition.

核验依据Verification

准静态正实数开环增益，单位负反馈稳定；其他特性理想，未发生输出限幅；误差相对于输入定义。v_i=0时输出也为零，可用增益误差连续延拓。Positive real quasistatic gain, stable unity negative feedback, other properties ideal, and no output clipping. Error is input-normalized; at v_i=0 both voltages are zero and gain error is defined by continuity.

对A_vo=9999、10⁴及多组较小/较大正值，独立解v_o=A_vo(v_i−v_o)，检查误差单调下降，并核验边界正好等于10⁻⁴。For A_vo=9999, 10⁴, and other positive values, independently solve v_o=A_vo(v_i−v_o), verify monotonic error reduction, and confirm the boundary equals 10⁻⁴.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

虚地让光电流全部进入反馈电阻Virtual ground sends the photocurrent through feedback

题目原文Transcribed question

电流-电压转换电路如图题2.3.6所示。设i_s是光探测仪的输出电流，R_si是其内阻。（1）试证明输出电压v_o=−i_sR；（2）当i_s=0.5 mA、R_si=10 kΩ、R=10 kΩ时，求输出电压v_o和互阻增益A_r。For the current-to-voltage converter in Figure 2.3.6, i_s is the photodetector output current and R_si its internal resistance. (1) Prove v_o=−i_sR. (2) For i_s=0.5 mA, R_si=10 kΩ, and R=10 kΩ, find v_o and transresistance gain A_r.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

光电流源i_s与R_si并联注入运放反相端，反馈电阻R由输出接反相端，同相端接地；i_s向上、反馈电流向右。Photocurrent source i_s and parallel R_si feed the inverting input; feedback resistor R joins output and inverting input, and the noninverting input is grounded. i_s points upward and feedback current rightward.

本题图在书第45页／PDF第78页。The source figure is on printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

诺顿电流源；理想运放虚地/虚断；节点KCL；互阻单位Ω。Norton current source; ideal-op-amp virtual ground and zero input current; KCL; transresistance in ohms.
R_si并在电流源两端，但虚地使它两端电压为零。因此它不分走信号电流，不能按普通并联分流公式处理。R_si shunts the current source, but virtual ground gives it zero voltage. It therefore draws no signal current; ordinary current division does not apply.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 输入节点虚地与KCL(1) Virtual ground and input-node KCL

同相端接地且负反馈线性工作，故v_N=0；运放输入电流为零，R_si电流也为零。所有i_s经R流向输出。Grounded noninverting input and linear negative feedback give v_N=0. Both op amp input current and R_si current are zero, so all i_s passes through R toward the output.

vN=vP=0;is=vNRsi+vN−voR+iN=0−voR+0

(1) 得到互阻关系(1) Transresistance relation

正向注入的电流必须从输入虚地点经R流向负电压输出，因此输出符号为负。A positive injected current flows from virtual ground through R to a negative output, which establishes the minus sign.

vo=−isR,Ar≡vois=−R

(2) 代入数值(2) Numerical values

0.5 mA乘10 kΩ为5 V；10 kΩ内阻不改变理想虚地关系。0.5 mA times 10 kΩ is 5 V; the 10 kΩ internal resistance does not alter ideal virtual-ground operation.

vo=−(0.5mA)(10kΩ)=−5V,Ar=−10kΩ

(1) v_o=−i_sR，A_r=−R。(2) v_o=−5 V，互阻增益A_r=−10 kΩ。(1) v_o=−i_sR and A_r=−R. (2) v_o=−5 V and transresistance gain A_r=−10 kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 电流源内阻R_si与反馈电阻R并不直接并联在同一对节点上；R另一端是运放输出，不是地。R_si and feedback R are not directly across the same node pair; R terminates at the output, not ground.
  • 互阻增益的单位是Ω，不能只写无单位的−10。Transresistance has units of ohms; do not report a dimensionless −10.
  • 若输出饱和或带宽不足，虚地条件会失效，此时R_si可能分流。If clipping or inadequate bandwidth destroys virtual ground, R_si can draw part of the source current.

核验依据Verification

理想运放稳定负反馈，供电与输出电流能力足以达到−5 V和0.5 mA；准静态忽略探测器及输入寄生电容。Ideal op amp with stable negative feedback and sufficient supply/output capability for −5 V and 0.5 mA; quasistatic analysis neglects detector and input parasitic capacitance.

在原图输入节点独立写完整KCL并检查R_si支路零电流；多组R_si及电流符号数值代入均满足KCL，给定数值时R流过0.5 mA。Independently write complete input-node KCL and verify zero R_si current; numerical checks over several R_si values and both current signs satisfy KCL, with 0.5 mA through R in the stated case.

2.3.7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2.3.7Assigned requirement: 2.3.7

双运放差分输出与输入电阻Two-op-amp differential output and input resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.3.7所示，v_i=0.5sin ωt V。（1）试求v_o1、v_o2和v_o；（2）求电路的电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i和输入电阻R_i。The circuit is shown in Fig. 2.3.7, with v_i = 0.5 sin(ωt) V. (1) Find v_o1, v_o2 and v_o. (2) Find the voltage gain A_v = v_o/v_i and the input resistance R_i.

输入v_i同时接A₁同相端前的12 kΩ和A₂反相端前的12 kΩ；A₁反馈40 kΩ、反相端对地12 kΩ；A₂反馈30 kΩ、同相端经12 kΩ接地。输出v_o定义上正下负，即v_o1-v_o2。Input v_i connects through separate 12 kΩ resistors to A₁’s non-inverting input and A₂’s inverting input. A₁ has 40 kΩ feedback and 12 kΩ from its inverting input to ground. A₂ has 30 kΩ feedback and its non-inverting input is grounded through 12 kΩ. Output v_o is positive at v_o1 and negative at v_o2.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

同相、反相放大器；差分电压的参考极性；端口输入电阻。Non-inverting and inverting amplifiers; differential-output polarity; port input resistance.
先拆成上方同相放大器与下方反相放大器，分别求输出，再按图示正负端相减。输入电阻要从信号源的总取流量计算。Treat the upper stage as non-inverting and the lower stage as inverting. Find each output, then subtract according to the marked polarity. Find input resistance from the total current drawn from the signal source.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

上方A₁：同相放大Upper A₁: non-inverting gain

同相端不取电流，其前面的12 kΩ无压降，故同相端电压就是v_i。A₁增益为1+40/12=13/3。The non-inverting input draws no current, so its series 12 kΩ resistor has no voltage drop and its voltage equals v_i. A₁’s gain is 1 + 40/12 = 13/3.

vo1=(1+4012)vi=136sinωtV

下方A₂：反相放大Lower A₂: inverting gain

A₂同相端为0，反相端为虚地。其增益为-30/12=-5/2。A₂’s non-inverting input is at 0 V and its inverting input is a virtual ground. Its gain is -30/12 = -5/2.

vo2=−3012vi=−54sinωtV

按输出极性相减Subtract according to the output polarity

图中v_o上正下负，故v_o=v_o1-v_o2。下方输出本身为负，相减后两项的幅值相加。The output is marked positive at the top and negative at the bottom, so v_o = v_o1 - v_o2. Since the lower output is negative, the amplitudes add.

vo=(133+52)vi=416vi=4112sinωtV,Av=416

从输入总电流求R_iFind R_i from the total input current

上方同相支路输入电流为零。输入电流全部通过下方12 kΩ流向A₂虚地，所以i_i=v_i/(12 kΩ)。The upper non-inverting branch draws zero input current. All input current flows through the lower 12 kΩ resistor into A₂’s virtual ground, so i_i = v_i/(12 kΩ).

Ri=viii=12kΩ

v_o1=(13/6)sin ωt V，v_o2=-(5/4)sin ωt V，v_o=(41/12)sin ωt V；A_v=41/6≈6.833，R_i=12 kΩ。v_o1 = (13/6) sin(ωt) V, v_o2 = -(5/4) sin(ωt) V, and v_o = (41/12) sin(ωt) V; A_v = 41/6 ≈ 6.833 and R_i = 12 kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • v_o是两个输出端之间的电压，不是某一个运放的对地输出。v_o is the voltage between the two outputs, not either single output relative to ground.
  • 上方串联12 kΩ不与下方12 kΩ并联取流，因为理想同相输入端的电流为零。The upper series 12 kΩ does not draw current in parallel with the lower 12 kΩ, because the ideal non-inverting input current is zero.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

逐点代回运放反相节点KCL。A₁节点电位v_i满足v_i/12k+(v_i-v_o1)/40k=0；A₂虚地满足-v_i/12k-v_o2/30k=0。输入取流式和输出极性独立核查均一致。Substituted into KCL at each inverting node. A₁’s node at v_i satisfies v_i/12k + (v_i - v_o1)/40k = 0; A₂’s virtual ground satisfies -v_i/12k - v_o2/30k = 0. Input-current and output-polarity checks agree.

2.3.8全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

两个虚短先定电位，再测βUse two feedback constraints before finding β

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.3.8所示，三极管T电极b、e间的压差V_BE=V_B−V_E=0.7 V。（1）求三极管电极c、b、e的电位；（2）若电压表的读数为200 mV，试求三极管电流放大系数β=I_C/I_B的值。In Figure 2.3.8, transistor T has V_BE=V_B−V_E=0.7 V. (1) Find the collector, base, and emitter potentials. (2) If the voltmeter reads 200 mV, find current gain β=I_C/I_B.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

A₁同相端+6 V、反相端接T集电极，输出驱动T发射极；+12 V经R₁=6 kΩ给集电极供电。A₂反相端接基极，R₂=10 kΩ反馈，R₃=10 kΩ使同相端接地，输出电压表读200 mV。A₁ has +6 V at its noninverting input, collector feedback at its inverting input, and drives the emitter. +12 V supplies the collector through R₁=6 kΩ. A₂ senses the base at its inverting input with R₂=10 kΩ feedback; R₃=10 kΩ grounds its noninverting input. Its output voltmeter reads 200 mV.

本题图在书第45页／PDF第78页。The source figure is on printed p. 45 / PDF p. 78.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放负反馈；BJT电位与放大区条件；KCL；β=I_C/I_B。Ideal op amp negative feedback; BJT terminal potentials and active-region conditions; KCL; β=I_C/I_B.
A₁通过晶体管把集电极钳在+6 V；A₂把基极保持在0 V。不要把A₁输出误当集电极，A₁输出实际接发射极。A₁ controls the transistor to hold its collector at +6 V; A₂ holds the base at 0 V. A₁ output is connected to the emitter, not the collector.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 两个理想反馈约束(1) Two ideal feedback constraints

A₁两输入相等给V_C=+6 V。A₂同相端经R₃接地且无输入电流，因此V_B=0。由给定V_BE求发射极。Equal A₁ input voltages give V_C=+6 V. A₂ noninverting input is grounded through R₃ without input current, so V_B=0. Use the given V_BE for the emitter.

VC=+6V,VB=0,VE=VB−VBE=−0.7V

(2) 集电极电流(2) Collector current

A₁输入不取电流，R₁的电流全部进入晶体管集电极。A₁ input draws no current, so all current through R₁ enters the collector.

IC=12−66kΩ=1mA

(2) 基极电流与β(2) Base current and β

NPN管基极需要正的流入电流，因此A₂输出为正的+200 mV，电流从输出经R₂流向0 V基极；R₃不承载输入电流。The NPN base requires positive current into the device, so A₂ output is +200 mV. Current flows from that output through R₂ toward the 0 V base; R₃ carries no input current.

IB=VO−VBR2=0.20010kΩ=20μA;β=1mA20μA=50

核对晶体管工作区与输出电流Check the transistor region and output currents

集电极高于基极6 V，集电结反偏；基极比发射极高0.7 V，发射结正偏，符合NPN正向放大。A₁输出需吸收I_E=1.02 mA，A₂输出提供20 μA。The collector is 6 V above the base, so the collector junction is reverse biased; the base is 0.7 V above the emitter, so the emitter junction is forward biased. This is NPN forward-active operation. A₁ must sink I_E=1.02 mA and A₂ supplies 20 μA.

VCB=6V>0,VCE=6.7V,IE=IC+IB=1.02mA

(1) V_C=+6 V，V_B=0 V，V_E=−0.7 V。(2) I_C=1 mA、I_B=20 μA，β=50；晶体管处于正向放大区。(1) V_C=+6 V, V_B=0 V, and V_E=−0.7 V. (2) I_C=1 mA, I_B=20 μA, and β=50; the transistor is forward active.

易错点Common errors

  • 6 kΩ电阻的压降是12−6=6 V，不是12 V。The 6 kΩ resistor drops 12−6=6 V, not 12 V.
  • 200 mV是A₂输出对地电压，基极本身由反馈保持0 V。The 200 mV reading is A₂ output relative to ground; feedback holds the base itself at 0 V.
  • 给定V_BE=V_B−V_E=+0.7 V，故基极0 V时发射极为−0.7 V。Given V_BE=V_B−V_E=+0.7 V, a 0 V base requires a −0.7 V emitter.

核验依据Verification

两运放理想、反馈稳定且未饱和；供电/共模范围支持A₁输入+6 V、输出−0.7 V及A₂输出+0.2 V。晶体管按题设V_BE=0.7 V，忽略漏电流；电压表输入电阻无限大。Both op amps are ideal, stable, and unclipped, with supply/common-mode capability for A₁ inputs at +6 V, its output at −0.7 V, and A₂ output at +0.2 V. Use specified transistor V_BE=0.7 V, neglect leakage, and treat the voltmeter as infinitely resistive.

从两个独立运放约束与集电极/基极节点KCL重算；再检查NPN发射结正偏、集电结反偏及I_E=I_C+I_B，避免先套β公式而遗漏工作区。Recompute from the two independent op amp constraints and collector/base KCL; then check NPN emitter forward bias, collector reverse bias, and I_E=I_C+I_B rather than applying β without a region check.

用T型反馈得到大增益，同时计入麦克风内阻Use T feedback and include microphone source resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

图2.3.8所示电路作为麦克风电路的前置放大器，麦克风的输入电压有效值为12 mV，其内阻R_si=1 kΩ，R₁=R₁′+R_si（R₁′为外接电阻）。要求输出电压有效值为1.2 V，求电路中各阻值，设计时该电路所有电阻小于500 kΩ。Use the circuit in body Figure 2.3.8 as a microphone preamplifier. The microphone source voltage is 12 mV rms and its internal resistance is R_si=1 kΩ; R₁=R₁′+R_si, where R₁′ is the external resistor. Design the resistances for an output of 1.2 V rms, with every resistor below 500 kΩ.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

正文T型反馈反相放大器：R₁连接输入源与反相虚地点N，R₂连接N与节点M，R₃连接M与输出，R₄连接M与地；同相端接地。图中的R₁包括麦克风内阻及外接R₁′。Body T-feedback inverting amplifier: R₁ joins the source to virtual-ground N; R₂ joins N to M, R₃ joins M to output, and R₄ joins M to ground. The noninverting input is grounded; R₁ includes microphone internal resistance and external R₁′.

本题图在书第29页／PDF第62页。The source figure is on printed p. 29 / PDF p. 62.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相运放虚地；T型网络节点KCL；有效值增益；源内阻串联。Inverting-amplifier virtual ground; T-network KCL; rms gain; series source resistance.
题目引用正文图2.3.8（印刷p29/PDF62），不是下面的图题2.3.8晶体管测β电路。12 mV是带1 kΩ内阻的源电压，必须把内阻加进R₁。设计解不唯一，给出一组满足全部约束的解即可。The reference is body Figure 2.3.8 (printed p29/PDF62), not exercise Figure 2.3.8 for transistor β measurement. The 12 mV belongs to a source with 1 kΩ internal resistance, which must be included in R₁. The design is not unique; one set satisfying all constraints is sufficient.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

目标源电压增益Required source-voltage gain

输出与输入有效值之比为100。正文电路反相，故所需带符号增益为−100。The ratio of output to source rms voltage is 100. The body circuit is inverting, so the required signed gain is −100.

Av=vovi=−1.20.012=−100,R1=R1′+Rsi

原图两个节点独立写KCLWrite KCL at both original nodes

N点为0 V，输入电流等于从N流向M的电流；M点另有R₄接地电流，不能把R₂与R₃简单串联。N is at 0 V, so input current equals current from N to M. M also connects through R₄ to ground, so R₂ and R₃ cannot be treated as a simple series pair.

viR1=−vMR2,vMR2+vMR4+vM−voR3=0

得到T型反馈的有效增益Derive T-feedback gain

消去v_M；R₂R₃/R₄这一项可使等效反馈电阻很大，同时每个实际电阻都不必很大。Eliminate v_M. The R₂R₃/R₄ term produces a large effective feedback resistance without requiring a large individual resistor.

Av=−R2+R3+R2R3/R4R1

选择一组精确阻值Choose one exact set

取外接R₁′=9 kΩ，与麦克风1 kΩ内阻合成R₁=10 kΩ；选R₂=R₃=100 kΩ。所需等效反馈电阻为1 MΩ，解得R₄=12.5 kΩ。全部实际电阻均严格小于500 kΩ。Choose external R₁′=9 kΩ so the 1 kΩ microphone resistance gives R₁=10 kΩ. Set R₂=R₃=100 kΩ. The required effective feedback resistance is 1 MΩ, giving R₄=12.5 kΩ. Every actual resistor is strictly below 500 kΩ.

R1′=9kΩ, Rsi=1kΩ, R2=R3=100kΩ, R4=12.5kΩ;R2+R3+R2R3R4=100+100+800=1000kΩ

带源内阻核对输出与支路电流Verify with source resistance and branch currents

对12 mV源电压，输入电流有效值1.2 μA，麦克风端电压10.8 mV；M点反相为−0.12 V，对应输出−1.2 V。以正的源电压相量为参考，图示i₂=1.2 μA、i₄=9.6 μA、i₃=10.8 μA，M点KCL闭合。For a 12 mV source, input current is 1.2 μA rms and the microphone terminal voltage is 10.8 mV. M has signed phasor −0.12 V and output −1.2 V. Relative to a positive source phasor, the drawn currents are i₂=1.2 μA, i₄=9.6 μA, and i₃=10.8 μA, satisfying M-node KCL.

VoVi=−100010=−100;|Vo|rms=1.2V;VM=−0.12V;i2+i4=i3

一组可行设计：R₁′=9 kΩ（外接）、R_si=1 kΩ（已有），因此R₁=10 kΩ；R₂=R₃=100 kΩ，R₄=12.5 kΩ。源电压增益−100，输出1.2 V有效值；全部电阻小于500 kΩ。R₁为总串联值，不能在已有内阻之外再接一个10 kΩ电阻。One valid design is external R₁′=9 kΩ with existing R_si=1 kΩ, hence total R₁=10 kΩ; R₂=R₃=100 kΩ and R₄=12.5 kΩ. Source-voltage gain is −100 and output is 1.2 V rms; every resistor is below 500 kΩ. R₁ is the total series value, not an additional external 10 kΩ resistor.

易错点Common errors

  • 图2.3.8和图题2.3.8是两个不同电路，须读正文T型网络图。Body Figure 2.3.8 and exercise Figure 2.3.8 are different circuits; this question uses the body’s T network.
  • 源内阻1 kΩ必须与外接R₁′相加；漏掉它会改变从麦克风源电压到输出的增益。Add the 1 kΩ source resistance to external R₁′; omitting it changes gain from microphone source voltage to output.
  • 等效反馈阻值1 MΩ不是一个实际1 MΩ电阻；实际最大电阻仍为100 kΩ。The 1 MΩ effective feedback value is not a physical 1 MΩ resistor; the largest actual resistor here is 100 kΩ.
  • 有效值比等于幅值比，输入与输出都用有效值，不要额外乘√2。An rms ratio equals the amplitude ratio; both stated voltages are rms, so do not insert an extra √2.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、稳定线性负反馈；题目12 mV有效值视为源开路等效电压，R₁按题设含源内阻。未给负载，默认输出高阻测量，且供电足以支持1.2 V有效值（约1.697 V峰值）。设计解不唯一。Ideal op amp with stable linear negative feedback. The stated 12 mV rms is the Thevenin source voltage, and R₁ includes source resistance as specified. No output load is given, so measurement is high impedance; supply headroom supports 1.2 V rms (about 1.697 V peak). The design is not unique.

目视正文p29/PDF62的原图，独立求解包含1 kΩ源内阻、9 kΩ外接电阻及T网络的四节点线性方程；检查源端加载、N与M点KCL、增益−100及所有电阻上限。Visually inspect the body figure on p29/PDF62 and independently solve four-node equations including the 1 kΩ source resistance, external 9 kΩ resistor, and T network. Check source loading, N/M-node KCL, gain −100, and every resistance constraint.

平衡四电阻，让负载电压项抵消Balance four resistors to cancel the load-voltage term

题目原文Transcribed question

图题2.3.10所示电路可以将电压源v_s转换为电流源i_L，驱动线圈Z_L。为使i_L独立于Z_L，电路中设定R₂/(R₁R₃)=1/R₄。试求i_L/v_s表达式。The circuit in Fig. 2.3.10 converts source voltage v_s to current i_L to drive coil Z_L. To make i_L independent of Z_L, set R₂/(R₁R₃)=1/R₄. Derive i_L/v_s.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

v_s经R₁接反相节点，R₂从该节点反馈到运放输出v_o；同相端接负载上端v_L。输出经R₃接v_L；R₄及Z_L分别由v_L接地，i_L箭头向下。v_s connects through R₁ to the inverting node, with R₂ to output v_o. The noninverting input senses load voltage v_L. R₃ connects output to v_L; R₄ and Z_L each connect v_L to ground. i_L points downward.

本题图在书第46页／PDF第79页。The source figure is on printed p. 46 / PDF p. 79.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
不能把运放看成简单反相放大器：同相端不是地。先令v_n=v_L，最后用平衡条件消掉v_L。This is not a grounded-input inverter: its noninverting input is v_L. Set v_n=v_L and use the balance condition only after writing load KCL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

反相节点KCLInverting-node KCL

输入电流为零，先把v_o写成v_L和v_s的函数。Zero input current expresses v_o in terms of v_L and v_s.

vL−vsR1+vL−voR2=0⇒vo=(1+R2R1)vL−R2R1vs

负载节点KCLLoad-node KCL

由R₃流入的电流要分给R₄和线圈；不要把R₃电流全当作i_L。Current through R₃ splits between R₄ and the coil; it is not all load current.

iL=vo−vLR3−vLR4=(R2R1R3−1R4)vL−R2R1R3vs

代入平衡条件并检查符号Apply balance and check the sign

v_L项抵消，向下为正的电流与v_s反相。若Z_L在线性频域为有限阻抗，v_L=Z_L i_L，运放仍需提供随负载变化的v_o；“电流不依赖负载”不等于无限输出余量。The v_L term cancels. Downward-reference load current has opposite sign to v_s. For finite linear impedance Z_L, v_L=Z_L i_L, while v_o still changes with the load; load independence does not imply unlimited compliance.

iLvs=−R2R1R3=−1R4

i_L/v_s=−R₂/(R₁R₃)=−1/R₄（按原图向下的i_L参考方向）。i_L/v_s=−R₂/(R₁R₃)=−1/R₄ for the downward i_L reference in the source figure.

易错点Common errors

  • 这里有负号；若把输出电流箭头反向，才写成+1/R₄。Retain the negative sign; reversing the load-current arrow gives +1/R₄.
  • 电阻失配会留下v_L项，实际负载独立性也受运放输出余量限制。Mismatch leaves a v_L-dependent term; real compliance also limits load independence.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

用独立线性节点求解扫描多组平衡电阻、源电压和负载电阻，逐项回代原反相节点与负载节点KCL；另用复数负载检查同一传输关系。Independent linear nodal solves scan balanced resistor sets, sources and resistive loads, then substitute both original KCL equations; complex loads verify the same transfer.

双虚地电桥给出严格线性失衡信号A dual-virtual-ground bridge gives a linear imbalance signal

题目原文Transcribed question

电桥测量电路如图题2.3.11所示。试推导v_o与δ的关系式，并说明电路特点。For the bridge measurement circuit in Fig. 2.3.11, derive v_o as a function of δ and explain its characteristics.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

电桥顶端接V_REF，底端由A₁输出v_o1驱动；上两臂均R₁，下左臂R(1+δ)、下右臂R。左中点A接A₁反相端，右中点B接A₂反相端，A₂以R₂反馈；两同相端均接地。Bridge top is V_REF and bottom is driven by A₁ output v_o1. Both upper arms are R₁; lower left is R(1+δ) and lower right R. Midpoint A feeds A₁ inverting input; B feeds A₂ inverting input with R₂ feedback. Both noninverting inputs are grounded.

本题图在书第46页／PDF第79页。The source figure is on printed p. 46 / PDF p. 79.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
两个中点都是0 V，先从左臂平衡求桥底电压，再用右中点KCL求输出；不需要小δ展开。Both midpoints are held at 0 V. Left-arm KCL determines the bridge-bottom voltage; right-arm KCL determines output without a small-δ expansion.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

左中点求驱动电压Find the bridge drive from A

A₁输入不取电流，V_REF经R₁流来的电流全部经R(1+δ)流到v_o1。A₁ draws no input current, so the current from V_REF through R₁ flows through R(1+δ) to v_o1.

vA=0,VREFR1+vo1R(1+δ)=0⇒vo1=−RR1(1+δ)VREF

右中点求输出Find output from B

B也为0 V，R₂反馈电流抵消右桥臂失衡电流。B is also at 0 V; feedback through R₂ cancels the right-arm imbalance current.

VREFR1+vo1R+voR2=0⇒vo=R2R1VREFδ

说明测量特点与边界Interpret the measurement and its limits

δ=0时输出0；在理想电阻和运放模型下对相对电阻变化δ严格线性，灵敏度为V_REF R₂/R₁，结果与下臂标称R无关。代价是两运放和足够输出余量；需1+δ>0，匹配误差、偏置和饱和会破坏理想结果。Output is zero at δ=0 and exactly linear in relative resistance change δ in the ideal model. Sensitivity is V_REF R₂/R₁, independent of nominal lower-arm R. It requires two op amps and output headroom, with 1+δ>0; mismatch, offsets and clipping cause errors.

v_o=(R₂/R₁)V_REF δ；理想模型下零点平衡、对δ严格线性、灵敏度可调，且不依赖下臂标称R。v_o=(R₂/R₁)V_REF δ: balanced zero, exactly linear ideal response, adjustable sensitivity, and independence from nominal lower-arm R.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把桥底端误当地；它是A₁的可变输出。The bridge bottom is A₁’s driven output, not ground.
  • 这里的线性是反馈电桥的精确理想结果，不是普通无源电桥的小信号近似。Linearity is exact for this ideal feedback bridge, not a small-signal approximation for a passive bridge.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

逐组独立解两中点KCL，扫描δ、V_REF及不同R；核查δ=0输出为0和δ反号输出反号，并回代全部支路电流。Independent midpoint-KCL solves scan δ, V_REF and R, verifying balanced zero and sign reversal, with branch-current substitution.

先算非零同相偏置，再做输出级功率账Find the nonzero bias before the output-stage power balance

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.3.12所示，设运放的静态电流I_Q=1.5 mA。（1）当v_i=2 V时，求输出电压v_o、各支路电流和运放的耗散功率；（2）当v_i=−2 V时，再求输出电压v_o、各支路电流和运放的耗散功率。For Fig. 2.3.12 with op-amp quiescent current I_Q=1.5 mA: (1) find output voltage, all branch currents, and op-amp dissipation for v_i=2 V; (2) repeat for v_i=−2 V.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

反相输入经10 kΩ接v_i、经30 kΩ接输出；输出以2 kΩ接地。同相输入经10 kΩ接地、经140 kΩ接−15 V。运放供电±15 V。Inverting input connects through 10 kΩ to v_i and 30 kΩ to output. Output has a 2 kΩ load to ground. Noninverting input connects through 10 kΩ to ground and 140 kΩ to −15 V. Supplies are ±15 V.

本题图在书第46页／PDF第79页。The source figure is on printed p. 46 / PDF p. 79.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

带偏置的反相电路；源出/吸收输出电流；供电功率减输出功率。Biased inverting circuit; source/sink output current; supply power minus output power.
同相端不是地！10 kΩ与140 kΩ先分出−1 V。输出级的电流还包含反馈电阻电流，不能只算2 kΩ负载。The noninverting input is not grounded: the 10/140 kΩ divider sets −1 V. Output current includes the feedback branch as well as the 2 kΩ load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先求公共偏置与传输式Find the bias and transfer relation

分压支路电流为15 V/150 kΩ=0.100 mA，从地经10 kΩ、140 kΩ流向−15 V。两运放输入电流均0，v_n=v_p=−1 V。Divider current is 0.100 mA, from ground through 10 kΩ and 140 kΩ to −15 V. Both input currents are zero and v_n=v_p=−1 V.

vp=−151010+140=−1V,vo=4vp−3vi=−4−3vi

规定电流参考方向Define branch-current references

定义i_i从输入源流向反相节点，i_f从反相节点流向输出，i_L从输出流向地，i_o从运放输出端流向外部电路。Define i_i from source to inverting node, i_f from that node to output, i_L from output to ground, and i_o out of the op amp.

ii=if=vi+110kΩ,iL=vo2kΩ,io=iL−if

（1）v_i=+2 V：输出吸收电流(1) v_i=+2 V: sinking output current

输出−10 V；i_i=i_f=+0.300 mA，i_L=−5.000 mA，i_o=−5.300 mA。实际负载电流由地流向输出；输出级把5.300 mA送到−15 V电源，输出级压差5 V。Output is −10 V; i_i=i_f=+0.300 mA, i_L=−5.000 mA, i_o=−5.300 mA. Load current flows from ground toward output, and the stage sinks 5.300 mA to −15 V across a 5 V drop.

PD=30IQ+(15−|vo|)|io|=45mW+5(5.3mA)=71.5mW

（2）v_i=−2 V：输出提供电流(2) v_i=−2 V: sourcing output current

输出+2 V；i_i=i_f=−0.100 mA，i_L=+1.000 mA，i_o=+1.100 mA。输出向负载供1.000 mA、向反馈支路供0.100 mA，输出级从+15 V取电，压差13 V。Output is +2 V; i_i=i_f=−0.100 mA, i_L=+1.000 mA, i_o=+1.100 mA. Output supplies 1.000 mA to the load and 0.100 mA through feedback; its stage drops 13 V from the +15 V rail.

PD=45mW+13(1.1mA)=59.3mW

按各电源端独立核对Check independently at the supply terminals

（1）运放+轨取1.5 mA、−轨吸收6.8 mA，供电124.5 mW，输出交付53.0 mW，差71.5 mW。（2）+轨取2.6 mA、−轨吸收1.5 mA，供电61.5 mW，输出交付2.2 mW，差59.3 mW。偏置分压另耗1.5 mW，属于外部电阻，不纳入运放。(1) Op-amp rail currents are 1.5 mA from +15 V and 6.8 mA into −15 V: 124.5 mW supply minus 53.0 mW output equals 71.5 mW. (2) They are 2.6/1.5 mA: 61.5 mW minus 2.2 mW equals 59.3 mW. The bias divider separately dissipates 1.5 mW outside the op amp.

v_p=v_n=−1 V，偏置支路0.100 mA，输入端电流0。（1）v_o=−10 V，输出吸收5.300 mA，运放耗散71.5 mW；（2）v_o=+2 V，输出提供1.100 mA，运放耗散59.3 mW。各支路方向见步骤。v_p=v_n=−1 V, divider current 0.100 mA, input-pin currents zero. (1) v_o=−10 V, sinking 5.300 mA, dissipation 71.5 mW. (2) v_o=+2 V, sourcing 1.100 mA, dissipation 59.3 mW. Branch directions are defined in the steps.

易错点Common errors

  • 将同相端当0 V会把两问输出都算错。Treating the noninverting input as 0 V gives wrong outputs in both parts.
  • 运放耗散既不是负载功率，也不是总电源功率；需要扣除输出交付功率。Op-amp dissipation is neither load power nor total supply power; subtract delivered output power.
  • 电源总表若包含外部分压器，其负轨还多0.100 mA；这不是芯片自身电流。A supply measurement including the external divider adds 0.100 mA to the negative rail; it is not chip current.

核验依据Verification

理想运放输入端不取电流、在线性区，供电±15 V；I_Q=1.5 mA为每条电源的静态电流。按教材输出级供电近似：源出电流由+15 V供给、吸收电流流入−15 V，除I_Q外不加其他内部电流。外部电阻耗散不计作运放耗散。Ideal linear op amp, zero input currents, ±15 V supplies; I_Q=1.5 mA is the quiescent current in each supply rail. Use the textbook output-stage approximation: source current comes from +15 V and sink current enters −15 V, without additional internal current beyond I_Q. External resistor loss is not op-amp dissipation.

独立解反相与偏置两节点KCL，核对输出KCL；分别用输出级压降乘电流、各运放供电端输入功率减输出功率两种算法，均得71.5/59.3 mW；再以含输入源及外部电阻的全电路功率平衡复核。Independent bias/inverting KCL and output KCL. Stage voltage-drop loss and rail-power-minus-output calculations both give 71.5/59.3 mW; a whole-circuit balance including the input source and external resistors provides another check.

先定反馈电阻，再按系数分配输入电阻Choose feedback resistance, then divide by each coefficient

题目原文Transcribed question

设计一反相加法器，使其输出电压v_o=−(7v_i1+14v_i2+3.5v_i3+10v_i4)，允许使用的最大电阻值为280 kΩ，求各支路的电阻。Design an inverting summer with v_o=−(7v_i1+14v_i2+3.5v_i3+10v_i4). The largest allowed resistor is 280 kΩ. Find the branch resistances.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相加法器与虚地KCL；电阻比设计。Inverting summation and virtual-ground KCL; resistor-ratio design.
系数等于R_f/R_i，题目给的是电阻上限，解不是唯一。选择R_f=280 kΩ可得到一组便于核对的输入电阻。Each coefficient is R_f/R_i. A maximum resistance does not make the design unique; R_f=280 kΩ gives a convenient valid set.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写通用设计约束Write the design constraints

四个输入各经R_i进入反相节点，R_f从输出反馈，同相端接地。虚地KCL给加权和。Each input reaches the inverting node through R_i; R_f feeds back output, and the noninverting input is grounded. Virtual-ground KCL gives the weighted sum.

vo=−Rf∑k=14vikRk,(R1,R2,R3,R4)=Rf(17,114,13.5,110)

选取一组满足上限的阻值Select a set within the limit

取R_f=280 kΩ，各输入电阻如下；全部不大于280 kΩ。理想模型下同相端可直接接地，不额外要求偏置补偿电阻。Choose R_f=280 kΩ, giving the following input values; all satisfy the limit. The ideal noninverting input may connect directly to ground; no bias-compensation resistor is required.

Rf=280kΩ,R1=40kΩ,R2=20kΩ,R3=80kΩ,R4=28kΩ

逐输入激励核验Check one input at a time

分别只令一个输入为1 V，其余接地，输出应为−7、−14、−3.5、−10 V；这也是检查输入编号与权重是否交换的快速方法。Set each input to 1 V in turn, grounding the others: outputs must be −7, −14, −3.5 and −10 V. This quickly detects swapped input weights.

一组解：反馈R_f=280 kΩ；输入R₁=40 kΩ、R₂=20 kΩ、R₃=80 kΩ、R₄=28 kΩ。也可同比缩小整组电阻。One solution: feedback R_f=280 kΩ; inputs R₁=40 kΩ, R₂=20 kΩ, R₃=80 kΩ, R₄=28 kΩ. Uniformly smaller sets also work.

易错点Common errors

  • 权重越大，输入电阻越小，不是越大。A larger coefficient requires a smaller input resistance.
  • 系数关系不保证任意输入下都不饱和；实际输入幅值仍须满足输出范围。Correct ratios do not prevent clipping for arbitrary input levels; signals must fit the output range.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

四个独立单位输入与随机输入向量代入原虚地KCL，核对所有系数和280 kΩ上限。Four unit-input checks and random input vectors are substituted into original virtual-ground KCL; all coefficients and the 280 kΩ maximum are checked.

题目原文Transcribed question

同相输入加法电路如图题2.4.2a、b所示。（1）求图a中输出电压v_o的表达式。当R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄时，v_o应为多少？（2）求图b中输出电压v_o的表达式。当R₁=R₂=R₃时，v_o应为多少？For the noninverting summing circuits in Fig. 2.4.2: (1) derive v_o for (a), and specialize to R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄; (2) derive v_o for (b), and specialize to R₁=R₂=R₃.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

图a：v_i1、v_i2经R₁、R₂接同相端；反相端经R₃接地、R₄接输出。图b：三个输入各经R₁、R₂、R₃接同相端；输出直接反馈反相端。(a) v_i1/v_i2 reach the noninverting input through R₁/R₂; R₃ grounds the inverting node and R₄ feeds back output. (b) Three inputs reach the noninverting input through R₁/R₂/R₃, with direct output-to-inverting feedback.

本题图在书第46页／PDF第79页。The source figure is on printed p. 46 / PDF p. 79.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
同相端不取电流，但输入电阻之间仍有电流；先算加权平均，再乘闭环电压增益。The input pin draws no current, but current flows between input sources through their resistors. Compute the weighted average before multiplying by closed-loop gain.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

图a的输入平均与增益Circuit (a): weighted input and gain

同相节点KCL给两信号的电导加权平均；反相反馈的增益为1+R₄/R₃。Noninverting KCL gives a conductance-weighted average; feedback gain is 1+R₄/R₃.

vp=vi1/R1+vi2/R21/R1+1/R2,vo=(1+R4R3)R2vi1+R1vi2R1+R2

图a等值电阻Circuit (a): equal resistors

输入节点是二者平均值，闭环增益2正好抵消除以2。The input is the average, and gain 2 cancels the factor 1/2.

R1=R2=R3=R4:vo=vi1+vi2

图b为电压跟随器Circuit (b) is a follower

闭环增益1，输出直接等于三路输入的电导加权平均。Unity gain makes output equal to the three-input conductance-weighted average.

vo=vp=vi1/R1+vi2/R2+vi3/R31/R1+1/R2+1/R3;R1=R2=R3:vo=vi1+vi2+vi33

图a：v_o=(1+R₄/R₃)(R₂v_i1+R₁v_i2)/(R₁+R₂)，等值时为两输入之和。图b：电导加权平均，等值时为三输入之和的1/3。(a) v_o=(1+R₄/R₃)(R₂v_i1+R₁v_i2)/(R₁+R₂), giving the sum for equal resistors. (b) A conductance-weighted average, giving one third of the sum for equal resistors.

易错点Common errors

  • 图b没有增益3，不能直接写三路相加。Circuit (b) has no gain of 3; its output is not the unscaled sum.
  • 等值之前先写一般电导式，避免把R₁、R₂的权重写反。Write the general conductance formula first to avoid exchanging resistor weights.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

随机输入及正电阻独立解同相节点与反相节点线性方程，并核对等值特例和共同输入时的增益。Independent linear input-node solves for random sources and positive resistors, with equal-resistor and equal-input special cases.

2.4.3全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第46页／PDF第79页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 46 / PDF p. 79. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

区分差模端口与单端输入电阻Distinguish differential-port and single-ended input resistances

题目原文Transcribed question

差分放大电路如图2.4.3a所示，已知R₄/R₁=R₃/R₂，差模电压增益A_vd=10。（1）若差模输入电阻R_id=20 kΩ，且R₁=R₂，求R₁、R₂、R₃和R₄的阻值；（2）v_i2=0时，求从v_i1输入端看进去的输入电阻R_i1；（3）v_i1=0时，求从v_i2输入端看进去的输入电阻R_i2。For the differential amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.3(a), R₄/R₁=R₃/R₂ and differential gain A_vd=10. (1) With differential input resistance R_id=20 kΩ and R₁=R₂, find all four resistors. (2) With v_i2=0, find input resistance seen at v_i1. (3) With v_i1=0, find input resistance seen at v_i2.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

正文图2.4.3：v_i1经R₁接反相端，反馈R₄；v_i2经R₂接同相端，同相端经R₃接地；图b展示浮置差模测试源。Body Fig. 2.4.3: v_i1 reaches the inverting node through R₁, with R₄ feedback. v_i2 reaches the noninverting node through R₂, with R₃ to ground. Part (b) illustrates a floating differential test source.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第67页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 / PDF p. 67.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

求差电路；浮置差模端口；输入测试源法。Differential amplifier; floating differential port; input test-source method.
R_id、R_i1、R_i2是三种不同的测试连接。差模源跨两输入；单端测试则将另一输入接地。R_id, R_i1 and R_i2 correspond to different test connections: a differential source bridges both inputs, whereas single-ended tests ground the other input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

差模电阻与阻值设计Differential resistance and resistor design

浮置差模源的两端电流相等反向；由于v_n=v_p，源电压只降在R₁+R₂上。由增益10再定R₃、R₄。A floating differential source has equal opposite terminal currents. Since v_n=v_p, source voltage drops across R₁+R₂. Gain 10 then fixes R₃ and R₄.

Rid=R1+R2=20kΩ⇒R1=R2=10kΩ,R3=R4=100kΩ

v_i2接地时With v_i2 grounded

同相端为0 V，反相端虚地；输入v_i1直接看到R₁。The noninverting node and virtual inverting node are at 0 V, so v_i1 sees R₁.

Ri1=vi1vi1/R1=R1=10kΩ

v_i1接地时With v_i1 grounded

同相输入引脚不取电流，v_i2的全部输入电流经R₂与R₃串联到地；运放反馈自动调整反相节点，不会给同相支路增加引脚电流。The noninverting pin draws no current, so all v_i2 input current passes through series R₂ and R₃ to ground. Feedback adjusts the inverting node without drawing current into the noninverting pin.

Ri2=R2+R3=110kΩ

R₁=R₂=10 kΩ，R₃=R₄=100 kΩ；R_i1=10 kΩ，R_i2=110 kΩ，而浮置差模输入电阻为20 kΩ。R₁=R₂=10 kΩ, R₃=R₄=100 kΩ; R_i1=10 kΩ, R_i2=110 kΩ, while floating differential input resistance is 20 kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把R_id直接当作任一单端输入电阻。Do not use R_id as either single-ended input resistance.
  • 本题引用正文图2.4.3，不是同号图题。This exercise refers to the body figure, not a similarly numbered exercise diagram.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

分别搭建浮置两端测试源、v_i2短路、v_i1短路三组原电路节点方程，以1 V测试计算电流；独立得到50 μA、100 μA及9.090909 μA。Three independent nodal tests use a floating differential source, grounded v_i2, and grounded v_i1. A 1 V test yields 50 μA, 100 μA and 9.090909 μA respectively.

2.4.4全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第46页／PDF第79页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 46 / PDF p. 79. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

先读电桥分压，再确定求差极性Read the bridge dividers before assigning subtraction polarity

题目原文Transcribed question

电桥信号放大电路如图题2.4.4所示。（1）试写出v_o=f(δ)的表达式（δ=ΔR/R）；（2）当v_i=7.5 V、δ=0.01时，求v_A、v_B、v_AB和v_o；（3）说明A₁、A₂电路的作用。For the bridge signal amplifier in Fig. 2.4.4: (1) derive v_o=f(δ), where δ=ΔR/R; (2) find v_A, v_B, v_AB and v_o for v_i=7.5 V and δ=0.01; (3) explain the role of A₁ and A₂.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

电桥左臂上下均R，右上R(1+δ)、右下R，顶端+v_i、底端地。A₁、A₂分别跟随v_A、v_B。A₃反相输入经R₁接v_o1，反馈R₂；同相输入经R₁接v_o2、经R₂接地。Bridge left arms are both R, upper right is R(1+δ), lower right R, with +v_i at top and ground at bottom. A₁/A₂ buffer v_A/v_B. A₃ has v_o1 through R₁ to its inverting input and R₂ feedback; v_o2 reaches its noninverting input through R₁, with R₂ to ground.

本题图在书第47页／PDF第80页。The source figure is on printed p. 47 / PDF p. 80.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无负载分压；电压跟随器；匹配差分放大器。Unloaded divider; voltage follower; matched differential amplifier.
A₁、A₂隔离后，电桥按开路分压求电位。A₃放大的是v_B−v_A，因此v_o与按A减B定义的v_AB反号。Buffers leave the bridge unloaded. A₃ amplifies v_B−v_A, so output is opposite in sign to v_AB defined as v_A−v_B.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）电桥输出与总传输(1) Bridge signal and total transfer

左中点v_A=v_i/2，右中点v_B=v_i/(2+δ)。按v_AB=v_A−v_B化简，再用求差增益。v_A=v_i/2 and v_B=v_i/(2+δ). Simplify v_AB=v_A−v_B and apply differential gain.

vAB=viδ2(2+δ),vo=−R2R1viδ2(2+δ)

（2）代入给定数值(2) Substitute the specified values

R₂/R₁未给定，输出只能保留增益比，不能擅自设为1。δ=0.01使右中点略低。R₂/R₁ is not specified; retain it rather than silently setting gain to 1. δ=0.01 makes the right midpoint slightly lower.

vA=3.750000V,vB=7.52.01≈3.731343V,vAB≈18.656716mV,vo≈−18.656716R2R1mV

（3）缓冲的作用(3) Role of the buffers

A₁、A₂为电压跟随器：高输入电阻避免后级电阻网络加载电桥，低输出电阻驱动A₃；本身电压增益为1。A₃求差并按R₂/R₁放大，电阻比匹配时抑制共模电压。A₁/A₂ are unity-gain buffers with high input resistance to avoid bridge loading and low output resistance to drive A₃. A₃ subtracts and amplifies by R₂/R₁, rejecting common-mode voltage when ratios match.

小变化近似的使用Using the small-change approximation

只有|δ|远小于1时，才可将分母2(2+δ)近似为4。此题近似值18.75 mV比精确值高0.5%，数值答案采用精确式。Only for |δ|≪1 may 2(2+δ) be replaced by 4. Here 18.75 mV is 0.5% above the exact result, so numerical answers use the exact relation.

|δ|≪1:vo≈−R2R1viδ4

v_o=−(R₂/R₁)v_iδ/[2(2+δ)]；给定数值时v_A=3.75 V、v_B≈3.731343 V、v_AB≈18.656716 mV、v_o≈−18.656716(R₂/R₁) mV。A₁、A₂为隔离电桥与求差级的跟随器。v_o=−(R₂/R₁)v_iδ/[2(2+δ)]. Numerically v_A=3.75 V, v_B≈3.731343 V, v_AB≈18.656716 mV and v_o≈−18.656716(R₂/R₁) mV. A₁/A₂ buffer the bridge from the subtractor.

易错点Common errors

  • 右上臂变化，正δ令v_B降低；最终输出为负。An increase in the upper-right arm lowers v_B; output is negative for positive δ.
  • 输出数值需保留未给定的R₂/R₁。Retain the unspecified R₂/R₁ in the numerical output.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

直接解左右分压节点、两跟随器约束以及A₃两输入KCL；扫描δ及增益比并回代精确式，检查δ=0零输出。Direct solves use both divider nodes, follower constraints, and A₃ input KCL; scans of δ and gain ratio verify the exact formula and zero output at δ=0.

2.4.5指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第47页／PDF第80页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 47 / PDF p. 80. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2.4.5Assigned requirement: 2.4.5

增益可调求差电路：两个反相节点列KCLAdjustable subtractor: KCL at both inverting nodes

题目原文Transcribed question

增益可调求差电路如图题2.4.5所示，试推导函数关系v_o=f(v_1,v_2)。The adjustable-gain subtractor is shown in Fig. 2.4.5. Derive the relationship v_o = f(v_1, v_2).

A₁同相输入v₁，A₂同相输入v₂。两个反相节点之间跨接R_G。A₁反相节点经R₂接地、经R₁接A₁输出v_o1；A₂反相节点经R₁接v_o1、经R₂接最终输出v_o。A₁’s non-inverting input is v₁ and A₂’s is v₂. R_G bridges their inverting nodes. A₁’s inverting node connects through R₂ to ground and R₁ to v_o1. A₂’s inverting node connects through R₁ to v_o1 and R₂ to the final output v_o.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放虚短、虚断；节点电流法；代数消元。Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; nodal KCL; algebraic elimination.
R_G连接两个反相节点，两个运放相互关联。直接把这两个节点电位分别写成v₁、v₂，再列两条KCL，消去中间输出v_o1。R_G connects the two inverting nodes, coupling the stages. Set their potentials to v₁ and v₂, write two KCL equations, and eliminate the intermediate output v_o1.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定反相节点电位Set the inverting-node potentials

在理想负反馈下，A₁反相节点为v₁，A₂反相节点为v₂。两个输入端均不取电流。With ideal negative feedback, A₁’s inverting node is v₁ and A₂’s is v₂. Neither input draws current.

vN1=v1,vN2=v2

A₁反相节点列KCLApply KCL at A₁’s inverting node

以流出节点为正，把流向地、v_o1和v₂的三条支路电流相加为零，先解出v_o1。Taking currents leaving the node as positive, sum the branches to ground, v_o1 and v₂. Solve first for v_o1.

v1R2+v1−vo1R1+v1−v2RG=0⇒vo1=(1+R1R2)v1+R1RG(v1−v2)

A₂反相节点列KCLApply KCL at A₂’s inverting node

流向v_o1、v_o和v₁的三条支路电流之和为零，把最终输出写成v_o1的函数。Sum the currents toward v_o1, v_o and v₁ to zero, then express the final output in terms of v_o1.

v2−vo1R1+v2−voR2+v2−v1RG=0⇒vo=v2+R2R1(v2−vo1)+R2RG(v2−v1)

消去中间输出并整理Eliminate the intermediate output

代入v_o1并合并v₁、v₂的系数，可见两者系数大小相同、符号相反，输出只与差值v₂-v₁有关。Substitute v_o1 and collect the coefficients of v₁ and v₂. They have equal magnitude and opposite signs, so the output depends only on v₂ - v₁.

vo=(1+R2R1+2R2RG)(v2−v1)

v_o=[1+R₂/R₁+2R₂/R_G](v₂-v₁)。减小R_G会提高差模增益；此结论以运放保持线性为前提。v_o = [1 + R₂/R₁ + 2R₂/R_G](v₂ - v₁). Decreasing R_G increases the differential gain, provided the op amps remain linear.

易错点Common errors

  • R_G中电流为(v₁-v₂)/R_G，不是v₁/R_G；它不接地。The current in R_G is (v₁ - v₂)/R_G, not v₁/R_G; R_G is not grounded.
  • 输出对应v₂-v₁；若将差分输入定义为v₁-v₂，增益需带负号。The output is proportional to v₂ - v₁; if the differential input is defined as v₁ - v₂, the gain is negative.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

以符号消元核查两条独立节点方程；v₁=v₂时输出为0，R_G趋于无穷时退化为[1+R₂/R₁](v₂-v₁)。另取R₁=10 kΩ、R₂=20 kΩ、R_G=5 kΩ、v₁=0.1 V、v₂=0.2 V，独立解节点方程得v_o1=-0.05 V、v_o=1.1 V，代回两式残差为0。Checked by symbolic elimination of the two independent nodal equations. Equal inputs give zero output, and R_G → ∞ gives [1 + R₂/R₁](v₂ - v₁). With R₁ = 10 kΩ, R₂ = 20 kΩ, R_G = 5 kΩ, v₁ = 0.1 V and v₂ = 0.2 V, an independent nodal solve gives v_o1 = -0.05 V and v_o = 1.1 V, with zero residuals.

两级反馈先求驱动电阻上的压差Use both feedback constraints to find the drive-resistor voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

图题2.4.6所示电路可将电压v_id转换为电流i_o，驱动负载Z_L，且i_o与Z_L无关。试求i_o与v_id的函数关系。原图定义v_id=v₁−v₂，i_o由负载上端向下流向地。The circuit in Fig. 2.4.6 converts v_id to current i_o to drive Z_L independently of the load. Derive i_o(v_id). The figure defines v_id=v₁−v₂ and i_o downward through the load to ground.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

A₁反相端以两个相等R₁接v₁及v₃；同相端以两个相等R₁接v₂及v₄。A₂跟随负载电压v_o，故v₄=v_o。A₁输出v₃经R接负载上端v_o，Z_L由v_o接地，i_o向下。A₁ inverting node connects through equal R₁ to v₁ and v₃; its noninverting node connects through equal R₁ to v₂ and v₄. A₂ follows load voltage v_o, so v₄=v_o. A₁ output v₃ drives load node v_o through R; Z_L runs to ground with downward i_o.

本题图在书第47页／PDF第80页。The source figure is on printed p. 47 / PDF p. 80.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
先由A₂得到v₄=v_o，再用A₁两输入电位相等消去中点；需要的是v₃−v_o，不必先求负载电压。First use A₂ to set v₄=v_o, then equate A₁ input-node voltages. The needed quantity is v₃−v_o, not load voltage itself.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

跟随器和等阻分压Follower and equal-resistor averages

两输入节点均无引脚电流；同相和反相中点分别是对应两个端点的平均值。Zero pin currents make each midpoint the average of its two connected endpoint voltages.

v4=vo,vn1=v1+v32,vp1=v2+vo2

由虚短求R两端压差Find the voltage across R

v_n1=v_p1，整理出v₃−v_o=v₂−v₁=−v_id。Equating input nodes gives v₃−v_o=v₂−v₁=−v_id.

v1+v3=v2+vo⇒v3−vo=−vid

负载节点KCLLoad-node KCL

A₂同相端不取电流，因此R的电流全部流入负载，按向下参考方向得到负跨导。A₂ noninverting input draws no current, so all R current reaches the load. Its downward reference gives negative transconductance.

io=v3−voR=−vidR

说明负载独立的前提Explain compliance limits

R₁只需四只相等以抵消中点关系，跨导由R设定。对有限Z_L，v_o=Z_L i_o、v₃=v_o−v_id；实际两个输出都须在允许范围，不能据理想式认为能驱动任意开路负载。The four R₁ values must match; R sets transconductance. For finite Z_L, v_o=Z_L i_o and v₃=v_o−v_id. Both actual outputs must remain in range; the ideal relation does not give unlimited open-circuit compliance.

i_o=−v_id/R=−(v₁−v₂)/R，按题图向下参考方向；与Z_L及匹配的R₁数值无关。i_o=−v_id/R=−(v₁−v₂)/R for the downward reference; it is independent of Z_L and the common R₁ value.

易错点Common errors

  • 符号由v_id正负端和i_o箭头共同决定，不能只套“电压除电阻”。The sign follows both the input polarity and load-current arrow.
  • A₂输出不直接接负载；它通过R₁网络提供电压反馈。A₂ output is not connected directly to the load; it returns voltage feedback through R₁.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

独立列两输入中点KCL、A₂跟随条件和负载KCL，扫描源电压、匹配R₁和负载（含复阻抗），得到同一负跨导。Independent midpoint KCL, follower constraint and load KCL are solved for multiple inputs, matched R₁ values and loads, including complex impedances; all give the same negative transconductance.

先求同相权重，再汇总正负输入Find noninverting weights before combining all inputs

题目原文Transcribed question

加减运算电路如图题2.4.7所示，求输出电压v_o的表达式。图中R₁=40 kΩ、R₂=25 kΩ、R₃=10 kΩ、R₄=20 kΩ、R₅=30 kΩ、R₆=50 kΩ。Find v_o for the adding/subtracting circuit in Fig. 2.4.7, with R₁=40 kΩ, R₂=25 kΩ, R₃=10 kΩ, R₄=20 kΩ, R₅=30 kΩ and R₆=50 kΩ.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

v_i1、v_i2经R₁、R₂接反相端，R₆反馈。v_i3、v_i4经R₃、R₄接同相端，同相端经R₅接地。v_i1/v_i2 enter the inverting node through R₁/R₂, with R₆ feedback. v_i3/v_i4 enter the noninverting node through R₃/R₄, with R₅ to ground.

本题图在书第47页／PDF第80页。The source figure is on printed p. 47 / PDF p. 80.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
同相端还有R₅接地，所以加权平均的分母必须包括1/R₅；反相输入的存在也增加同相通路的闭环增益。Ground resistor R₅ belongs in the noninverting conductance denominator. The inverting source resistors also contribute to gain from the noninverting node.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

同相节点电导加权Noninverting conductance weighting

把接地支路视为0 V输入，所有电导都进入分母。Treat the grounded branch as a 0 V input; include every conductance in the denominator.

vp=vi3/10+vi4/201/10+1/20+1/30=611vi3+311vi4

反相节点KCLInverting-node KCL

v_n=v_p；先保留v_p再解v_o，可避免遗漏增益里的1。Use v_n=v_p and solve for v_o before substituting v_p, retaining the unity term.

vo=(1+R6R1+R6R2)vp−R6R1vi1−R6R2vi2=174vp−54vi1−2vi2

合并四个输入系数Collect the four coefficients

代入同相权重并逐路核对正负号。Substitute the noninverting weights and check each input sign.

vo=−54vi1−2vi2+5122vi3+5144vi4

v_o=−1.25v_i1−2v_i2+(51/22)v_i3+(51/44)v_i4，后两系数约2.318182、1.159091。v_o=−1.25v_i1−2v_i2+(51/22)v_i3+(51/44)v_i4; the last two coefficients are approximately 2.318182 and 1.159091.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能忽略R₅，也不能将两个同相输入各直接乘1+R₆/R₁。Do not omit R₅ or give each positive input the gain 1+R₆/R₁.
  • 第一步以kΩ为统一单位，分子分母的电导单位相消。The first equation consistently uses kΩ; conductance units cancel.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

使用与推导不同的二节点线性矩阵求解，对四个单位输入和200组随机输入检查两节点KCL及最终系数。An independent two-node matrix solve checks both KCL equations and the final coefficients for four unit inputs and 200 random input vectors.
