端点先精确设计，标称器件再核对覆盖范围Design exact endpoints, then check coverage with nominal parts

题目原文Transcribed question

仪用放大器电路如图2.4.5所示，设电路中R₄=R₃，R₁为固定电阻R′₁=1 kΩ和电位器R_P串联，若要求差模电压增益在5～400之间可调，求R₂和R_P的阻值，并选取R₂、R₃、R₄和R_P的标称阻值，要求电路中每个电阻值必须小于250 kΩ。For the instrumentation amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.5, set R₄=R₃ and let R₁ be fixed R′₁=1 kΩ in series with potentiometer R_P. Find R₂ and R_P for adjustable differential gain magnitude 5–400, then choose nominal R₂, R₃, R₄ and R_P values, each below 250 kΩ.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

正文图2.4.5是三运放仪用放大器：A₁、A₂同相输入v₁、v₂，反馈各R₂，两个反相端之间R₁；A₃用匹配R₃/R₄求差。此图不同于图题2.4.5的双运放电路。Body Fig. 2.4.5 is a three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier: A₁/A₂ take v₁/v₂ at noninverting inputs, each with R₂ feedback and R₁ between inverting nodes; A₃ subtracts with matched R₃/R₄. It differs from the two-op-amp exercise Fig. 2.4.5.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第69页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 / PDF p. 69.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

三运放仪用放大器；端点设计；标称阻值与实际调节范围。Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier; endpoint design; nominal values and adjustment coverage.
增益大小在电位器阻值最小时最大。先按两个精确端点解R₂和电位器最大有效电阻，再选标称值并重新验算，不能把四舍五入后的端点称为精确。Gain magnitude is largest at minimum potentiometer resistance. Solve exact endpoint values first, then select nominal parts and recompute the range; rounded endpoints are not exact.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用第一级KCL得增益Gain from first-stage KCL

正文图定义的输出对v₁−v₂为反相，教材的5～400指差模增益的大小。R₄=R₃使末级增益大小为1。The body figure inverts v₁−v₂, so the requested 5–400 is a gain magnitude. With R₄=R₃ the final stage has unity magnitude.

v3=v1+R2R1(v1−v2),v4=v2+R2R1(v2−v1),vo=−(v3−v4);|Avd|=1+2R21kΩ+rP

最大增益400定R₂Set R₂ using maximum gain 400

电位器有效阻值r_P=0时最大；将1+2R₂/1 kΩ设为400。Maximum gain occurs at r_P=0; set 1+2R₂/1 kΩ to 400.

R2=400−12(1kΩ)=199.5kΩ

最小增益5定最大电位器阻值Set the potentiometer maximum using gain 5

将1+399 kΩ/(1 kΩ+R_P)设为5。R₃=R₄可任取满足限制的匹配正电阻。Set 1+399 kΩ/(1 kΩ+R_P) to 5. Choose any matched positive R₃=R₄ satisfying the limit.

RP=399kΩ5−1−1kΩ=98.75kΩ

给一组常见标称阻值并验算Choose convenient nominal values and recheck

取R₂=200 kΩ、R₃=R₄=100 kΩ、电位器R_P=100 kΩ，固定R′₁仍1 kΩ。理想标称增益范围约4.960396～401，覆盖5～400；要恰好输出400和5，电位器分别调到约2.506266 Ω和99 kΩ。若要求全行程端点恰为5与400，需按199.5/98.75 kΩ校准或限位，不能直接声称标称组精确达到端点。Choose R₂=200 kΩ, matched R₃=R₄=100 kΩ and a 100 kΩ pot, keeping fixed R′₁=1 kΩ. Nominal ideal gain spans about 4.960396–401, covering 5–400. Gains 400 and 5 occur at pot settings about 2.506266 Ω and 99 kΩ. Exact full-travel endpoints require calibrated 199.5/98.75 kΩ values or travel limits; the nominal set does not have exact endpoints.

Gmin=1+400101≈4.960396,Gmax=401,rP(G)=400kΩG−1−1kΩ

器件限制与误差Component limits and tolerance

单只R₂=200 kΩ、R₃=R₄=100 kΩ、电位器100 kΩ均小于250 kΩ，R₁总阻值也最多101 kΩ。未给器件公差，标称覆盖不等于任意公差下保证；实作需测量调校并保持差分级电阻比匹配。Each 200/100/100/100 kΩ component is below 250 kΩ, and total R₁ is at most 101 kΩ. Without tolerances, nominal coverage is not a worst-case guarantee; measure and calibrate actual parts and maintain final-stage ratio matching.

精确端点设计：R₂=199.5 kΩ、R_P最大有效值98.75 kΩ。标称可取R₂=200 kΩ、R₃=R₄=100 kΩ、R_P=100 kΩ，理想可调范围约4.9604～401，覆盖目标5～400，需调校端点。Exact endpoint design: R₂=199.5 kΩ, maximum effective R_P=98.75 kΩ. A nominal set is R₂=200 kΩ, R₃=R₄=100 kΩ, R_P=100 kΩ, giving approximately 4.9604–401 and covering 5–400 with endpoint calibration.

易错点Common errors

  • 引用的是正文图2.4.5三运放结构，不是图题2.4.5。Use the three-op-amp body figure, not exercise Fig. 2.4.5.
  • 增益与电位器电阻反向变化；最大增益发生在r_P=0。Gain decreases with pot resistance; maximum gain is at r_P=0.
  • 200 kΩ/100 kΩ标称组合覆盖目标，却不是精确5～400的全行程。The 200/100 kΩ nominal set covers the target but does not have exact 5–400 full-travel endpoints.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

按原三运放图独立解四条KCL和虚短约束，检查两个精确端点、标称端点及5和400的电位器反解；所有元件上限逐项比较。Independent original-circuit KCL and equal-input constraints verify exact endpoints, nominal endpoints and inverse pot settings for gains 5/400; every component is checked against the limit.

指定要求：2.4.9Assigned requirement: 2.4.9

INA128：先区分共模电压与两端信号极性INA128: separate common-mode voltage and signal polarity

题目原文Transcribed question

INA128型仪用放大器电路如图题2.4.9所示，其中R₁是外接电阻。（1）它的输入干扰电压V_C=1 V（直流），输入信号v_i1=v_i2=0.04sin ωt V，当R₁=1 kΩ时，求出v₃、v₄、v₃-v₄和v_o的电压值；（2）当输入信号v_i1=v_i2=0.01sin ωt V，要求v_o=-6sin ωt V，求此时外接电阻R₁的阻值。The INA128 instrumentation amplifier is shown in Fig. 2.4.9, where R₁ is an external resistor. (1) Its input interference voltage is V_C = 1 V DC and its input signals are v_i1 = v_i2 = 0.04 sin(ωt) V. With R₁ = 1 kΩ, find v₃, v₄, v₃ - v₄ and v_o. (2) For v_i1 = v_i2 = 0.01 sin(ωt) V, require v_o = -6 sin(ωt) V. Find the required external resistance R₁.

共模源V_C=1 V接在两信号源中点：上端v₁=V_C+v_i1，下端v₂=V_C-v_i2。前级两个反相节点之间是外接R₁，每级反馈R₂=25 kΩ。后级匹配差分电路四个电阻均40 kΩ，上端v₃进反相支路、下端v₄进同相支路，故v_o=v₄-v₃。The 1 V common-mode source connects to the midpoint of the signal sources: v₁ = V_C + v_i1 and v₂ = V_C - v_i2. External R₁ bridges the first-stage inverting nodes; each feedback R₂ is 25 kΩ. The final matched difference amplifier uses four 40 kΩ resistors, with v₃ entering its inverting branch and v₄ its non-inverting branch, so v_o = v₄ - v₃.

本题图在书第48页／PDF第81页。The source figure is on printed p. 48 / PDF p. 81.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

共模与差模；仪用放大器前级节点分析；匹配差分放大器。Common-mode and differential-mode signals; first-stage instrumentation-amplifier nodal analysis; matched difference amplifier.
必须按图中两信号源的正负端先写v₁、v₂。虽然v_i1=v_i2，上下输入节点并不相等；它们对共模中点的方向相反。先求前级两输出，再作后级相减。First write v₁ and v₂ from the source polarities. Although v_i1 = v_i2, the two input-node voltages differ because the signals face opposite directions relative to the common-mode midpoint. Find the first-stage outputs, then apply the final subtraction.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从电压源极性写实际输入Write actual inputs from source polarities

图中上信号源上正下负，下信号源也上正下负，而V_C接它们的中点。因此v₁=V_C+v_i1，v₂=V_C-v_i2。第（1）问差模输入为0.08sin ωt V。Both signal sources have their positive terminal at the top, while V_C connects to their midpoint. Thus v₁ = V_C + v_i1 and v₂ = V_C - v_i2. In part (1), the differential input is 0.08 sin(ωt) V.

v1=1+0.04sinωt,v2=1−0.04sinωt,v1−v2=0.08sinωtV

列前级两个节点方程Write the two first-stage node equations

由虚短，反相节点A、B分别等于v₁、v₂。令R₂=25 kΩ，在两节点列KCL，解得v₃、v₄；相减得前级差模增益1+2R₂/R₁。The virtual short gives node A = v₁ and node B = v₂. With R₂ = 25 kΩ, KCL gives v₃ and v₄; their difference has gain 1 + 2R₂/R₁.

v3=v1+R2R1(v1−v2),v4=v2−R2R1(v1−v2),v3−v4=(1+2R2R1)(v1−v2)

第（1）问代入R₁=1 kΩPart (1): substitute R₁ = 1 kΩ

R₂/R₁=25，故前级输出仍包含共同的1 V直流分量，交流分量大小为2.04 V且符号相反。R₂/R₁ = 25. Both first-stage outputs retain the same 1 V DC component, while their AC components have opposite signs and amplitude 2.04 V.

v3=1+2.04sinωtV,v4=1−2.04sinωtV,v3−v4=4.08sinωtV

后级相减消除共模The final subtraction removes common mode

后级电阻比为1。v₃进入反相支路、v₄进入同相支路，所以v_o=v₄-v₃，输出的1 V直流分量消除。The final stage has matched resistor ratios of 1. Because v₃ enters the inverting branch and v₄ the non-inverting branch, v_o = v₄ - v₃, cancelling the 1 V DC component.

vo=v4−v3=−4.08sinωtV

第（2）问先算所需差模增益Part (2): find the required differential gain

两信号源幅值都为0.01 V，实际差模幅值为0.02 V。要得到6 V输出幅值，需要前级差模增益300。由1+50 kΩ/R₁=300解外接电阻。Each signal-source amplitude is 0.01 V, so the actual differential amplitude is 0.02 V. A 6 V output amplitude requires differential gain 300. Solve 1 + 50 kΩ/R₁ = 300 for the external resistor.

(1+50kΩR1)0.02=6⇒R1=50kΩ299≈167.224Ω

（1）v₃=1+2.04sin ωt V，v₄=1-2.04sin ωt V，v₃-v₄=4.08sin ωt V，v_o=-4.08sin ωt V。（2）R₁=50 kΩ/299≈167.22 Ω。(1) v₃ = 1 + 2.04 sin(ωt) V, v₄ = 1 - 2.04 sin(ωt) V, v₃ - v₄ = 4.08 sin(ωt) V, and v_o = -4.08 sin(ωt) V. (2) R₁ = 50 kΩ/299 ≈ 167.22 Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • v_i1=v_i2不代表v₁=v₂；必须看两个电压源相对中点的极性。v_i1 = v_i2 does not mean v₁ = v₂; inspect each source polarity relative to the midpoint.
  • 求外接电阻时保留增益公式中的1，不能以50 kΩ/300替代精确结果。Retain the 1 in the gain equation; 50 kΩ/300 is not the exact required resistance.
  • 题干在第47页，电路在第48页，需合并阅读。The statement is on printed p. 47 and the figure on p. 48; read them together.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

按图中25 kΩ、40 kΩ和源极性重新推导。正弦峰值处，A=1.04 V、B=0.96 V，跨R₁电流80 μA；两25 kΩ压降均2 V，得v₃=3.04 V、v₄=-1.04 V。后级非反相节点v₄/2=-0.52 V，反相节点KCL得v_o=-4.08 V。第二问代回167.2240802676 Ω得差模增益300、输出幅值6 V。Re-derived from the actual 25 kΩ and 40 kΩ resistors and source polarities. At the positive sine peak, A = 1.04 V and B = 0.96 V, giving 80 μA through R₁; each 25 kΩ feedback resistor drops 2 V, so v₃ = 3.04 V and v₄ = -1.04 V. The final non-inverting node is v₄/2 = -0.52 V, and KCL at the inverting node gives v_o = -4.08 V. Substituting 167.2240802676 Ω in part (2) gives gain 300 and output amplitude 6 V.

电阻失配：先写一般求差式，再找最坏角点Resistor mismatch: derive the general subtractor before testing corners

题目原文Transcribed question

在图2.4.5所示的仪用放大器中，已知R₁=2 kΩ，R₂=50 kΩ，R₃=30 kΩ，R₄=90 kΩ。（1）求差模电压增益A_vd；（2）如果R₃有±5%的误差，求最大共模电压增益|A_vc|和共模抑制比K_CMR。In the instrumentation amplifier of body Fig. 2.4.5, R₁=2 kΩ, R₂=50 kΩ, R₃=30 kΩ and R₄=90 kΩ. (1) Find differential gain A_vd. (2) If R₃ has ±5% tolerance, find maximum common-mode gain magnitude and CMRR.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

引用正文图2.4.5三运放仪用放大器：首级反馈各R₂，反相端之间R₁；末级两输入串联电阻各标R₃，反馈及同相接地电阻各R₄。Uses the three-op-amp body Fig. 2.4.5: first-stage feedback R₂ and a shared R₁; final-stage input resistors are both R₃, with R₄ feedback and R₄ from the noninverting node to ground.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第69页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 / PDF p. 69.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.
“R₃有±5%误差”必须说明两只R₃的关系。主结果按两只独立取±5%且其他电阻精确；共同等比例偏移不会引入电阻失配共模增益。Specify how the two R₃ errors relate. The main result uses independent ±5% tolerances with other resistors exact; identical tracking errors create no resistor-mismatch common-mode gain.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）标称差模增益(1) Nominal differential gain

以v_id=v₁−v₂为差模输入，首级差值放大51倍，末级反相3倍。若把差模输入定义反向，增益符号也反向。For v_id=v₁−v₂, the first stage multiplies the difference by 51 and the final stage inverts with magnitude 3. Reversing the differential-input definition reverses the gain sign.

Avd=−R4R3(1+2R2R1)=−3(51)=−153

不匹配末级的一般表达式General expression for the mismatched last stage

记反相输入串联电阻为r_a，同相输入串联电阻为r_b，F=90 kΩ。节点KCL给v_o=bv₄−av₃；共同输入下首级两个输出均等于v_c。Let r_a be the inverting input resistor, r_b the noninverting input resistor and F=90 kΩ. Nodal KCL gives v_o=bv₄−av₃; equal common-mode inputs make both first-stage outputs v_c.

a=Fra,b=(1+Fra)Frb+F,Avc=b−a=F(ra−rb)ra(rb+F)

两只独立误差的最坏共模角点Worst common-mode corner for independent errors

r_a、r_b各在28.5～31.5 kΩ。|A_vc|最大在r_a=28.5、r_b=31.5 kΩ；反向角点略小。Each resistor lies in 28.5–31.5 kΩ. Maximum |A_vc| occurs at r_a=28.5 and r_b=31.5 kΩ; the opposite corner is slightly smaller.

|Avc|max=90(31.5−28.5)28.5(31.5+90)≈0.07797271

用同一实际电路的差模增益求CMRRUse differential and common-mode gains of the same actual circuit

对称差模输入v₁=+v_id/2、v₂=−v_id/2，实际A_vd=−(51/2)(a+b)。比值简化后，两只误差独立时最坏CMRR在两个反向角点，均为2040。不要用一个电路的标称差模增益与另一个电路的实际共模增益混成“精确CMRR”。For symmetric differential excitation v₁=+v_id/2 and v₂=−v_id/2, actual A_vd=−(51/2)(a+b). The ratio simplifies; its worst value is 2040 at either opposite corner. A nominal differential gain divided by another circuit’s actual common-mode gain is not an exact CMRR.

KCMR=|AvdAvc|=512ra+rb+2F|ra−rb|,Kmin=2040≈66.19dB

说明其他误差解释与常用估算Other interpretations and the nominal-gain estimate

若沿用标称|A_vd|=153估算，153/0.07797271≈1962.225，约65.85 dB，应注明是标称增益估算。若只有一只R₃偏差、另一只精确，最坏|A_vc|≈0.03947368，实际最坏CMRR=4054.5（72.16 dB）。若两只R₃同幅同向变化，则A_vc=0，理想电阻模型CMRR无限；真实运放本身有限CMRR未由本题给出。Using nominal |A_vd|=153 gives the explicitly nominal estimate 1962.225, about 65.85 dB. If only one R₃ varies and the other is exact, worst |A_vc|≈0.03947368 and worst actual CMRR=4054.5 (72.16 dB). Identical tracking gives A_vc=0 and infinite ideal resistor-model CMRR; real op-amp CMRR is not specified.

（1）A_vd=−153（按v₁−v₂定义）。（2）两只R₃独立±5%时，最大|A_vc|≈0.07797271，实际最坏K_CMR=2040≈66.19 dB；用标称差模增益估算则约1962.225≈65.85 dB。误差共同跟踪或仅一只误差的结果另见步骤。(1) A_vd=−153 for v₁−v₂. (2) Independent ±5% errors give maximum |A_vc|≈0.07797271 and worst actual CMRR=2040≈66.19 dB. A nominal-differential-gain estimate is 1962.225≈65.85 dB. Tracking and single-resistor cases are explained separately.

易错点Common errors

  • 两只同标号电阻不代表误差一定同向或完全一致。Two resistors sharing a label need not have tracking errors.
  • CMRR必须说明用实际还是标称差模增益。State whether CMRR uses actual or nominal differential gain.

核验依据Verification

理想线性运放；主结果为两只R₃独立±5%，其余电阻精确；差模定义v₁−v₂，实际增益以对称差模激励测量。Ideal linear op amps; main result uses independent ±5% errors in both R₃ values with other resistors exact; differential input is v₁−v₂ with symmetric excitation for actual gain.

独立原三运放节点矩阵分别施加共同和对称差模输入，扫描两个误差的二维网格及四角点；核对同向误差A_vc=0、单只误差和同电路增益比。Independent original three-op-amp matrices are excited with common and symmetric differential inputs over a two-dimensional error grid and corners, checking tracking, single-resistor and same-circuit gain ratios.

先定抑制比，再用输出余量限制反馈增益Set suppression first, then limit feedback gain by output headroom

题目原文Transcribed question

在图2.4.6所示的心电信号放大电路中，设R₁/2=1 kΩ，R_si=120 kΩ，v_cm的最大幅值为20 V，所有运放的电源电压为±15 V，A₅的输出饱和压降为1 V。（1）求心电信号的增益；（2）若要求加到INA128输入端的共模电压是v_cm的1/800，求R₇的最大值和K的值。For the ECG amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.6, R₁/2=1 kΩ, R_si=120 kΩ, maximum v_cm amplitude is 20 V, all op-amp supplies are ±15 V, and A₅ output saturates 1 V from either rail. (1) Find ECG differential gain. (2) To reduce common-mode input at INA128 to v_cm/800, find maximum R₇ and gain K.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

A₄ buffers it; A₅ inverts with K=R₆/R₅ to produce v_oc, returned through R₇. Interference v_cm reaches the common-mode node through R_si.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.
R₁是两个1 kΩ串联的总值2 kΩ。共模环路先由KCL给抑制比，再用A₅的14 V输出边界确定最大允许K。R₁ is the total of two 1 kΩ halves, hence 2 kΩ. Common-mode KCL sets suppression, then A₅’s 14 V output boundary sets the largest K.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）差模信号增益(1) Differential signal gain

教材图2.4.6与式2.4.15给INA128的增益大小1+50 kΩ/R₁；按v_la−v_ra定义为负。共模提取点在对称差模下为0，不改变该差模增益。Body Fig. 2.4.6 and Eq. 2.4.15 give gain magnitude 1+50 kΩ/R₁; it is negative for v_la−v_ra. The common-mode sensing point is zero under symmetric differential excitation, leaving differential gain unchanged.

Av=−(1+50kΩ2kΩ)=−26

（2）建立准确的共模方程(2) Establish exact common-mode equations

同相输入不取电流，A₄输出v_ic，A₅输出v_oc=−K v_ic。对干扰/返回节点列KCL。Inputs draw no current. A₄ outputs v_ic and A₅ outputs −K v_ic. Apply KCL at the interference/return node.

vcm−vicRsi=vic−vocR7,voc=−Kvic⇒vicvcm=11+(Rsi/R7)(1+K)

用1/800和14 V输出限制求边界Use 1/800 and the 14 V output limit

最大共模输入变为20/800=0.025 V；|v_oc|=0.025K≤14，故K≤560。保持800倍抑制需R₇=R_si(1+K)/799，随K增大，因此最大值出现在K=560。Peak residual input is 20/800=0.025 V. Thus |v_oc|=0.025K≤14 gives K≤560. Suppression 800 requires R₇=R_si(1+K)/799, increasing with K, so the limiting maximum occurs at K=560.

K=560,R7,max=120kΩ561799≈84.255319kΩ

区分近似结果与实作余量Distinguish approximation and headroom

若采用正文K远大于1+R₇/R_si的近似，则R₇≈14×120 kΩ/20=84 kΩ，K≈560。精确边界84.255 kΩ保留了1+K及分母799；要保证严格在线性区，R₇、K应略小于此边界，并重新检查元件误差。The body’s large-K approximation gives R₇≈14×120 kΩ/20=84 kΩ and K≈560. Exact limiting values retain 1+K and denominator 799. Strict linear headroom requires slightly smaller R₇/K and a tolerance check.

（1）按v_la−v_ra定义，增益−26，大小26。（2）精确饱和边界K=560，R₇最大约84.2553 kΩ；教材大增益近似为R₇≈84 kΩ。实际线性设计需留输出余量。(1) Gain is −26 for v_la−v_ra, magnitude 26. (2) Exact saturation boundary: K=560 and maximum R₇≈84.2553 kΩ; large-gain approximation gives about 84 kΩ. A linear implementation needs headroom.

易错点Common errors

  • R₁/2=1 kΩ不是R₁=1 kΩ。R₁/2=1 kΩ means R₁=2 kΩ.
  • A₅可用输出峰值为14 V，而非15 V。A₅ available peak output is 14 V, not 15 V.
  • 84 kΩ来自近似；代入完整方程时应区分精确边界。84 kΩ is approximate; distinguish it from the exact full-equation boundary.

核验依据Verification

教材理想共模等效电路，忽略人体阻抗和输入偏置；K=R₆/R₅；A₅输出边界±14 V。仅为题设电路分析，非实际设备性能保证。Textbook ideal common-mode equivalent circuit, neglecting body impedance and input bias; K=R₆/R₅ and A₅ output boundary ±14 V. This analyzes the specified model and does not guarantee actual device performance.

核读正文37～38页的图2.4.6与式2.4.15、2.4.18～20；独立解共模节点与A₅虚地KCL，回代20 V输入得v_ic=25 mV、v_oc=−14 V，两端返回电流均166.458333 μA。Read body pp. 37–38, Fig. 2.4.6 and Eqs. 2.4.15, 2.4.18–20. Independent common-node and A₅ KCL give v_ic=25 mV and v_oc=−14 V at 20 V input, with matching return/source currents 166.458333 μA.

A₁、A₂跟随两个输入。A₃反相端经R₁接v_o1、经R₂接地；同相端经R₁接v_o2、经R₂接A₄输出v_o4。A₄同相端接地，反相端经R₃接其输出、经可调R₄接最终v_o。A₁/A₂ buffer both inputs. A₃ inverting node connects through R₁ to v_o1 and R₂ to ground; its noninverting node connects through R₁ to v_o2 and R₂ to A₄ output v_o4. A₄ noninverting input is grounded; its inverting node has R₃ feedback and adjustable R₄ to final v_o.

本题图在书第48页／PDF第81页。The source figure is on printed p. 48 / PDF p. 81.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.
A₃没有直接的普通反相反馈电阻；反馈经A₄反相后进入A₃同相端，整体仍是负反馈。先分别写两个中点与A₄虚地。A₃ does not use an ordinary direct inverting feedback resistor. Its feedback is inverted by A₄ before reaching A₃’s noninverting input, making the total loop negative. Write midpoint and A₄ virtual-ground constraints.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

输入缓冲和A₃反相分压Input buffers and A₃ inverting divider

A₁、A₂电压增益1；A₃反相端分压为R₂/(R₁+R₂)倍v_i1，其同相端电位相等。A₁/A₂ have unity gain. A₃ inverting input divides v_i1 by R₂/(R₁+R₂); its noninverting input has the same potential.

vo1=vi1,vo2=vi2,vn3=vp3=R2R1+R2vi1

A₃同相节点KCLA₃ noninverting-node KCL

该节点从两个源接入，解出辅助输出v_o4。The node connects to two sources; solve its KCL for auxiliary output v_o4.

vp3−vi2R1+vp3−vo4R2=0⇒vo4=R2R1(vi1−vi2)

A₄反相关系给最终增益A₄ inversion gives the final gain

A₄的输入电阻是可调R₄、反馈是R₃。由v_o4=−(R₃/R₄)v_o解v_o，结果随R₄线性变化。For A₄, the input resistor is adjustable R₄ and feedback is R₃. Invert v_o4=−(R₃/R₄)v_o to obtain an output gain linear in R₄.

voR4+vo4R3=0⇒Av=−R2R4R1R3

A_v=−R₂R₄/(R₁R₃)，电压增益随可调R₄线性变化；前提是各运放未饱和、环路稳定。A_v=−R₂R₄/(R₁R₃), linear in adjustable R₄, provided all amplifiers remain linear and the loop is stable.

易错点Common errors

  • R₄是A₄输入电阻，R₃才是A₄反馈电阻。R₄ is A₄’s input resistor; R₃ is its feedback resistor.
  • A₃同相端不是地，不能套标准反相式。A₃ noninverting input is not grounded; do not use a standard inverter formula.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立构造四个未知量v_n3、v_p3、v_o4、v_o的原节点矩阵，扫描输入及正电阻，检查虚短、两个输入节点和A₄虚地KCL。An independent original-node matrix for v_n3, v_p3, v_o4 and v_o scans inputs and positive resistors, checking equal-input and original KCL constraints.

（1）1 V阶跃(1) A 1 V step

RC=100 kΩ×2 μF=0.2 s，输出从0以−5 V/s下降。RC=100 kΩ×2 μF=0.2 s, so output starts at zero and falls at −5 V/s.

vo(t)=−1RC∫0tvi(τ)dτ=−5tV(t in s),vo(1s)=−5V

（2）首脉冲面积(2) First pulse area

新的RC=0.047 s=47 ms。0～60 ms斜率−6/47 V/ms，60 ms时到达−360/47≈−7.659574 V。New RC is 0.047 s=47 ms. From 0 to 60 ms, slope is −6/47 V/ms, reaching −360/47≈−7.659574 V.

vo(60ms)=−66047=−36047V

（2）负脉冲和完整分段式(2) Negative pulse and full piecewise result

后一个脉冲面积相反，输出以+6/47 V/ms回升，120 ms恢复0，此后输入0使输出保持0。令t_ms为以ms计的时间，见附波形。The opposite pulse reverses the slope to +6/47 V/ms, returning to zero at 120 ms and remaining there. Let t_ms denote numerical time in ms; see the plot.

vo={−647tms,0≤tms≤60647(tms−120),60<tms≤1200,tms>120V

本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。Input/output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

（1）t=1 s时v_o=−5 V。（2）0→60 ms线性降至−7.659574 V，60→120 ms线性回到0，此后保持0；完整分段式及波形见上。(1) v_o(1 s)=−5 V. (2) Fall linearly to −7.659574 V at 60 ms, rise to zero at 120 ms, then remain zero; see the piecewise expression and waveform.

易错点Common errors

  • 时间刻度是ms，必须与RC单位一致。Time is in ms; match units to RC.

Discrete nodal integration also checks continuity.

A₂是反相加法积分器，所以A₁产生的正负号还要整体反相一次。A₂ is an inverting summing integrator, so the signs from A₁ are inverted again.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

A₁通用求差式General A₁ subtractor relation

先分压求同相电位，再列反相节点KCL。First divide for the noninverting voltage, then apply inverting-node KCL.

vo1=(1+R4R1)R3R2+R3vi2−R4R1vi1

A₂电容KCL并积分A₂ capacitor KCL and integration

零初始电容电压给v_o(0)=0。输出导数等于两个输入支路电流之和的−1/C倍。Zero initial capacitor voltage gives v_o(0)=0. Output derivative is −1/C times the sum of the input branch currents.

vo(t)=1C∫0t[R4R1R5vi1(τ)−(1+R4/R1)R3(R2+R3)R5vi2(τ)−vi3(τ)R6]dτ

等值电阻化简Equal-resistor simplification

A₁输出v_i2−v_i1，积分级再反相，把符号整理为v_i1−v_i2−v_i3。A₁ gives v_i2−v_i1; integration inverts again to produce v_i1−v_i2−v_i3.

vo(t)=1RC∫0t[vi1(τ)−vi2(τ)−vi3(τ)]dτ

一般式见步骤；六电阻相等时，v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i1−v_i2−v_i3)dτ，v_o(0)=0。Use the general expression above. For equal resistors, v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i1−v_i2−v_i3)dτ with v_o(0)=0.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

v_i1经R₁接反相端，C₁从输出反馈；v_i2经R₂接同相端，C₂由同相端接地。v_i1 reaches the inverting input through R₁ with capacitor C₁ feedback. v_i2 reaches the noninverting input through R₂, with C₂ from that node to ground.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

叠加定理；RC低通；理想运放电容KCL；零初值拉普拉斯变换。Superposition; RC low-pass; op-amp capacitor KCL; zero-initial-condition Laplace transforms.
不能把同相端直接视为v_i2；它先经过RC低通。这个低通与同相闭环传输相乘后，恰好化成正积分。The noninverting node is not v_i2; it follows an RC low-pass. Multiplication by the noninverting closed-loop transfer yields a positive integrator.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）只加v_i2(1) Apply v_i2 alone

同相节点传输为1/(1+sRC)，带电容反馈的同相增益为1+1/(sRC)。二者相乘后消去1+sRC。The noninverting node has transfer 1/(1+sRC), while the closed-loop gain from that node is 1+1/(sRC). Their product cancels 1+sRC.

Vo(s)Vi2(s)=(1+1sRC)11+sRC=1sRC⇒vo(t)=1RC∫0tvi2(τ)dτ

（2）只加v_i1(2) Apply v_i1 alone

v_i2=0且C₂初压0，使同相端恒0，退化为普通反相积分器。With v_i2=0 and zero C₂ voltage, the noninverting node remains at zero, leaving an inverting integrator.

Vo(s)Vi1(s)=−1sRC⇒vo(t)=−1RC∫0tvi1(τ)dτ

（3）叠加并用时域KCL核对(3) Superpose and check with time-domain KCL

令v_p=v_n，C₂的KCL给RC·dv_p/dt=v_i2−v_p；C₁反馈给RC·dv_o/dt=RC·dv_p/dt+v_p−v_i1。相加抵消v_p，得到差分积分；两电容零初值使v_o(0)=0。C₂ KCL gives RC·dv_p/dt=v_i2−v_p. C₁ feedback gives RC·dv_o/dt=RC·dv_p/dt+v_p−v_i1. Substitution cancels v_p, yielding differential integration; both zero initial voltages imply v_o(0)=0.

vo(t)=1RC∫0t[vi2(τ)−vi1(τ)]dτ

分别为正积分v_i2、负积分v_i1；总输出v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i2−v_i1)dτ，v_o(0)=0。The two responses are positive integration of v_i2 and negative integration of v_i1; total v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i2−v_i1)dτ, with v_o(0)=0.

易错点Common errors

  • 匹配R、C和零初值是抵消成立的条件。Matched R/C values and zero initial conditions are required for the cancellation.
  • 同相端先低通，不可跳过后恰好得到错误的额外直通项。Retain the noninverting low-pass to avoid an erroneous direct-feedthrough term.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立复频域双节点KCL扫描频率与输入，核对两个单输入传输及叠加；时域两个电容微分方程直接消元确认输出导数。Independent complex-frequency two-node KCL scans verify both single-input transfers and superposition; direct elimination of the two capacitor ODEs independently verifies the output derivative.

微分电路及其输入电压波形如图题2.4.16所示，设R=10 kΩ，C=100 μF，试定量画出输出电压v_o的波形。输入0～10 s从0线性升至1 V，10～30 s保持1 V，30～40 s线性降至0，随后为0。For the differentiator and input waveform in Fig. 2.4.16, R=10 kΩ and C=100 μF. 本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

输入经C到反相端，反馈R，同相端接地；图b时间单位为秒，梯形顶端1 V、转折10、30、40 s。Input passes through C to the inverting node with R feedback and grounded noninverting input. Time is in seconds, with a 1 V trapezoid and corners at 10, 30 and 40 s.

本题图在书第49页／PDF第82页。The source figure is on printed p. 49 / PDF p. 82.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电容电流i=C·dv_i/dt；反相虚地与KCL；分段斜率。Capacitor current i=C·dv_i/dt; virtual ground and KCL; piecewise slopes.
RC=1 s。输出看输入斜率，不看输入电平；1 V平顶的输出是0，不是−1 V。RC=1 s. Output follows input slope rather than input level; a flat 1 V top gives zero output.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

时间常数与微分关系Time constant and differentiation

用统一单位计算10⁴ Ω×100×10⁻⁶ F=1 s。Consistent units give 10⁴ Ω×100×10⁻⁶ F=1 s.

vo=−RCdvidt=−1sdvidt

逐段输出Output by interval

上升段斜率+0.1 V/s，输出−0.1 V；平顶0；下降段−0.1 V/s，输出+0.1 V；此后0。Rising slope +0.1 V/s gives −0.1 V output; the flat top gives zero; falling slope −0.1 V/s gives +0.1 V; then zero.

vo(t)={−0.1V,0<t<10s0,10<t<30s+0.1V,30<t<40s0,t>40s

转折点的理想化处理Ideal behavior at corners

输入连续、只有斜率改变，所以输出是有限阶跃而非狄拉克冲激；理想导数在转折瞬间按左右极限说明，不给唯一瞬时值。真实运放转换受带宽约束。Input is continuous with slope changes, so output has finite steps rather than Dirac impulses. At corners use one-sided limits, without a unique ideal instantaneous derivative; real transitions have finite bandwidth.

本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。Input/output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

0～10 s输出−0.1 V；10～30 s为0；30～40 s为+0.1 V；之后0。转折点取单侧极限，输入连续所以无冲激。Output is −0.1 V in 0–10 s, zero in 10–30 s, +0.1 V in 30–40 s, then zero. Use one-sided limits at corners; continuous input gives no impulse.

易错点Common errors

  • C是100 μF，时间轴为s，不能改成nF或ms。C is 100 μF and time is in seconds.
  • 不要把输入斜率跳变误当输入电压跳变。A slope discontinuity is not a voltage discontinuity.

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立由每段Δv/Δt求电容电流±10 μA，再由反馈电阻乘电流得∓0.1 V；输出全时段积分反向恢复原梯形的增减量。Independent Δv/Δt gives capacitor currents ±10 μA and resistor drops ∓0.1 V; reverse integration of the output recovers the trapezoid changes.

两个极点限制微分频带Two poles bound the useful differentiation band

题目原文Transcribed question

一实用微分电路如图题2.4.17所示，它具有衰减高频噪声的作用。（1）确定电路的传递函数V_o(s)/V_i(s)；（2）若R₁=R₂=R，C₁=C₂=C，试问应当怎样限制v_i的频率，才能使电路不失去微分功能？The practical differentiator in Fig. 2.4.17 attenuates high-frequency noise. (1) Determine V_o(s)/V_i(s). (2) If R₁=R₂=R and C₁=C₂=C, what input-frequency restriction preserves differentiation?

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

输入串联R₁、C₁到反相虚地；反馈R₂与C₂并联，同相端接地。Input has series R₁/C₁ to virtual ground; feedback is parallel R₂/C₂, with the noninverting input grounded.

本题图在书第50页／PDF第83页。The source figure is on printed p. 50 / PDF p. 83.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

复阻抗；反相传输−Z_f/Z_i；低频近似与幅相误差。Complex impedance; inverting transfer −Z_f/Z_i; low-frequency approximation and magnitude/phase error.
先按串联输入、并联反馈分别写阻抗。微分要求两个分母因子都接近1；不能只要求频率低于截止而不说明远低于。Write series input and parallel feedback impedances separately. Differentiation requires both denominator factors near 1; merely being below cutoff is insufficient.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）阻抗与传递函数(1) Impedances and transfer function

理想虚地反相式给−Z_f/Z_i，零初始条件下写s域表达式。The ideal virtual-ground inverter gives −Z_f/Z_i under zero initial conditions.

Zi=R1+1sC1,Zf=R21+sR2C2,VoVi=−sR2C1(1+sR1C1)(1+sR2C2)

（2）匹配参数下的频带(2) Frequency band for matched components

R、C相等时H(s)=−sRC/(1+sRC)²。只有输入中需要微分的频率成分满足ωRC远小于1，才近似H≈−sRC。Matching gives H(s)=−sRC/(1+sRC)². Desired input-frequency components must satisfy ωRC≪1 to approximate H≈−sRC.

ωRC≪1⟺f≪12πRC;vo≈−RCdvidt

给可核查的误差尺度Quantify the approximation

令x=ωRC，实际传输与理想微分的比为1/(1+jx)²，幅度比1/(1+x²)，额外相位−2 arctan x。x=0.1时幅度低约0.99%，仍有约−11.42°相位偏差；频率上限应由允许的幅相误差决定。For x=ωRC, actual/ideal transfer is 1/(1+jx)², with magnitude 1/(1+x²) and extra phase −2 arctan x. At x=0.1 magnitude is about 0.99% low but phase error is still −11.42°; select the band from acceptable magnitude and phase errors.

高频噪声为何受到衰减Why high-frequency noise is attenuated

高频时传输衰减为1/ω，而普通理想微分器增益随ω升高；两个极点抑制高频放大，但不能在高频仍称其精确微分。At high frequency the gain decays as 1/ω, unlike the increasing gain of an ideal differentiator. Its poles suppress high-frequency amplification, at the cost of losing high-frequency differentiation.

|sRC|≫1:H(s)≈−1sRC

H(s)=−sR₂C₁/[(1+sR₁C₁)(1+sR₂C₂)]。匹配时H=−sRC/(1+sRC)²；输入需满足ωRC≪1，即f≪1/(2πRC)，具体范围取决于允许幅相误差。H(s)=−sR₂C₁/[(1+sR₁C₁)(1+sR₂C₂)]. For matched values H=−sRC/(1+sRC)²; require ωRC≪1 or f≪1/(2πRC), with the usable band determined by allowed magnitude/phase errors.

易错点Common errors

  • 两个RC分母都要保留，不能把实用微分器写成理想−sRC。Retain both RC factors; the practical differentiator is not exactly −sRC.
  • ω是rad/s，f是Hz，转换需要2π。ω is in rad/s and f in Hz; retain 2π.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立由输入支路电流和反馈支路电流KCL扫描复频率，核对传输的低频微分、高频衰减及x=0.1的幅相误差。Independent complex-frequency input/feedback branch KCL verifies low-frequency differentiation, high-frequency rolloff and magnitude/phase errors at x=0.1.

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.4.18a所示，设电容器C上的初始电压为零。（1）求v_o1、v_o2、v_o与输入电压的关系；（2）当输入电压v_i1、v_i2如图题2.4.18b所示时，试定量画出v_o的波形。图中R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄=R₂₃=100 kΩ、R₂₁=300 kΩ、C=100 μF；0～5 s内v_i1=−0.1 V，v_i2从+3 V开始每1 s在±3 V之间切换。For Fig. 2.4.18(a), capacitor C initially has zero voltage. Over 0–5 s, v_i1=−0.1 V and v_i2 alternates ±3 V every second, beginning positive.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

A₁反相增益−R₂₁/R₁；A₂输入R₂、反馈C为积分器；A₃从v_o1经R₃、v_o2经R₄求和，反馈R₂₃。图b为恒定−0.1 V及1 s间隔±3 V方波。A₁ inverts with −R₂₁/R₁; A₂ integrates through R₂/C; A₃ sums v_o1/R₃ and v_o2/R₄ with R₂₃ feedback. Figure (b) gives constant −0.1 V and an alternating ±3 V square wave at 1 s intervals.

本题图在书第50页／PDF第83页。The source figure is on printed p. 50 / PDF p. 83.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相放大；积分；求和；分段连续累计。Inverting gain; integration; summation; continuous piecewise accumulation.
每级先算中间输出，最后再做求和反相。C×R₂=10 s，所以积分斜率大小为0.3 V/s，不是3 V/s。Compute intermediate outputs before final inversion. R₂C=10 s gives integration slopes of 0.3 V/s, not 3 V/s.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）三个输出关系(1) Three output relations

A₁为−3倍；A₂零初值积分；A₃两输入权重均−1。A₁ gain is −3, A₂ integrates from zero, and A₃ has −1 weights on both inputs.

vo1=−3vi1,vo2=−110s∫0tvi2(τ)dτ,vo=−vo1−vo2=3vi1+110s∫0tvi2(τ)dτ

（2）逐段累计积分输出(2) Accumulate the integrator output

v_o1恒为+0.3 V；v_o2在每个+3 V区间以−0.3 V/s下降，在−3 V区间以+0.3 V/s上升，端点依次0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3 V。v_o1 is +0.3 V. v_o2 falls at −0.3 V/s during +3 V intervals and rises at +0.3 V/s during −3 V intervals; values at t=0…5 s are 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3 V.

最终输出及分段式Final output and piecewise waveform

v_o=−0.3−v_o2，因此最终端点依次−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0 V，连成连续三角波。时间t以秒计，只在原图0～5 s区间作答。v_o=−0.3−v_o2, giving endpoint values −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0 V, joined linearly as a continuous triangular waveform. Time t is in seconds; the result covers only the plotted 0–5 s interval.

vo(t)={−0.3+0.3(t−2k),2k≤t≤2k+1, k=0,1,2−0.3[t−(2k+1)],2k+1<t≤2k+2, k=0,1V

本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。Input/output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

v_o1=−3v_i1，v_o2=−(1/10 s)∫v_i2dτ，v_o=−v_o1−v_o2。给定输入下0～5 s输出在−0.3与0 V间线性往返，t=0、1、2、3、4、5 s处分别−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0 V。v_o1=−3v_i1, v_o2=−(1/10 s)∫v_i2dτ and v_o=−v_o1−v_o2. For the given input, output ramps between −0.3 and 0 V, with values −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0 V at t=0…5 s.

易错点Common errors

  • 积分器每段必须继承上一段末值，不能反复重置0。Carry each interval’s final value into the next; do not reset the integrator.
  • 方波先+3 V，最终输出先上升。The square wave begins at +3 V, so final output initially rises.
  • 原图只规定0～5 s，不擅自规定此后输入与输出。Do not invent input or output behavior beyond the plotted 0–5 s interval.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

先统一单位，再反解指数式Unify units, then invert the exponential

题目原文Transcribed question

在室温（300 K）情况下，若二极管的反向饱和电流为1 nA，问它的正向电流为0.5 mA时应加多大的电压？设二极管的指数模型为i_D=I_S(e^{v_D/(nV_T)}−1)，其中n=1，V_T=26 mV。At 300 K, a diode has reverse saturation current 1 nA. What voltage produces a forward current of 0.5 mA? Use i_D=I_S(exp(v_D/(nV_T))−1), n=1 and V_T=26 mV.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

指数模型；自然对数；mA与nA单位换算。Exponential model; natural logarithms; mA/nA conversion.
已知I_S和目标电流，直接反解电压；这里的比值为500000。I_S and target current are known, so invert for voltage; their ratio is 500000.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

反解并代入Invert and substitute

保留−1项，电流比使用同一单位。Retain the −1 term and use consistent current units.

VD=nVTln(1+IDIS)=0.026ln(500001)≈0.3411815V

回代检查Back-substitution

回代所得电流为0.5 mA；强正向近似只差约52 nV。Back-substitution gives 0.5 mA; dropping the −1 term changes voltage by only about 52 nV.

V_D≈0.34118 V。V_D≈0.34118 V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要将0.5 mA/1 nA错算成500。0.5 mA / 1 nA is 500000, not 500.

核验依据Verification

题给指数模型，n=1，V_T=26 mV。Given exponential model, n=1 and V_T=26 mV.

独立回代指数式得到0.500000 mA，并核对所有单位。Independent exponential back-substitution returns 0.500000 mA; units were checked.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管指数模型；热电压；自然对数。Diode exponential model; thermal voltage; natural logarithms.
先用已知工作点反求I_S；换到新电流时使用同一个I_S。电流按倍数变化对应电压按对数增加。Use the known operating point to recover I_S, then keep that same I_S for the new current. Multiplying the current produces a logarithmic voltage increase.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

选定本章室温参数Use the chapter’s room-temperature parameter

采用相邻题3.2.1给出的V_T=26 mV，且本题n=1。保留指数模型中的-1。Use V_T = 26 mV, given in adjacent exercise 3.2.1, and n = 1. Retain the -1 term in the exponential model.

ID=IS(eVD/VT−1),VT=0.026V

第（1）问：反求I_SPart (1): solve for I_S

将0.7 V、1 mA代入指数模型。反向饱和电流是模型参数，不等于当前的正向电流。Substitute 0.7 V and 1 mA into the model. Reverse saturation current is a model parameter, not the present forward current.

IS=10−3e0.7/0.026−1≈2.0298×10−15A

第（2）问：将新电流代回Part (2): substitute the new current

新电流为10 mA。由指数模型反解电压，得到约0.75987 V。The new current is 10 mA. Invert the exponential relation to obtain approximately 0.75987 V.

VD2=VTln(1+10mAIS)≈0.759867V

用电压增量快速复核Quick check from the voltage increment

因两个正向电流都远大于I_S，可以用ΔV≈V_T ln10复核，电压约增加59.87 mV。Both forward currents greatly exceed I_S, so ΔV ≈ V_T ln 10 provides a check: the voltage rises by about 59.87 mV.

ΔVD≈0.026ln10=59.867mV

采用V_T=26 mV：（1）I_S≈2.03×10⁻¹⁵ A；（2）V_D≈0.75987 V，较原来增加约59.87 mV。Using V_T = 26 mV: (1) I_S ≈ 2.03 × 10⁻¹⁵ A. (2) V_D ≈ 0.75987 V, an increase of about 59.87 mV.

易错点Common errors

  • 指数函数的电压单位必须一致，0.7/0.026不是0.7/26。Use consistent voltage units in the exponent: 0.7/0.026, not 0.7/26.
  • 热电压采用26 mV是教材近似；若取kT/q的更精细数值，I_S会有明显差别，因此必须说明参数。The textbook uses the 26 mV approximation. A more precise kT/q changes I_S noticeably, so the chosen thermal voltage must be stated.

核验依据Verification

二极管指数模型，n=1；室温热电压按教材相邻题取26 mV。Exponential diode model with n = 1; room-temperature thermal voltage is 26 mV as given in the adjacent textbook exercise.

将求得I_S分别代回0.7 V和0.759867 V，独立回算电流为1 mA和10 mA。精确含-1式与强正向近似的差异远小于所报精度。Substituting the recovered I_S at 0.7 V and 0.759867 V independently reproduces 1 mA and 10 mA. The exact -1 formula and strong-forward-bias approximation differ far below the reported precision.

3.4.1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第84页／PDF第117页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 84 / PDF p. 117. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

把导通条件写成输入门限Express conduction as an input threshold

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.1所示，电源v_s=2sinωt V，试分别使用二极管理想模型和恒压降模型（V_D=0.7 V）分析，绘出负载R_L两端的电压波形，并标出幅值。For Fig. 3.4.1 with v_s=2sinωt V, use both an ideal diode and a constant 0.7 V drop to draw the load-voltage waveform and label its peak.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

电源v_s、正向从电源接至负载的二极管D、R_L串联；输出v_L取R_L上正下负。Source v_s, diode conducting toward the load, and R_L are in series; v_L is positive at the load top.

本题图在书第84页／PDF第117页。The source figure is on printed p. 84 / PDF p. 117.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.
截止时负载电流为零，所以输出为零；导通时用源电压减正向压降。Off means zero load current and voltage; on means source voltage minus forward drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

理想模型Ideal model

正半周导通，负半周截止，输出峰值2 V。On for the positive half-cycle, off for the negative; peak is 2 V.

vL=max(0,2sinωt)V

恒压降模型Constant-drop model

只有输入超过0.7 V才导通；峰值降为1.3 V。令θ=ωt，导通区θ∈(arcsin0.35,π−arcsin0.35)再按2π周期延拓。Conduction requires input above 0.7 V; peak becomes 1.3 V. For θ=ωt, the interval is (arcsin0.35, π−arcsin0.35), repeated every 2π.

vL=max(0,2sinωt−0.7)V

2 V正弦输入：理想输出峰2 V，0.7 V模型峰1.3 V。2 V sine: ideal output peak 2 V, constant-drop peak 1.3 V.

理想半波峰值2 V；恒压降半波峰值1.3 V，导通起点约20.487°。Ideal half-wave peak 2 V; constant-drop peak 1.3 V, with turn-on at about 20.487°.

易错点Common errors

  • 截止输出是0，而不是负半周输入。Off-state output is zero, not the negative input half-cycle.

核验依据Verification

正R_L，无其他负载；分别采用理想和0.7 V恒压降模型。Positive R_L without other loading; separate ideal and 0.7 V constant-drop models.

分别枚举开路和固定压降两种二极管状态，检查支路电流非负、截止v_D≤V_D及负载KCL；峰值与门限独立计算。Enumerated open and fixed-drop states, checking nonnegative branch current, off-state v_D≤V_D and load KCL; independently checked peaks and thresholds.

3.4.2指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第84页／PDF第117页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 84 / PDF p. 117. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.2Assigned requirement: 3.4.2

电池充电：先判断导通，再找正负峰值Battery charging: check conduction, then examine both source peaks

题目原文Transcribed question

12 V电池的简化充电电路如图题3.4.2所示，用二极管理想模型分析，若v_s是振幅为24 V的正弦波，则二极管流过的峰值电流和二极管两端的最大反向电压各是多少？The simplified charging circuit for a 12 V battery is shown in Fig. 3.4.2. Using the ideal-diode model, find the diode peak current and maximum reverse voltage when v_s is sinusoidal with amplitude 24 V.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

正弦源v_s经100 Ω和向右导通的二极管接12 V电池正端；电池负端与正弦源下端相连。The sinusoidal source connects through 100 Ω and a diode conducting to the right to the positive terminal of a 12 V battery. The battery negative terminal returns to the lower source terminal.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想二极管分段模型；KVL；反向电压的定义。Piecewise ideal-diode model; KVL; definition of reverse voltage.
电池建立固定12 V门槛。正峰值决定最大充电电流，负峰值决定最大反向电压；二者发生在不同半周。The battery creates a fixed 12 V threshold. The positive source peak sets the largest charging current; the negative peak sets the largest reverse voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先判导通条件Determine the conduction condition

二极管截止时100 Ω中无电流，阳极电位为v_s，阴极电位为12 V。只有v_s>12 V才导通。When the diode is off, no current flows through 100 Ω, so its anode is at v_s and cathode at 12 V. It turns on only when v_s > 12 V.

iD={(vs−12)/100,vs>12V0,vs≤12V

正峰值求峰值电流Use the positive peak for peak current

当v_s=24 V时，理想二极管压降为零，电阻上电压为24-12=12 V。At v_s = 24 V, the ideal diode has zero drop and the resistor voltage is 24 - 12 = 12 V.

ID,pk=24−12100=0.12A=120mA

负峰值求最大反向电压Use the negative peak for maximum reverse voltage

当v_s=-24 V时二极管截止，电阻压降为零。最大反向电压为阴极减阳极，即12-(-24)。At v_s = -24 V the diode is off and the resistor drop is zero. Reverse voltage is cathode minus anode: 12 - (-24).

VR,max=12−(−24)=36V

峰值电流120 mA；最大反向电压36 V。Peak current: 120 mA. Maximum reverse voltage: 36 V.

易错点Common errors

  • 正弦源振幅是24 V，不是有效值；不再乘√2。24 V is the sinusoidal amplitude, not RMS; do not multiply it by √2.
  • 反向峰值要叠加电池电压，不能只取24 V。The reverse peak includes the battery voltage; it is not just 24 V.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；理想12 V电池。Ideal diode and ideal 12 V battery.

逐半周检查理想二极管互补条件：导通时v_AK=0且i_D≥0；截止时i_D=0且v_AK=v_s-12≤0。正峰值KVL为24=12+100×0.12；负峰值反向36 V。Checked ideal-diode complementarity in both half-cycles: on means v_AK = 0 and i_D ≥ 0; off means i_D = 0 and v_AK = v_s - 12 ≤ 0. Positive-peak KVL is 24 = 12 + 100(0.12); the negative peak gives 36 V reverse bias.

3.4.3指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第84页／PDF第117页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 84 / PDF p. 117. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.3(1)Assigned requirement: 3.4.3(1)

桥式整流：导通路径与二极管耐压Bridge rectification: current paths and reverse-voltage rating

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.3所示，电源v_s为正弦波电压。（1）二极管采用理想模型，试绘出负载R_L两端的电压波形；（2）若v_s的有效值为220 V，则二极管的最高反向工作电压值应为多少？The circuit in Fig. 3.4.3 has a sinusoidal source v_s. (1) Using ideal diodes, draw the voltage waveform across R_L. (2) If v_s has RMS value 220 V, what maximum reverse-working-voltage rating is required for each diode?

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

桥式整流器：上左D₁、上右D₂、下右D₃、下左D₄；交流源接桥的上下顶点，负载接左右顶点，右端为输出正端。Bridge rectifier: D₁ upper left, D₂ upper right, D₃ lower right, D₄ lower left. The AC source connects to the top and bottom bridge vertices; the load is between left and right vertices, with output positive at the right.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通路径；理想全波整流；正弦有效值与峰值。Diode conduction paths; ideal full-wave rectification; sinusoidal RMS and peak values.
分别沿正半周和负半周画闭合电流路径，确认负载电流方向始终相同，再检查每只截止管两端的节点电位。Trace a closed current path in each half-cycle. The load current keeps the same direction. Then inspect the two node potentials across each off diode.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

正半周：D₂、D₄导通Positive half-cycle: D₂ and D₄ conduct

v_s>0时，电流从源上端经D₂到负载正端，通过R_L后经D₄回源下端，故v_L=v_s。D₁、D₃反偏。For v_s > 0, current flows from the source upper terminal through D₂, through R_L from its positive terminal, then through D₄ back to the source lower terminal. Thus v_L = v_s; D₁ and D₃ are reverse-biased.

vs>0:vL=vs

负半周：D₃、D₁导通Negative half-cycle: D₃ and D₁ conduct

v_s<0时，源下端较高，电流经D₃、R_L、D₁回源上端。负载方向不变，故v_L=-v_s。For v_s < 0, the source lower terminal is higher. Current returns through D₃, R_L and D₁ to the upper terminal. Load direction is unchanged, so v_L = -v_s.

vs<0:vL=−vs

合并为全波整流波形Combine into the full-wave waveform

把正弦负半周翻到零线上方，峰值保持V_m，周期变为输入的一半，输出脉动频率为输入的两倍。Reflect the negative sine half-cycle above zero. The peak remains V_m, the output period is half the input period, and the ripple frequency doubles.

vs=Vmsinωt⇒vL=Vm|sinωt|

第（2）问：检查截止管反向峰值Part (2): check the off-diode reverse peak

以正半周的D₁为例，其阳极在源下端电位、阴极在源上端电位，反向电压为v_s。其他管对称。因此每管PIV为源峰值，而不是两倍源峰值。For D₁ in the positive half-cycle, the anode is at the source lower-terminal potential and cathode at the upper-terminal potential, so its reverse voltage is v_s. Symmetry applies to the others. Each diode’s PIV equals the source peak, not twice it.

VR,max=Vm=2Vs,rms=2202≈311.13V

理想桥式整流波形：灰色虚线为输入正弦，蓝绿色实线为负载输出。负半周翻到零线上方，输出峰值为V_m，输出频率为输入的两倍。Ideal bridge-rectifier waveform. Dashed gray is the sinusoidal input; solid teal is the load output. Negative half-cycles are reflected above zero, with peak V_m and twice the input frequency.

（1）v_L=|v_s|=V_m|sin ωt|，为全波整流波形；（2）每只管的最大反向电压约311 V，反向工作电压额定值须不低于该值。(1) v_L = |v_s| = V_m |sin(ωt)|, a full-wave rectified waveform. (2) Each diode sees about 311 V maximum reverse voltage; its reverse-working-voltage rating must be at least this value.

易错点Common errors

  • 桥式整流每只管的反向峰值为V_m；不要套用中心抽头全波电路的2V_m。A bridge diode sees peak reverse voltage V_m; do not substitute the 2V_m result for a center-tapped full-wave circuit.
  • 本题为理想管，不扣除两只实际硅管的导通压降。The diodes are ideal here; do not subtract the drops of two real silicon diodes.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；负载为电阻，无滤波电容。Ideal diodes with a resistive load and no filter capacitor.

按实际图上四管方向分别追踪两种导通对，并以负载电阻电流i_L=v_L/R_L≥0复核。正半周截止D₁、D₃的v_AK=-v_s≤0，负半周截止D₂、D₄的v_AK=v_s≤0，全部满足模型条件。Traced both conducting pairs using the actual diode directions. The resistor current i_L = v_L/R_L is nonnegative. In the positive half-cycle, off diodes D₁ and D₃ have v_AK = -v_s ≤ 0; in the negative half-cycle, off diodes D₂ and D₄ have v_AK = v_s ≤ 0. Every ideal-model condition is satisfied.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第84页／PDF第117页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 84 / PDF p. 117. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

桥内电流整流，运放抵消二极管影响Rectify meter current inside the feedback bridge

题目原文Transcribed question

图题3.4.4是一高输入阻抗交流电压表电路，二极管用理想模型分析，被测电压v_i=√2 V_i sinωt。（1）当v_i瞬时极性为正时，标出流过表头M的电流方向，说明哪几个二极管导通；（2）写出流过表头M的电流平均值表达式；（3）设表头满刻度平均电流为100 μA，要求V_i=1 V时满刻度，试求R；（4）若改为1 V直流电压表，满刻度时R应如何改变？Figure 3.4.4 is a high-input-impedance AC voltmeter. With ideal diodes and v_i=√2 V_i sinωt: (1) for positive instantaneous input, identify conducting diodes and meter-current direction; (2) derive average meter current; (3) find R for 100 μA full-scale average current at V_i=1 V; (4) find R for a 1 V DC full-scale range.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

同相端接v_i；反相节点v_n经R接地，也是整流桥左端，运放输出接桥右端；表头M位于桥A（上、+）与B（下、−）之间。D₄左→A，D₃右→A，D₁B→左，D₂B→右。Noninverting input is v_i. Node v_n connects through R to ground and to the bridge left terminal; op-amp output is the bridge right terminal. Meter is between upper A (+) and lower B (−). D₄ runs left→A, D₃ right→A, D₁ B→left and D₂ B→right.

本题图在书第85页／PDF第118页。The source figure is on printed p. 85 / PDF p. 118.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

同相负反馈；全波整流平均值；正弦有效值。Noninverting negative feedback; full-wave average; sinusoidal RMS.
虚短给v_n=v_i，电阻电流由v_i/R决定；桥把两个方向都转成表头A→B。Virtual short gives v_n=v_i, setting resistor current v_i/R; the bridge routes both signs through the meter A→B.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

正、负半周电流路径Current paths in both half-cycles

v_i>0：运放输出→D₃→A→M→B→D₁→v_n→R→地，D₁/D₃导通。v_i<0：地→R→v_n→D₄→A→M→B→D₂→输出，D₂/D₄导通。两种情况M均A→B。For v_i>0: output→D₃→A→M→B→D₁→v_n→R→ground; D₁/D₃ conduct. For v_i<0: ground→R→v_n→D₄→A→M→B→D₂→output; D₂/D₄ conduct. Meter current always flows A→B.

iM=|vi|R

平均电流与交流量程Average current and AC range

V_i为有效值，不是峰值。全波正弦平均值为峰值的2/π。V_i is RMS, not peak. A full-wave sine has average equal to 2/π times its peak.

IM,av=22ViπR;RAC=22π100μA≈9.00316kΩ

直流量程DC range

直流无需整流平均系数，故R增加至10 kΩ，约为原来的1.11072倍。DC requires no waveform averaging factor; increase R to 10 kΩ, about 1.11072 times the AC value.

RDC=1V100μA=10kΩ

正半周D₁、D₃导通，表头电流A→B；I平均=2√2V_i/(πR)。交流1 V量程R≈9.003 kΩ，直流1 V量程R=10 kΩ。Positive input turns on D₁/D₃, with meter current A→B. Average current is 2√2V_i/(πR). Use R≈9.003 kΩ for 1 V RMS AC and 10 kΩ for 1 V DC.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能用1 V/100 μA直接得到交流量程R。Do not use 1 V/100 μA for the RMS AC range.

核验依据Verification

理想运放在线性负反馈内；输出有足够余量推动表头；理想二极管，表头串联阻抗由反馈补偿。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback with enough output compliance; ideal diodes and meter series impedance inside the feedback loop.

按原桥四个二极管方向逐状态列KCL，正负输入分别得到两条一致电流路径；数值积分|√2sinθ|/R的整周期平均为100 μA。Original bridge directions and state KCL give the two consistent current paths. Numerical full-cycle integration of |√2sinθ|/R gives 100 μA.

3.4.5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第85页／PDF第118页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 85 / PDF p. 118. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

分半周确认反馈支路Identify the active feedback path in each half-cycle

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.5所示，运放电源±10 V，二极管导通压降0.7 V。（1）v_s=2 V时，v_A和v_o各是多少？（2）v_s=−2 V时各是多少？（3）正弦v_s振幅分别为2 V和0.5 V时，绘出相应v_A、v_o波形并标幅值。（4）若图题3.4.1中v_s振幅也为0.5 V、二极管导通压降0.7 V，则v_L波形怎样？据此说明本题电路的优点。提示：正负半周两管状态不同。For Fig. 3.4.5, op-amp supplies are ±10 V and diode drop is 0.7 V. (1) Find v_A and v_o for v_s=2 V. (2) Repeat for −2 V. (3) Draw v_A/v_o for sinusoidal amplitudes 2 V and 0.5 V, labeling peaks. (4) Compare with Fig. 3.4.1 for a 0.5 V sine and 0.7 V diode, explaining this circuit’s advantage. Hint: diode states differ between half-cycles.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

输入v_s经R到反相节点；输出v_o经R反馈至反相节点；同相端接地。D₁由反相节点指向运放输出v_A，D₂由v_A指向v_o。Input v_s reaches the inverting node through R; equal R returns v_o to that node. Noninverting input is grounded. D₁ runs from inverting node to op-amp output v_A; D₂ runs from v_A to v_o.

本题图在书第85页／PDF第118页。The source figure is on printed p. 85 / PDF p. 118.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

运放虚短/虚断；二极管状态；精密半波整流。Op-amp input conditions; diode states; precision half-wave rectification.
v_s正时走D₁反馈、输出为零；v_s负时走D₂反馈、输出反相。二极管压降由v_A承担。Positive input uses D₁ feedback with zero output; negative input uses D₂ feedback with inverted output. v_A supplies the diode drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

v_s>0与第（1）问v_s>0 and part (1)

D₁通、D₂断，v_n=0，因此v_A=−0.7 V、v_o=0；v_s=2 V同此。D₁ on, D₂ off and v_n=0 give v_A=−0.7 V and v_o=0, including v_s=2 V.

vs>0:vA=−0.7V,vo=0

v_s<0与第（2）问v_s<0 and part (2)

D₂通、D₁断，等值R给v_o=−v_s，v_A=v_o+0.7；−2 V时分别为2.7 V、2 V，均在电源余量内。D₂ on and D₁ off; equal resistors give v_o=−v_s and v_A=v_o+0.7. For −2 V, these are 2 V and 2.7 V, within supply limits.

vs<0:vo=−vs,vA=−vs+0.7

两个振幅与对比Both amplitudes and comparison

振幅V_m时，v_o= max(−V_m sinωt,0)，峰值V_m；v_A正峰值V_m+0.7、正输入半周为−0.7。故2 V输入输出峰值2 V、v_A正峰2.7 V；0.5 V输入为0.5 V、1.2 V。普通图3.4.1的0.5 V输入不够导通，v_L恒0；本题可整流小于0.7 V的信号。For amplitude V_m, output is max(−V_m sinωt,0), peaking at V_m. v_A peaks at V_m+0.7 and is −0.7 during positive input. The two cases give output peaks 2/0.5 V and v_A positive peaks 2.7/1.2 V. The ordinary 0.5 V rectifier remains off; this precision circuit rectifies signals below 0.7 V.

2 V和0.5 V输入下的恒压降模型波形；裸输出理想零交越跳变不代表真实动态。Constant-drop waveforms for 2/0.5 V inputs; ideal raw-output jumps are not real switching dynamics.

（1）v_A=−0.7 V，v_o=0；（2）v_A=2.7 V，v_o=2 V；（3）v_o为输入负半周反相，峰值分别2 V、0.5 V；v_A按上述分段式；（4）普通整流输出0，本题能对小信号精密整流。(1) v_A=−0.7 V, v_o=0. (2) v_A=2.7 V, v_o=2 V. (3) Negative input half-cycles become positive output peaks of 2/0.5 V; v_A follows the stated piecewise rule. (4) Ordinary output is zero; this circuit rectifies small signals.

易错点Common errors

  • 输出取D₂之后的v_o，不等于运放裸输出v_A。Use v_o after D₂, not the raw op-amp output v_A.
  • 零交越处理想恒压降模型不唯一限定v_A；真实转换受带宽限制。At exact zero crossing, the ideal constant-drop model does not uniquely fix v_A; real switching is bandwidth limited.

核验依据Verification

理想运放有足够带宽且处于负反馈；±10 V电源；二极管0.7 V恒压降；不把零交越的理想跳变当作真实动态。Ideal op amp with sufficient bandwidth in negative feedback, ±10 V supplies, 0.7 V diode drops; ideal zero-crossing jumps are not real transient predictions.

分别将两种状态代回反相端KCL和两管端电压，确认导通电流非负、另一管反偏；各指定峰值均小于±10 V。Substituted each state into inverting-node KCL and both diode voltages, confirming nonnegative conducting current and reverse bias of the other diode; stated peaks remain within ±10 V.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

精密整流；反相加法；实际运放带宽与转换。Precision rectification; inverting summation; real op-amp bandwidth and switching.
A₁给负半波v_o1，A₂实现−v_s−2v_o1；分别带入两种状态即可。A₁ creates negative half-wave v_o1; A₂ forms −v_s−2v_o1. Substitute the two states.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

分半周求A₁A₁ by half-cycle

v_s>0时D₂通、D₁断，v_o1=−v_s；v_s≤0时D₁通、D₂断，v_o1=0。0.7 V压降落在A₁裸输出内。For v_s>0, D₂ on and D₁ off give v_o1=−v_s. For v_s≤0, D₁ on and D₂ off give v_o1=0. The 0.7 V drop is supplied by A₁’s raw output.

vo1=−max(vs,0)

A₂求和并画理想波形A₂ sum and ideal waveforms

虚地KCL给v_o=−v_s−2v_o1，因此正负半周均为|v_s|。2 V正弦输入下，v_o1从−2到0 V，v_o为0到2 V的全波。Virtual-ground KCL yields v_o=−v_s−2v_o1, hence |v_s| for both signs. A 2 V sine gives v_o1 from −2 to 0 V and full-wave v_o from 0 to 2 V.

vs2R+vo1R+vo2R=0⇒vo=|vs|

与桥式整流比较Comparison with bridge rectification

优点：避免两只二极管正向压降导致的小信号死区，可由后级提供低输出阻抗。缺点：需供电、两只运放及匹配电阻，受输出范围、带宽和转换速度限制；桥式无需额外运放供电且适于较大功率整流。Advantages: avoids the two-diode small-signal dead zone and provides a low-impedance driven output. Costs: supplies, two op amps, matched resistors, finite output range/bandwidth/switching speed. A passive bridge needs no separate amplifier supplies and suits power rectification.

实际SPICE及模型边界Executed SPICE and model limits

已实际运行ngspice 47，使用TI官方UA741宏模型和OUP列出的EVAL 1N4148参数。1 kHz、1 V峰值的末周期输出约−0.04795到1.00156 V，零交越附近有动态尖差，最大|v_o−|v_s||约0.09030 V，不能把真实741仿真画成完美绝对值。附瞬态和直流扫描传输图；网表需从下方TI链接下载模型，去末尾Ctrl-Z并另存为同目录UA741.lib。Executed ngspice 47 with TI’s UA741 macro-model and the OUP-listed EVAL 1N4148 parameters. At 1 kHz and 1 V peak, last-cycle output spans about −0.04795 to 1.00156 V, with crossover transients and maximum |v_o−|v_s||≈0.09030 V. The real-741 simulation is not an ideal absolute value. Transient and DC-transfer plots are attached. Download the TI model below, remove its trailing Ctrl-Z and save it beside the netlist as UA741.lib.

第（2）问2 V正弦输入的理想半波及全波。Part (2): ideal half-wave and full-wave outputs for a 2 V sine.

实际DC扫描传输特性与所列简化模型对比。Executed DC transfer versus the stated simplified model.

理想v_o1=−max(v_s,0)，v_o=|v_s|；2 V输入时分别为−2～0 V、0～2 V。μA741实际仿真另见附图，保留其零交越动态误差。Ideal v_o1=−max(v_s,0), v_o=|v_s|; a 2 V input gives −2…0 V and 0…2 V respectively. Attached μA741 simulations retain crossover errors.

易错点Common errors

  • A₂输入系数为−1和−2；不能忽略v_s的直通求和支路。A₂ coefficients are −1 and −2; retain the direct v_s summing branch.
  • 静态传输与1 kHz瞬态的零交越误差不是同一个结果。DC transfer and 1 kHz transient crossover errors are distinct.

核验依据Verification

（1）～（3）理想线性运放、0.7 V二极管；（4）TI UA741宏模型及指定EVAL 1N4148参数，27°C，供电按题为±12 V；模型预测不是器件误差保证。Parts (1)–(3): ideal linear op amps and 0.7 V diodes. Part (4): TI UA741 macro-model plus specified EVAL 1N4148 parameters at 27°C, with the requested ±12 V supplies. Simulation is a model prediction, not a guaranteed device error bound.

理想门限与导通分压Ideal threshold and on-state divider

v_i≤6 V时截止，v_o=6 V。v_i>6 V时导通，两只等值电阻串联在v_i与6 V之间，v_o=(v_i+6)/2。Off for v_i≤6 V, with v_o=6 V. Above 6 V, equal series resistors divide between v_i and 6 V, giving v_o=(v_i+6)/2.

使用恒压降模型（V_D=0.7 V），重复题3.4.8第（1）问：图3.4.8a的两个电阻均200 Ω，负载支路串联+6 V电源，输入在0<t<5 ms由0线性升至10 V，绘v_o(t)。Repeat exercise 3.4.8(1) using V_D=0.7 V: both resistors in Fig. 3.4.8a are 200 Ω, the load branch includes a +6 V source, and input ramps 0→10 V over 0<t<5 ms. Draw v_o(t).

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

本题引用图3.4.8：输入经200 Ω和正向二极管到输出，输出经200 Ω到+6 V；输入为图示斜坡。Uses Fig. 3.4.8: input through 200 Ω and a forward diode to output, then 200 Ω to +6 V; input is the shown ramp.

本题图在书第86页／PDF第119页。The source figure is on printed p. 86 / PDF p. 119.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.
截止输出仍是6 V；要使阳极比阴极高0.7 V，输入须超过6.7 V。Off-state output remains 6 V; input must exceed 6.7 V to forward-bias the diode by 0.7 V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

门限和两段输出Threshold and piecewise output

2 V/ms斜率给门限时刻3.35 ms；导通电流(v_i−6−0.7)/400，输出为6+200i_D。The 2 V/ms slope gives a threshold at 3.35 ms. On-state current is (v_i−6−0.7)/400 and output is 6+200i_D.

vo=max(6,vi+5.32);vo(t)={6,tms≤3.35tms+2.65,tms>3.35V

斜坡输入：理想3 ms开通、0.7 V模型3.35 ms开通。Ramp input: ideal turn-on at 3 ms; constant-drop turn-on at 3.35 ms.

0～3.35 ms为6 V；3.35～5 ms为(t_ms+2.65)V，末值趋于7.65 V。6 V until 3.35 ms, then (t_ms+2.65)V, approaching 7.65 V at 5 ms.

易错点Common errors

  • 导通后0.7 V由整个串联回路承担，等值分压使输出比理想情况低0.35 V。The 0.7 V belongs to the series loop; equal division lowers output by 0.35 V relative to the ideal on-state.

核验依据Verification

硅二极管恒压降0.7 V；反向截止，忽略漏电及动态寄生。Silicon diode with constant 0.7 V forward drop, no reverse current or dynamic parasitics.

导通KVL：v_i−v_o−0.7=200i_D，输出支路v_o−6=200i_D；联立独立检查门限、连续性和峰值。Independent KVL equations v_i−v_o−0.7=200i_D and v_o−6=200i_D verify threshold, continuity and peak.

从被钳住的正峰求电容电压Find capacitor charge at the clamped positive peak

题目原文Transcribed question

二极管钳位电路如图题3.4.10，D为硅二极管，v_s=6sinωt V，且R_L C≫2π/ω。用恒压降模型分析，绘v_o稳态波形。For the clamper in Fig. 3.4.10, D is silicon, v_s=6sinωt V and R_L C≫2π/ω. Use a constant-drop model to draw steady-state v_o.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

输入经串联电容C到输出，R_L并接输出与地；D阳极在输出、阴极接地，钳住正峰。Input couples through series C to output, with R_L to ground. Diode anode is output and cathode is ground, clamping the positive peak.

本题图在书第86页／PDF第119页。The source figure is on printed p. 86 / PDF p. 119.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.
正峰6 V时输出被钳到0.7 V，电容左正右负充至5.3 V；余下周期近似保持。At a +6 V input peak, output clamps at +0.7 V, charging the capacitor left-to-right to +5.3 V, approximately held for the cycle.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

保持电容电压求平移Use held capacitor voltage for the shift

周期远短于放电时间常数，可忽略R_L导致的缓慢下垂；输出为原正弦向下平移5.3 V。The period is much shorter than the discharge time constant, so slow load droop is neglected; shift the sine down by 5.3 V.

vC≈6−0.7=5.3V;vo≈6sinωt−5.3V

标出两端峰值Label both extrema

正峰0.7 V，负峰−11.3 V，峰峰值仍约12 V。Maximum +0.7 V, minimum −11.3 V; peak-to-peak remains approximately 12 V.

大时间常数近似：输出−11.3至+0.7 V。Large-time-constant approximation: output −11.3…+0.7 V.

v_o≈6sinωt−5.3 V，范围−11.3～+0.7 V；这是稳态大时间常数近似。v_o≈6sinωt−5.3 V, spanning −11.3…+0.7 V under the steady-state large-time-constant approximation.

易错点Common errors

  • 此处钳正峰；不能把波形误向上平移。The positive peak is clamped; do not shift upward.

核验依据Verification

0.7 V恒压降；已达稳态，R_L C远大于周期；忽略周期内放电下垂。0.7 V drop, steady state and R_L C much larger than the period; within-cycle droop neglected.

正峰时检查D导通v_o=0.7；其余时刻v_o≤0.7满足截止；输出减输入的电压为固定−5.3 V，满足电容保持条件。At the positive peak v_o=0.7 satisfies conduction; elsewhere v_o≤0.7 is consistent with off-state operation. The constant −5.3 V output-input difference matches held capacitor charge.

先认偏置极性；空载仿真要检查周期电荷Read bias polarity; check periodic charge for an unloaded clamper

题目原文Transcribed question

钳位电路如图题3.4.11，D为硅二极管。（1）v_s=4sinωt V，用恒压降模型绘v_o稳态波形；（2）二极管用1N4148，v_s=4sin(2π×1000t) V，C=10 μF，用SPICE绘v_o(t)稳态波形。For Fig. 3.4.11 with a silicon diode: (1) use a constant-drop model for v_s=4sinωt V and draw steady-state output; (2) use 1N4148, v_s=4sin(2π×1000t) V and C=10 μF in SPICE to plot steady-state output.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

输入经C到输出；二极管阳极接+3 V偏置上端，阴极在输出，电源下端接地；原图没有负载电阻。Input couples through C to output; diode anode is at the +3 V bias source and cathode is at output. The original figure has no load resistor.

本题图在书第86页／PDF第119页。The source figure is on printed p. 86 / PDF p. 119.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

偏置钳位；电容电压连续；空载周期电荷平衡。Biased clamping; capacitor-voltage continuity; unloaded periodic charge balance.
这是下限钳位：0.7 V模型将最低输出固定在3−0.7=2.3 V。真实二极管空载时没有规定的毫安正向电流，不能强制保持0.7 V。This is a lower clamp: the 0.7 V model sets minimum output to 3−0.7=2.3 V. A real unloaded diode has no fixed milliamp forward current, so its drop need not remain 0.7 V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

恒压降稳态Constant-drop steady state

负峰v_s=−4 V时v_o=2.3 V，电容左减右为−6.3 V，所以输出为原波形上移6.3 V。At v_s=−4 V, output is 2.3 V and capacitor left-minus-right is −6.3 V, shifting the sine upward by 6.3 V.

vo≈4sinωt+6.3V;2.3≤vo≤10.3V

实际SPICE及模型边界Executed SPICE and model limits

实际1N4148空载仿真没有擅加负载。先由整周期二极管平均电流为0求周期初始电荷，再运行10周期；所得平移约6.84579 V、输出约2.84579～10.84579 V。末周期输出减输入的变化约1.88 μV，周期二极管电荷积分约4.16×10⁻¹⁵ C，确认已近周期稳态。这个结果与0.7 V近似不同，原因是实际模型的空载小电流压降不同。The executed unloaded 1N4148 simulation adds no load. Periodic initial charge is found from zero cycle-average diode current, then simulated for 10 cycles. Offset is about 6.84579 V and output about 2.84579…10.84579 V. Last-cycle output-input ripple is about 1.88 μV and integrated diode charge about 4.16×10⁻¹⁵ C, confirming near-periodic steady state. It differs from the 0.7 V approximation because the actual unloaded, low-current diode drop differs.

实际ngspice末两周期的输入与输出波形，模型条件见解析。Executed ngspice input/output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

（1）v_o≈4sinωt+6.3 V，2.3～10.3 V。（2）指定1N4148模型、原图空载的周期稳态约2.84579～10.84579 V，不能混用固定0.7 V答案。(1) v_o≈4sinωt+6.3 V, from 2.3 to 10.3 V. (2) The specified unloaded 1N4148 model has periodic output about 2.84579…10.84579 V; do not substitute the fixed-drop answer.

易错点Common errors

  • 原图没有R_L；随意加负载会改变实际二极管稳态。No R_L is drawn; an added load changes real-diode steady state.
  • 初始电容为零的前几个周期不等于稳态波形。The first cycles from zero capacitor charge are not the steady waveform.

核验依据Verification

（1）0.7 V恒压降、稳态电容保持；（2）指定EVAL 1N4148、27°C、原图空载、C=10 μF、理想输入及3 V偏置源。Part (1): held steady-state capacitor charge and 0.7 V drop. Part (2): specified EVAL 1N4148 at 27°C, original unloaded circuit, C=10 μF and ideal input/3 V sources.

恒压降式按原二极管极性检查最低输出；实际模型用独立DC I–V扫描及整周期电荷平衡求初始状态，再以瞬态周期端点、电荷积分、半步长检查。Checked constant-drop minimum against diode polarity. For the actual model, an independent DC I–V sweep and cycle charge balance determine the initial state, then transient endpoints, charge integration and a half-step check verify it.

参考模型依据Model references

  • OUP · EVAL 1N4148 parameters (PDF p.10)

3.4.12指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第86页／PDF第119页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 86 / PDF p. 119. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.12(a)(c)Assigned requirement: 3.4.12(a)(c)

理想二极管状态：先读电池极性，再试断路Ideal-diode states: read battery polarities, then test an open diode

题目原文Transcribed question

二极管电路如图题3.4.12所示，试判断图中的二极管是导通还是截止，并求出AO两端电压V_AO。设二极管是理想的。For the diode circuits in Fig. 3.4.12, determine whether each diode is on or off and find the voltage V_AO across terminals A and O. Assume ideal diodes.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

四个电路都含A到固定电位的3 kΩ电阻，O为参考点。(a)D阳极-6 V、下拉电位-12 V；(b)D阳极-15 V、下拉-12 V；(c)两个阳极分别0 V、-15 V，阴极同接A，下拉-12 V；(d)两个阴极分别0 V、-6 V，阳极同接A，电阻另一端+12 V。电池长线为正端。All four circuits have a 3 kΩ resistor from A to a fixed potential, with O as reference. (a) Anode -6 V, pull node -12 V. (b) Anode -15 V, pull node -12 V. (c) Anodes 0 V and -15 V share cathode A, with pull node -12 V. (d) Cathodes 0 V and -6 V share anode A, with resistor pull node +12 V. A battery’s longer plate is positive.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电池极性与节点电位；理想二极管开关模型；欧姆定律。Battery polarity and node potentials; ideal-diode switching model; Ohm’s law.
先把电池上端写成相对O的带符号电位，再假设管截止。若出现阳极高于阴极，则改为导通；最后确认导通电流不为负、截止管不正偏。Write the signed battery-terminal potentials relative to O. Start with the diode off; if its anode is above its cathode, turn it on. Finally check nonnegative on-current and nonpositive anode-to-cathode voltage for off diodes.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)：D导通(a): D is on

若截止，A=-12 V，阳极-6 V高于阴极，矛盾。因此D导通，A被钳位为-6 V；电阻电流2 mA从A流向-12 V。If D were off, A = -12 V, below its -6 V anode, which contradicts the off assumption. D therefore conducts and clamps A to -6 V. The resistor carries 2 mA from A toward -12 V.

VAO=−6V,ID=−6−(−12)3kΩ=2mA

(b)：D截止(b): D is off

截止时A=-12 V，阳极-15 V比阴极低3 V，反偏成立。电阻无电流，A保持-12 V。With D off, A = -12 V and the -15 V anode is 3 V below its cathode. The diode is reverse-biased, no resistor current flows, and A remains -12 V.

vAK=−15−(−12)=−3V<0,VAO=−12V

(c)：D₁导通、D₂截止(c): D₁ is on and D₂ is off

A由3 kΩ向-12 V下拉。阳极在0 V的D₁先导通，将A钳位到0 V；D₂阳极-15 V，因而反偏。D₁向电阻提供4 mA。The resistor pulls A toward -12 V. D₁, whose anode is at 0 V, conducts and clamps A to 0 V. D₂’s anode is at -15 V, so D₂ is reverse-biased. D₁ supplies 4 mA to the resistor.

VAO=0,ID1=0−(−12)3kΩ=4mA,vAK,D2=−15V

(d)：D₂导通、D₁截止(d): D₂ is on and D₁ is off

本图12 V电池长线在上，电阻将A向+12 V拉高。两个管共阳极，阴极更低的D₂（-6 V）导通，将A钳位为-6 V。D₁阴极0 V，比阳极高6 V而截止。The 12 V battery has its longer plate on top, so the resistor pulls A toward +12 V. With common anodes, D₂’s lower cathode potential (-6 V) makes D₂ conduct and clamp A to -6 V. D₁’s 0 V cathode is 6 V above its anode, so D₁ is off.

VAO=−6V,ID2=12−(−6)3kΩ=6mA,vAK,D1=−6V

(a)D导通，V_AO=-6 V；(b)D截止，V_AO=-12 V；(c)D₁导通、D₂截止，V_AO=0 V；(d)D₁截止、D₂导通，V_AO=-6 V。(a) D on, V_AO = -6 V. (b) D off, V_AO = -12 V. (c) D₁ on and D₂ off, V_AO = 0 V. (d) D₁ off and D₂ on, V_AO = -6 V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能按电池旁“6 V、12 V”字样直接把上端写成正电位，要看长短线。Do not assume a battery upper terminal is positive from its 6 V or 12 V label; inspect the plate lengths.
  • 两管共同接输出时，必须同时检查另一只管的反偏条件。When two diodes share the output, also check that the other diode remains reverse-biased.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；按原图电池极性确定各节点。Ideal diodes with battery polarities read from the original figure.

对所有四图逐项检查互补条件。导通管电流分别为2、4、6 mA，均沿阳极到阴极且为正；截止管v_AK分别为(b)-3 V、(c)D₂的-15 V、(d)D₁的-6 V。各电阻欧姆定律和节点KCL同时成立。Checked complementarity for all four circuits. On-currents are 2, 4 and 6 mA, positive from anode to cathode. Off-diode v_AK values are -3 V in (b), -15 V for D₂ in (c), and -6 V for D₁ in (d). Resistor Ohm’s law and nodal KCL both hold.

3.4.13指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第87页／PDF第120页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 87 / PDF p. 120. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.13(a)(b)Assigned requirement: 3.4.13(a)(b)

浮动电源分压网络：用开路电位判二极管状态Floating-source divider: determine diode state from open-circuit potentials

题目原文Transcribed question

试判断图题3.4.13中二极管是导通还是截止，为什么？设二极管是理想的。Determine whether the diode in each circuit of Fig. 3.4.13 is on or off, and explain why. Assume ideal diodes.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

三图D的阳极在右侧A、阴极在左侧B。右分压为15 V经140 kΩ和10 kΩ到地。左主分压为15 V经25 kΩ和5 kΩ到地，记其节点为C。(a)(b)10 V源接18 kΩ、2 kΩ串联，底端接C，B在两电阻之间；两图电源极性相反。(c)20 V源上正下负，C在18 kΩ和2 kΩ之间，B在源下端。In all three figures, D has anode A on the right and cathode B on the left. The right divider is 140 kΩ and 10 kΩ from 15 V to ground. The left main divider is 25 kΩ and 5 kΩ; call its midpoint C. In (a) and (b), a floating 10 V source drives series 18 kΩ and 2 kΩ, with its lower terminal tied to C and B between the resistors; the source polarity reverses between figures. In (c), the 20 V source is positive on top, C lies between 18 kΩ and 2 kΩ, and B is the source lower terminal.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

浮动电压源；电阻分压；理想二极管；戴维南等效与节点分析。Floating voltage sources; resistor division; ideal diodes; Thévenin equivalents and nodal analysis.
先把二极管断开，比较A、B的开路电位。独立的浮动电源回路只经一个节点接主网络时，不向该节点净取流，不能把它当作对地分压器。First open the diode and compare A and B potentials. A floating source loop connected to the main network at only one node draws zero net current from that node; do not treat it as a divider to ground.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先求两个主分压节点Find the two main divider potentials

D开路时，右节点A=15×10/(140+10)=1 V。左25 kΩ、5 kΩ分压节点C=15×5/(25+5)=2.5 V。With D open, A = 15(10)/(140 + 10) = 1 V. The 25 kΩ/5 kΩ main divider gives C = 15(5)/(25 + 5) = 2.5 V.

VA0=1V,VC0=2.5V

(a)：B高于A，截止(a): B is above A, so D is off

10 V源上正下负，2 kΩ上的分压为+1 V，故B=C+1=3.5 V。D阳极A=1 V、阴极B=3.5 V，反偏2.5 V。The 10 V source is positive on top; the 2 kΩ divider drop is +1 V, so B = C + 1 = 3.5 V. With anode A = 1 V and cathode B = 3.5 V, D is reverse-biased by 2.5 V.

VB0=2.5+10218+2=3.5V,vAK=−2.5V<0

(b)：电源反向后仍截止(b): reversing the source still leaves D off

10 V源反向，故B=C-1=1.5 V。A仍为1 V，阳极仍低于阴极0.5 V，因此截止。Reversing the 10 V source gives B = C - 1 = 1.5 V. A remains 1 V, still 0.5 V below the cathode, so D is off.

VB0=2.5−10218+2=1.5V,vAK=−0.5V<0

(c)：开路试算出现正偏，必须导通(c): the open-circuit test gives forward bias

20 V源使C比B高20×2/(18+2)=2 V，故开路B=2.5-2=0.5 V。A=1 V高于B，截止假设矛盾，D应导通。导通后节点会相互加载，不能继续把A固定为1 V、B固定为0.5 V。The 20 V source puts C 20(2)/(18 + 2) = 2 V above B, giving open-circuit B = 2.5 - 2 = 0.5 V. A = 1 V is above B, contradicting the off assumption; D must conduct. Once on, the dividers load each other, so A and B no longer retain their open-circuit values.

VA0−VB0=1−0.5=0.5V>0

独立检查(c)导通电流方向Independently check the on-current in (c)

将两侧从A、B看入作戴维南等效。右侧电阻140 kΩ∥10 kΩ=28/3 kΩ；左侧电阻(25 kΩ∥5 kΩ)+(18 kΩ∥2 kΩ)=179/30 kΩ。短接A、B后电流从A到B为32.68 μA，正向成立。Find the Thévenin resistance seen from each side. On the right, 140 kΩ ∥ 10 kΩ = 28/3 kΩ. On the left, (25 kΩ ∥ 5 kΩ) + (18 kΩ ∥ 2 kΩ) = 179/30 kΩ. Shorting A to B produces 32.68 μA from A to B, confirming forward conduction.

ID=1−0.5(28/3+179/30)kΩ=130600A≈32.68μA,VA=VB=319459V≈0.69499V

(a)截止：V_A=1 V、V_B=3.5 V；(b)截止：V_A=1 V、V_B=1.5 V；(c)导通：开路试算V_A=1 V>V_B=0.5 V，实际导通电流约32.68 μA（A→B）。(a) Off: V_A = 1 V and V_B = 3.5 V. (b) Off: V_A = 1 V and V_B = 1.5 V. (c) On: the open-circuit test gives V_A = 1 V > V_B = 0.5 V; the actual forward current is about 32.68 μA from A to B.

易错点Common errors

  • D的阴极横线在左，阳极A在右；方向看反会把三图结论全部颠倒。The cathode bar is on the left and anode A on the right; reversing this interpretation reverses every conclusion.
  • 图(c)导通后的电位不能沿用开路试算值。In (c), do not keep the open-circuit node voltages after D turns on.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；15 V电源和浮动电源均理想。Ideal diode, ideal 15 V supply and ideal floating sources.

(a)(b)使用含浮动电源的修正节点方程独立求解，结果分别A=1、B=3.5和A=1、B=1.5 V。(c)通过节点方程与戴维南法两种方法得到同一ID=1/30600 A、A=B=319/459 V、C=1210/459 V，二极管正向电流为正。Independently solved modified nodal equations including the floating source for (a) and (b), obtaining A = 1, B = 3.5 V and A = 1, B = 1.5 V. For (c), nodal and Thévenin methods both give I_D = 1/30600 A, A = B = 319/459 V and C = 1210/459 V, with positive forward diode current.

3.4.14指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第87页／PDF第120页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 87 / PDF p. 120. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.14Assigned requirement: 3.4.14

带直流偏置的二极管：先静态，后小信号Biased diode: solve DC first, then the small signal

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.14所示，D为硅二极管，V_DD=2 V，R=1 kΩ，正弦信号v_s=50sin(2π×50t) mV。（1）静态（即v_s=0）时，求二极管中的静态电流和v_o的静态电压；（2）动态时，求二极管中的交流电流振幅和v_o的交流电压振幅；（3）求输出电压v_o的总量。In Fig. 3.4.14, D is a silicon diode, V_DD = 2 V, R = 1 kΩ, and v_s = 50 sin(2π × 50t) mV. (1) With v_s = 0, find the diode DC current and the DC output voltage. (2) Find the AC current amplitude through the diode and the AC output-voltage amplitude. (3) Find the total output voltage v_o.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

2 V直流源与v_s同向串联，驱动向右导通的二极管及1 kΩ接地电阻。v_o上正下负，测的是电阻两端电压。The 2 V DC source and v_s are connected in series with matching polarity, driving a diode conducting to the right and a 1 kΩ resistor to ground. Output v_o is measured across the resistor, positive at the top.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

静态工作点；二极管恒压降模型和小信号电阻；直流与交流叠加。DC operating point; constant-drop and small-signal diode models; DC-plus-AC superposition.
先用0.7 V硅管近似求Q点，再以r_d=V_T/I_DQ代替交流二极管。输出跨电阻，交流分压应取R/(R+r_d)。First find the Q point with the 0.7 V silicon approximation, then replace the diode by r_d = V_T/I_DQ for AC. Because the output is across R, the AC divider factor is R/(R + r_d).
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

第（1）问：先求静态量Part (1): find the DC quantities

采用硅二极管正向压降约0.7 V，静态时电阻分得2-0.7=1.3 V，串联电流为1.3 mA。Using a silicon forward drop of approximately 0.7 V, the resistor DC voltage is 2 - 0.7 = 1.3 V and the series current is 1.3 mA.

IDQ≈2−0.71kΩ=1.3mA,VOQ=IDQR≈1.3V

建立交流小信号电阻Find the AC small-signal resistance

采用本章室温V_T=26 mV、n=1，得r_d=26 mV/1.3 mA=20 Ω。交流等效中独立直流电压源短路，输入驱动r_d与R串联。Using the chapter’s room-temperature V_T = 26 mV and n = 1 gives r_d = 26 mV/1.3 mA = 20 Ω. In the AC equivalent, the independent DC voltage source is shorted and the signal drives r_d in series with R.

rd≈nVTIDQ=20Ω

第（2）问：求交流振幅Part (2): find the AC amplitudes

输入峰值50 mV，故交流电流峰值为50 mV/(1000+20) Ω，输出峰值为其乘1 kΩ。The input peak is 50 mV, so the AC current amplitude is 50 mV/(1000 + 20) Ω. Multiply by 1 kΩ for the output amplitude.

Im≈0.0501020=49.0196μA,Vom=RIm≈49.0196mV

第（3）问：静态与交流相加Part (3): add DC and AC

交流电流与输入同相，输出也同相。把1.3 V静态值与约49.02 mV的50 Hz正弦量相加。The AC current and output are in phase with the input. Add the 1.3 V DC value to the approximately 49.02 mV, 50 Hz sinusoidal component.

vo(t)≈1.3+0.0490196sin(100πt)V

检查小信号和持续导通条件Check small-signal validity and continuous conduction

二极管上的交流峰值仅r_d I_m≈0.9804 mV，远小于26 mV；最小总电流约1.3-0.04902=1.25098 mA>0，二极管整个周期都保持正向导通。The diode AC-voltage amplitude is only r_d I_m ≈ 0.9804 mV, much smaller than 26 mV. Minimum total current is about 1.3 - 0.04902 = 1.25098 mA > 0, so the diode remains forward-conducting throughout the cycle.

vd,m≈0.9804mV≪26mV,ID,min>0

按V_DQ≈0.7 V、V_T=26 mV、n=1：（1）I_DQ≈1.3 mA，V_OQ≈1.3 V；（2）I_m≈49.02 μA，V_om≈49.02 mV；（3）v_o≈1.3+0.04902sin(100πt) V。以上交流结果为一阶小信号近似。Using V_DQ ≈ 0.7 V, V_T = 26 mV and n = 1: (1) I_DQ ≈ 1.3 mA and V_OQ ≈ 1.3 V. (2) I_m ≈ 49.02 μA and V_om ≈ 49.02 mV. (3) v_o ≈ 1.3 + 0.04902 sin(100πt) V. AC results are first-order small-signal approximations.

易错点Common errors

  • v_o跨1 kΩ电阻，不是跨二极管；两者交流振幅分别约49.02 mV和0.9804 mV。v_o is across the 1 kΩ resistor, not the diode. Their AC amplitudes are approximately 49.02 mV and 0.9804 mV, respectively.
  • 不能把直流压降0.7 V模型原封不动用于交流，否则无法给出本题的小信号电阻影响。Do not use the fixed 0.7 V drop unchanged for AC; it omits the small-signal resistance requested here.

核验依据Verification

静态采用硅管0.7 V近似；交流采用n=1、室温V_T=26 mV的小信号模型。题目没有给出器件I_S，不能把近似结果宣称为某实际器件的精确指数解。DC uses the 0.7 V silicon approximation; AC uses n = 1 and room-temperature V_T = 26 mV. The exercise does not specify device I_S, so these approximate results are not claimed as an exact exponential solution for a particular real device.

交流KVL独立核对：(R+r_d)I_m=50 mV，R I_m+r_d I_m=49.0196+0.9804=50 mV。以Q点校准指数模型，数值解正负输入峰值的非线性串联方程，确认输出与一阶近似的误差小于0.020 mV，且始终正向导通。Independent AC KVL gives (R + r_d)I_m = 50 mV, with R I_m + r_d I_m = 49.0196 + 0.9804 = 50 mV. Calibrating an exponential model at the Q point and solving the nonlinear series equation at both input peaks confirms an output error below 0.020 mV from the first-order approximation and continuous forward conduction.

题目原文Transcribed question

低压稳压电路如图题3.4.15，V_DD=(10±1)V，R=1 kΩ，三只硅二极管串联接地。（1）用恒压降模型求I_D、V_O（V_D=0.7 V）；（2）室温300 K，利用小信号模型求V_O变化范围。For Fig. 3.4.15, V_DD=(10±1)V, R=1 kΩ and three series silicon diodes to ground. (1) Find I_D and V_O using 0.7 V diode drops. (2) At 300 K, use the small-signal model to find output range.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

V_DD经1 kΩ到输出，输出经三只同向串联二极管接地。无外接负载。V_DD reaches output through 1 kΩ; three forward series diodes connect output to ground. There is no external load.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第120页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 / PDF p. 120.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.
三管静态输出约2.1 V，偏置电流为7.9 mA。用各管r_d=26 mV/I_D，再把三个r_d串联。The three-diode DC output is about 2.1 V. Bias current is 7.9 mA. Use r_d=26 mV/I_D for each, then series-connect the three.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

静态偏置DC bias

恒压降近似给V_OQ=3×0.7=2.1 V。I_DQ=(10−2.1)/1k=7.9 mA。Constant-drop approximation gives V_OQ=2.1 V. I_DQ=(10−2.1)/1k=7.9 mA.

VOQ=2.1V;IDQ=7.9mA

增量等效和变化范围Incremental equivalent and range

每管r_d≈3.291139 Ω，三管总计9.873418 Ω。供电±1 V通过1 kΩ与输出等效电阻分压。Each diode has r_d≈3.291139 Ω, total 9.873418 Ω. The ±1 V supply change divides between 1 kΩ and the incremental shunt.

ΔVO=rshunt1000+rshuntΔVDD≈±9.776886mV

小信号一阶近似：V_O≈2.1 V±9.776886 mV，即2.090223～2.109777 V。First-order small-signal approximation: V_O≈2.1 V±9.776886 mV, or 2.090223…2.109777 V.

易错点Common errors

  • r_d由每只二极管的静态电流决定，不是总供电电流。r_d uses each diode’s bias current, not total supply current.
  • 这是围绕静态点的线性化范围，不是指数模型大信号精确端点。This range is linearized around bias, not exact large-signal exponential endpoints.

核验依据Verification

静态每管0.7 V；小信号n=1、V_T=26 mV，围绕10 V供电线性化；不包含温漂及器件离散性。DC drop 0.7 V per diode; small-signal n=1 and V_T=26 mV, linearized at 10 V supply; temperature drift and device spread excluded.

独立线性化原节点KCL，求输出对供电的导数；有负载时同时保留R_L项，所得导数与小信号分压一致。Independently differentiated original node KCL with respect to supply, retaining the load term where present; sensitivity agrees with incremental division.
