把最差输入端点化为两个联立约束Turn supply extremes into coupled constraints

题目原文Transcribed question

低压稳压电路如图题3.4.17，5 V≤V_I≤10 V；保证二极管正向压降0.7 V的最小电流I_D(min)=2 mA，最大整流电流I_D(max)=15 mA。用恒压降模型，在保持V_O=0.7 V时讨论R、R_L取值范围。For Fig. 3.4.17, 5 V≤V_I≤10 V. Diode current must be at least 2 mA to maintain a 0.7 V drop and no more than 15 mA. Using a constant-drop model, determine allowed R and R_L while maintaining V_O=0.7 V.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

V_I经R到输出，正向二极管和R_L均从输出并联接地。V_I reaches output through R; the forward diode and R_L both shunt output to ground.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第120页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 / PDF p. 120.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.
小输入检查二极管最小电流，大输入检查最大电流；负载电流0.7/R_L一直存在。R和R_L是耦合范围，不能分别给两个互不相关区间。Minimum supply checks minimum diode current, maximum supply checks maximum current. Load current is always 0.7/R_L; R/R_L ranges are coupled, not independent intervals.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写两端约束Endpoint constraints

二极管电流随V_I单调增加，故只需检查5 V和10 V两个端点。Diode current increases monotonically with supply, so only the 5 V and 10 V endpoints need checking.

4.3R−0.7RL≥0.002;9.3R−0.7RL≤0.015

固定负载时的R区间R interval for a given load

两不等式联立即为完整设计条件；区间存在需R_L≥76.2527 Ω（允许边界等号）。Their intersection gives the complete design condition; it exists for R_L≥76.2527 Ω, including equality.

9.30.015+0.7/RL≤R≤4.30.002+0.7/RL;RL≥0.70.00918≈76.2527Ω

给出可复核设计例Checkable example

例如R=1 kΩ，则R_L≥304.3478 Ω（含空载）满足两端电流；临界负载76.2527 Ω时，R只能为384.6154 Ω。空载时R为620～2150 Ω。For example R=1 kΩ permits R_L≥304.3478 Ω, including open load. At the limiting load 76.2527 Ω, R is fixed at 384.6154 Ω. With no load, R may be 620…2150 Ω.

完整范围由两端电流不等式或上述R(R_L)区间给出；可行负载R_L≥76.2527 Ω。取R=1 kΩ时，R_L≥304.3478 Ω。The coupled endpoint inequalities, or the stated R(R_L) interval, give the full range. Feasible R_L≥76.2527 Ω; for R=1 kΩ, R_L≥304.3478 Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 最大输入还必须检查15 mA上限，不能只保留最低2 mA。Check the 15 mA limit at maximum supply as well as the 2 mA minimum.

核验依据Verification

0.7 V恒压降，仅在题给2～15 mA内使用；电阻均正，允许R_L→∞。0.7 V model used only within the specified 2…15 mA diode-current range; positive resistances, including R_L→∞.

按原图KCL在输入两端独立回算电流；可行负载边界同时达到2 mA和15 mA，随机可行点扫描中间供电均在范围内。Independent original-node KCL checks both endpoints; the limiting design attains 2/15 mA simultaneously, and sampled feasible designs remain within bounds at intermediate supplies.

单管两向不同；反串双管两向对称One zener is asymmetric; an opposing pair is symmetric

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.5.1，所有稳压管均为硅管，稳定电压V_Z=8 V，v_i=15sinωt V。绘出v_o1和v_o2波形。In Fig. 3.5.1 all zeners are silicon with V_Z=8 V. For v_i=15sinωt V, draw v_o1 and v_o2.

两图输入均经3 kΩ到输出。（a）单稳压管阴极在输出、阳极接地；（b）两只稳压管反向串联接在输出与地之间。Both inputs feed output through 3 kΩ. (a) One zener has cathode at output and anode at ground. (b) Two opposing series zeners connect output to ground.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.
单管正向只需0.7 V，反向需8 V；反串双管任一方向都是一只击穿、一只正向，总计8.7 V。A single zener needs 0.7 V forward or 8 V reverse. An opposing pair has one in breakdown and one forward in either direction, totaling 8.7 V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

单管限幅Single-zener clipping

v_o1正峰钳8 V、负峰钳−0.7 V；未达限幅时跟随输入。v_o1 clips at +8 V and −0.7 V, following input between limits.

vo1=min(8,max(−0.7,15sinωt))V

反串双管限幅Opposing-pair clipping

v_o2在±8.7 V对称限幅；不能把正向那只压降漏掉。v_o2 clips symmetrically at ±8.7 V; include the forward-biased diode drop.

vo2=min(8.7,max(−8.7,15sinωt))V

单管限幅−0.7/+8 V，反串双管限幅±8.7 V。Single-zener limits −0.7/+8 V; opposing pair limits ±8.7 V.

v_o1：−0.7～+8 V；v_o2：−8.7～+8.7 V，均在限幅区外截顶、区内跟随输入。v_o1 spans −0.7…+8 V; v_o2 spans −8.7…+8.7 V. Both follow input until clipping.

易错点Common errors

  • 稳压管反向8 V不意味着正向也8 V。An 8 V reverse zener rating does not imply an 8 V forward drop.

核验依据Verification

理想8 V击穿稳压、硅正向0.7 V；忽略动态电阻和反向漏电。Ideal 8 V reverse regulation and 0.7 V forward drop; dynamic resistance and leakage neglected.

逐极性枚举截止、正向和击穿状态，以串联3 kΩ求电流并确认状态一致；双管输出对称，单管方向与原图阴极一致。Enumerated off, forward and breakdown states by polarity; series 3 kΩ currents confirm each state. Pair symmetry and the single-zener orientation match the source.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

稳压管电流分配；功率；器件I–V模型与误差边界。Zener current sharing; power; device I–V models and uncertainty.
先用I_R=I_Z+I_O。只给5.1 V@49 mA并不能唯一确定5 V时I_Z，所以SPICE数值必须绑定具体模型。Start with I_R=I_Z+I_O. A 5.1 V @49 mA point does not uniquely determine I_Z at 5 V, so numerical SPICE results must name a model.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

稳压管功率与最差条件Zener power and extremes

在稳压成立时V_O≈V_Z，输入越高、负载电阻越大（负载电流越小），P_Z越大，空载最危险；输入最低且负载电阻最小时P_Z最小，直到失稳边界。While regulation holds V_O≈V_Z. Higher input and larger load resistance increase zener power; open load is worst. Lowest input and smallest load resistance minimize it, down to the loss-of-regulation boundary.

PZ≈VZ(VI−VZR−VZRL)

负载和限流电阻功率Load and series-resistor power

表达式仅适用于输出仍稳压的区间。These expressions apply while the output remains regulated.

PL≈VZ2RL;PR≈(VI−VZ)2R

模型无关的第（3）问关系Model-independent relation for part (3)

在V_O=5 V边界，负载电流=(10−5)/30−I_Z(5 V)，并须满足0≤I_Z≤178 mA。仅以恒定5.1 V且I_Z≥0近似，只能得到0～163.333 mA的理想极限；不能把它说成真实1N4733的5 V门限电流。At the 5 V boundary, load current is (10−5)/30−I_Z(5 V), with 0≤I_Z≤178 mA. An ideal fixed-5.1 V approximation gives only a 0…163.333 mA limit; it is not a real 1N4733 5 V threshold prediction.

IO,max=10−530−IZ(5V)

实际SPICE及模型边界Executed SPICE and model limits

为给出可复现示例，另用自写分段线性模型V_Z=5.1+7(I_Z−0.049)（V/A单位），7 Ω选自数据表在49 mA处的最大微分阻抗，绝非完整厂商模型。实际DC扫描得V_O=5 V时I_O≈131.952 mA，示例范围0～131.952 mA；空载约5.74892 V、I_Z≈141.703 mA<178 mA。用最大局部斜率跨区外推不构成实物保证，其他SPICE模型会改变数值；原题未指定模型，真实数值不唯一。For a reproducible illustration, an authored piecewise model uses V_Z=5.1+7(I_Z−0.049), in V/A. The 7 Ω is the datasheet’s maximum differential impedance at 49 mA, not a full manufacturer model. An executed DC sweep reaches V_O=5 V at I_O≈131.952 mA, giving the illustrative range 0…131.952 mA; no-load is about 5.74892 V at I_Z≈141.703 mA<178 mA. Extrapolating a maximum local slope is not a device guarantee. Other SPICE models change this result; the unspecified original model prevents a unique real-device number.

自写7 Ω分段线性模型的实际DC扫描，非厂商完整模型或实物保证。Executed DC sweep of the authored 7 Ω piecewise model; not a manufacturer model or device guarantee.

（1）（2）见功率式。（3）一般上限为166.667 mA−I_Z(5 V)，必须说明器件模型。本次明确标注的7 Ω分段线性SPICE示例为0～131.952 mA，不冒充真实器件唯一答案。(1)–(2) See power expressions. (3) General upper limit is 166.667 mA−I_Z(5 V), requiring an explicit I–V model. The clearly labeled 7 Ω piecewise SPICE example gives 0…131.952 mA, not a unique real-device answer.

易错点Common errors

  • I_ZT=49 mA是测试电流，既不是最小稳压电流，也不是最大电流。49 mA is test current, not minimum regulation current or maximum current.
  • 数据表局部最大微分阻抗不等于全范围真实I–V直线。A maximum local differential impedance is not the full-range actual I–V line.

核验依据Verification

功率式用理想恒压稳压近似；数值SPICE示例另用显式7 Ω局部斜率外推，不能据此保证实际1N4733输出精度。Power expressions use ideal voltage regulation. The numerical SPICE example explicitly extrapolates a 7 Ω local slope and does not guarantee actual 1N4733 accuracy.

原节点KCL及功率守恒独立推得各式；示例网表实际DC扫描，与分段线性节点方程独立求解的5 V交点及空载值相符，并检查178 mA上限。Original-node KCL and power conservation independently give the expressions. The executed illustrative DC sweep agrees with independent piecewise nodal solutions for the 5 V intersection and no-load point; the 178 mA limit was checked.

负载范围Load range

I_R=(10−5)/100=50 mA，故0≤I_L≤45 mA，空载恰好达到I_Z最大值。I_R=50 mA, so 0≤I_L≤45 mA; open load exactly reaches maximum zener current.

RL≥50.045=111.111Ω(including open load)

三个最大功率Three maximum powers

负载最大功率在R_L最小时；稳压管最大功率在空载；R压降固定5 V，耗散不随负载变化。Maximum load power occurs at minimum R_L; maximum zener power at open load; resistor drop stays at 5 V, so its power is load independent.

易错点Common errors

理想5 V稳压，二极管仅在5～50 mA范围使用；不计电源/电阻容差。Ideal 5 V regulation over the specified 5…50 mA range; source and resistor tolerances excluded.

题目原文Transcribed question

设计一稳压管并联式稳压电路，要求V_O=4 V、I_O=15 mA；输入直流V_I=6 V且有10%波动。试选稳压管型号和合适限流电阻，检验功率定额。Design a shunt-zener regulator with V_O=4 V and I_O=15 mA from a 6 V DC input varying by ±10%. Choose a zener type and series resistor, checking power ratings.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

并联稳压；输入上下限；器件容差；额定功率。Shunt regulation; supply extremes; device tolerance; power ratings.
输入范围5.4～6.6 V。先为稳压管保留电流，再选R；题目未给输出误差，必须区分教材4 V近似与实物3.9 V标称。Input spans 5.4…6.6 V. Reserve zener current before selecting R. No output tolerance is given, so distinguish a textbook 4 V approximation from a nominal 3.9 V part.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

教材4 V模型的一组设计One design under the textbook 4 V model

选R=62 Ω，最低输入时I_Z=(5.4−4)/62−15m≈7.581 mA，最高输入时≈26.935 mA，均为正且远低于0.5 W/4 V。Choose R=62 Ω. Zener current ranges from (5.4−4)/62−15m≈7.581 mA to 26.935 mA, positive and far below 0.5 W/4 V.

IZ,min≈7.58065mA;IZ,max≈26.9355mA

给出实物候选并说明精度Concrete part candidate and accuracy

可用Vishay BZX55C3V9（标称3.9 V、0.5 W）作约4 V方案，配62 Ω、0.5 W电阻。数据表在5 mA测试点的电压档为3.7～4.1 V；该器件并不保证4.000 V。若要求严格4 V，原题缺少误差与温度条件，应选实测4 V分档/校准方案，并复核整个工作电流范围，不能把3.9 V直接宣称精确4 V。Vishay BZX55C3V9 (nominal 3.9 V, 0.5 W) with a 62 Ω, 0.5 W resistor is an approximately 4 V candidate. Its datasheet range at the 5 mA test point is 3.7…4.1 V; it does not guarantee 4.000 V. Strict 4 V requires missing tolerance/temperature requirements, screened or calibrated parts, and verification over the operating-current range; nominal 3.9 V must not be called exact 4 V.

最差功率核验Worst-case power checks

在理想4 V模型、15 mA负载下，P_Z最大≈0.107742 W，P_R最大≈0.109032 W；高输入空载P_Z≈0.167742 W。若仅作3.7～4.1 V恒压档的保守角点核验，带载最小I_Z≈5.968 mA，P_Z≤0.117565 W、P_R≤0.135645 W，空载P_Z≤0.173065 W；均低于所选0.5 W额定。该角点检查不把数据表测试点容差当作全电流范围电压保证。In the ideal 4 V model at 15 mA load, maximum P_Z≈0.107742 W and P_R≈0.109032 W; high-input open-load P_Z≈0.167742 W. A conservative constant-voltage corner check over 3.7…4.1 V gives loaded minimum I_Z≈5.968 mA, P_Z≤0.117565 W, P_R≤0.135645 W and open-load P_Z≤0.173065 W, below 0.5 W ratings. This corner check does not turn test-point tolerance into a full-current voltage guarantee.

一组教材近似设计：约4 V、≥0.5 W稳压管，R=62 Ω/0.5 W；可选BZX55C3V9作约4 V候选，须明确其标称3.9 V及精度限制。严格4.000 V不能由原题信息或此型号直接保证。One textbook approximate design: approximately 4 V zener rated at least 0.5 W and R=62 Ω/0.5 W. BZX55C3V9 is an approximately 4 V candidate with nominal 3.9 V and explicit accuracy limits; strict 4.000 V is not guaranteed by this part or the given information.

易错点Common errors

  • 输入最低时仍须给稳压管留电流，不能只按15 mA负载算R。Reserve zener current at minimum input; do not size R using load current alone.
  • 型号的标称、容差、测试电流及温度条件都影响实物输出。Nominal voltage, tolerance, test current and temperature all affect real output.

核验依据Verification

教材计算用恒定4 V；实物选型仅为约4 V候选，0.5 W按数据表规定散热条件使用；未声称跨温度/电流/容差保证4 V。Textbook calculations use constant 4 V. The real part is only an approximately 4 V candidate, with 0.5 W rating subject to datasheet thermal conditions; no exact 4 V guarantee across temperature/current/tolerance is claimed.

按原并联稳压KCL独立检查输入上下限、负载与空载；功率逐角点计算，并检查V_Z(6.6−V_Z)/R在给定电压区间单调下降，最差值发生在3.7 V端。Independent shunt-node KCL checks input extremes with load and open load. Power was checked at each corner; V_Z(6.6−V_Z)/R decreases over the stated voltage interval, placing worst-case open-load power at 3.7 V.

指定要求：4.1.1Assigned requirement: 4.1.1

从转移曲线判断MOS类型及阈值Read MOS type and threshold from transfer curves

题目原文Transcribed question

图题4.1.1所示为MOS管的转移特性，请分别说明各属于何种类型的MOS管。指出它们的阈值电压各为多少？（图中i_D的参考方向为流进漏极。）Fig. 4.1.1 shows MOS transfer characteristics. Identify the type of MOSFET represented by each curve and state its threshold voltage. The reference direction of i_D is into the drain.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

三条i_D-v_GS曲线：(a)i_D为正，零电流交点v_GS=-3 V且v_GS=0时仍有正电流；(b)i_D为负，零电流交点+2 V且v_GS=0时有负电流；(c)i_D为负，在v_GS=-4 V进入导通，v_GS=0时截止。Three i_D versus v_GS curves: (a) positive i_D, zero-current threshold at -3 V and nonzero current at v_GS = 0; (b) negative i_D, threshold at +2 V and nonzero current at zero gate voltage; (c) negative i_D, onset at -4 V and off at zero gate voltage.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

NMOS/PMOS电流方向；增强型/耗尽型定义；阈值电压的带符号值。NMOS/PMOS current directions; enhancement/depletion definitions; signed threshold voltage.
先用漏极电流符号识别N/P沟道，再看v_GS=0是否已导通识别增强/耗尽，最后读曲线与横轴的阈值交点。Use the drain-current sign to identify N/P channel, then inspect conduction at v_GS = 0 to distinguish enhancement/depletion, and finally read the threshold at the zero-current intercept.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)：正漏极电流且零栅压导通(a): positive drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

电流参考方向流进漏极，正i_D对应NMOS。v_GS=0时已有电流，故为耗尽型，阈值读为-3 V。With i_D referenced into the drain, positive current indicates NMOS. Nonzero current at v_GS = 0 identifies depletion mode, with threshold -3 V.

(a) NMOS depletion:VTN=−3V

(b)：负漏极电流且零栅压导通(b): negative drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

负i_D表示实际电流流出漏极，对应PMOS。零栅压仍导通，故为耗尽型；正向栅压增至+2 V才截止，阈值+2 V。Negative i_D means current leaves the drain, identifying PMOS. Conduction at zero gate voltage indicates depletion mode; a positive gate voltage of +2 V is needed to cut it off, so the threshold is +2 V.

(b) PMOS depletion:VTP=+2V

(c)：负漏极电流且需负栅压开启(c): negative drain current requiring negative gate voltage

负i_D对应PMOS。v_GS=0时截止，只有栅压低于-4 V才导通，因此为增强型PMOS，阈值-4 V。Negative i_D identifies PMOS. It is off at v_GS = 0 and turns on only when v_GS falls below -4 V, so it is an enhancement-mode PMOS with threshold -4 V.

(c) PMOS enhancement:VTP=−4V

(a)耗尽型NMOS，V_TN=-3 V；(b)耗尽型PMOS，V_TP=+2 V；(c)增强型PMOS，V_TP=-4 V。(a) Depletion-mode NMOS, V_TN = -3 V. (b) Depletion-mode PMOS, V_TP = +2 V. (c) Enhancement-mode PMOS, V_TP = -4 V.

易错点Common errors

  • PMOS阈值不能一概写成负值，耗尽型PMOS阈值可为正。A PMOS threshold is not always negative; depletion-mode PMOS can have a positive threshold.
  • 阈值读取电流刚消失的横轴交点，不读取纵轴电流截距。Read the threshold from the zero-current gate-voltage intercept, not the drain-current-axis intercept.

核验依据Verification

按图中i_D流入漏极的参考方向；以理想转移曲线读取阈值。Drain-current reference is into the drain, as stated; thresholds are read from the ideal transfer curves.

按三项独立特征复核：电流符号确定沟道类型，零栅压是否导通确定增强/耗尽，曲线开始导通方向与阈值符号满足NMOS v_GS>V_TN、PMOS v_GS<V_TP。三图均一致。Cross-checked three independent features: current sign identifies channel type, zero-gate conduction identifies enhancement/depletion, and the onset direction agrees with NMOS v_GS > V_TN or PMOS v_GS < V_TP. All three curves are consistent.

4.1.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 / PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

从零漏源电压电导求可调电阻Find the adjustable resistance from zero-drain-voltage conductance

题目原文Transcribed question

某增强型NMOS管在较低的v_DS电压下工作，以使MOS管工作在可变电阻区。已知K′_n=50 μA/V²，W=10 μm，L=1 μm，V_TN=1 V。当r_ds0在500 Ω到20 kΩ之间变化时，求v_GS的变化范围。An enhancement NMOS operates at low v_DS in the variable-resistance region. K′_n=50 μA/V², W=10 μm, L=1 μm and V_TN=1 V. Find the v_GS range for r_ds0 from 500 Ω to 20 kΩ.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
下标0指v_DS趋于0时的电阻。先对可变电阻区电流求漏源电导，再反解过驱动电压，别把恒流区平方律当作欧姆定律。The subscript 0 denotes the resistance as v_DS tends to zero. Differentiate the triode-region current, then solve for overdrive; the saturation square law is not an Ohmic law.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写可变电阻区电流Write the triode-region current

取k=K′_nW/L=500 μA/V²；题中K′_n不是已含W/L与1/2的K_n。Let k=K′_nW/L=500 μA/V². K′_n does not include W/L or the saturation factor 1/2.

iD=k[(vGS−VTN)vDS−vDS22]

在零漏源电压求电阻Evaluate resistance at zero drain voltage

零点的微分电导为k(v_GS−V_TN)。正的有限电阻要求v_GS>V_TN。The zero-voltage differential conductance is k(v_GS−V_TN). A positive finite resistance requires v_GS>V_TN.

rds0=[∂iD∂vDS|0]−1=1k(vGS−VTN),vGS=1+1(500×10−6)rds0

代入两端并检查小电压条件Evaluate endpoints and check the low-voltage condition

500 Ω对应5 V，20 kΩ对应1.1 V；阻值随栅压上升而下降。全范围近似线性电阻需|v_DS|远小于最小过驱动0.1 V；单说v_DS较低不足以保证任意精度。500 Ω gives 5 V and 20 kΩ gives 1.1 V. Resistance decreases with gate voltage. For an approximately linear resistor over the whole range, |v_DS| must be much smaller than the minimum overdrive 0.1 V; an unspecified low voltage does not guarantee any chosen accuracy.

1.1V≤vGS≤5V

v_GS范围为1.1～5 V；500 Ω对应5 V，20 kΩ对应1.1 V。结果为v_DS→0的电阻条件。v_GS ranges from 1.1 to 5 V: 500 Ω at 5 V and 20 kΩ at 1.1 V, for resistance in the v_DS→0 limit.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要漏乘W/L=10，或多乘/漏乘1/2。Include W/L=10 and distinguish triode k from saturation K=k/2.
  • r_ds0与有限v_DS下的静态v_DS/i_D并不完全相同。r_ds0 differs from the static v_DS/i_D at finite v_DS.

核验依据Verification

长沟道低场模型，忽略体效应和沟道长度调制，r_ds0按v_DS=0的微分定义。Long-channel low-field model, neglecting body effect and channel-length modulation; r_ds0 is differential resistance at v_DS=0.

用原可变电阻区方程的±h中央差分求导，并分别代入两个栅压核对500 Ω和20 kΩ；另检查有限漏压的电阻偏差随漏压趋零而消失。Central differences of the original triode equation independently reproduce 500 Ω and 20 kΩ; finite-drain-voltage resistance errors vanish as drain voltage tends to zero.

4.1.3全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 / PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

耗尽型PMOS：先定电流符号，再求夹断边界Depletion PMOS: establish current sign, then find the pinch-off boundary

题目原文Transcribed question

已知耗尽型PMOS管的参数为K_p=0.2 mA/V²，V_TP=0.5 V，i_D=−0.5 mA（参考方向为流进漏极）。试求此时的夹断点栅源电压v_GS和漏源电压v_DS。A depletion PMOS has K_p=0.2 mA/V², V_TP=+0.5 V and i_D=−0.5 mA, referenced into the drain. Find v_GS and v_DS at the pinch-off boundary.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
耗尽型PMOS的阈值可以为正，不能擅自改成−0.5 V。“夹断点”指定恒流区与可变电阻区的边界，而非任意恒流区漏压。A depletion PMOS can have a positive threshold; do not change it to −0.5 V. Pinch-off specifies the boundary between triode and saturation, not an arbitrary saturation drain voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用正的过驱动量求栅压Solve gate voltage with a positive overdrive

PMOS导通要求v_GS<V_TP。记u=V_TP−v_GS>0，流进漏极的电流为负。A conducting PMOS requires v_GS<V_TP. Define u=V_TP−v_GS>0; drain-entering current is negative.

iD=−Kp(VTP−vGS)2,u=0.50.2=2.5V

选择物理解并写夹断条件Select the physical root and impose pinch-off

应取v_GS=V_TP−u，另一个平方根分支不满足导通条件。边界处漏栅电压为−V_TP=−0.5 V。Use v_GS=V_TP−u; the other square-root branch fails the conduction condition. At pinch-off the drain-to-gate voltage is −V_TP=−0.5 V.

vGS=0.5−2.5≈−1.081139V,vDS=vGS−VTP=−2.5≈−1.581139V

区别夹断与截止Distinguish pinch-off from cutoff

夹断后仍有−0.5 mA恒流区电流；本题理想恒流区满足v_DS≤−1.581139 V。截止则为v_GS≥+0.5 V。Pinch-off still supports −0.5 mA. Ideal saturation extends to v_DS≤−1.581139 V at this gate voltage. Cutoff instead requires v_GS≥+0.5 V.

夹断边界v_GS≈−1.081139 V，v_DS≈−1.581139 V；不是截止点。At pinch-off, v_GS≈−1.081139 V and v_DS≈−1.581139 V; this is not cutoff.

易错点Common errors

  • i_D按流入漏极定义，PMOS正常电流为负。With current referenced into the drain, normal PMOS current is negative.
  • 正阈值是耗尽型PMOS的题设，不能改号。The positive threshold is intentional for the specified depletion PMOS.

核验依据Verification

教材长沟道平方律；K_p已含几何系数和1/2，忽略沟道长度调制及体效应。Textbook long-channel square law; K_p includes geometry and 1/2. Channel-length modulation and body effect are neglected.

分别将所得电压代入PMOS恒流区平方律和可变电阻区方程，边界两者均得−0.5 mA；检查v_D−v_G=−0.5 V。The PMOS saturation square law and triode equation both give −0.5 mA at the boundary; v_D−v_G=−0.5 V is checked separately.

4.1.4指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 / PDF p. 178. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.1.4Assigned requirement: 4.1.4

由迁移率、氧化层电容及宽长比求NMOS电流Find NMOS current from mobility, oxide capacitance and aspect ratio

题目原文Transcribed question

设增强型NMOS管的参数为V_TN=1 V，W=100 μm，L=5 μm，μ_n=650 cm²/(V·s)，C_ox=76.7×10⁻⁹ F/cm²。已知V_GS=2V_TN时，MOS管工作在恒流区，试计算此时的电流I_D。An enhancement-mode NMOS has V_TN = 1 V, W = 100 μm, L = 5 μm, μ_n = 650 cm²/(V·s), and C_ox = 76.7 × 10⁻⁹ F/cm². At V_GS = 2V_TN it operates in saturation. Calculate I_D.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS饱和区平方律；过驱动电压；单位一致性。MOS saturation square law; overdrive voltage; consistent units.
先算过驱动V_GS-V_TN和几何比W/L，再把迁移率与单位面积电容相乘。直接使用完整平方律，避免不同K定义造成漏掉1/2。First find overdrive V_GS - V_TN and aspect ratio W/L, then multiply mobility by capacitance per unit area. Use the complete square-law expression to avoid losing the factor 1/2 under differing K conventions.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定过驱动与宽长比Find overdrive and aspect ratio

V_GS=2V_TN=2 V，故过驱动为1 V；W、L同用μm，因此比值为20。V_GS = 2V_TN = 2 V, giving overdrive 1 V. W and L are both in μm, so their ratio is 20.

VOV=VGS−VTN=1V,WL=1005=20

代入饱和区平方律Use the saturation square law

忽略沟道长度调制，恒流区电流为(1/2)μ_n C_ox(W/L)V_OV²。μ_n中的cm²与C_ox中的cm⁻²互消。Neglecting channel-length modulation, saturation current is (1/2)μ_n C_ox(W/L)V_OV². The cm² in mobility cancels the cm⁻² in oxide capacitance.

ID=12μnCoxWL(VGS−VTN)2

计算并换成mACalculate and convert to mA

代入650、76.7×10⁻⁹、20与1²，得到4.9855×10⁻⁴ A，约0.499 mA。Substituting 650, 76.7 × 10⁻⁹, 20 and 1² gives 4.9855 × 10⁻⁴ A, approximately 0.499 mA.

ID=12(650)(76.7×10−9)(20)(1)2=4.9855×10−4A≈0.499mA

检查工作区前提Check the region assumption

题目已经说明处于恒流区，该假设要求V_DS≥V_GS-V_TN=1 V。题目未给V_DS，因此只能列出这一必要条件，不能编造具体漏源电压。The exercise states saturation operation, which requires V_DS ≥ V_GS - V_TN = 1 V. No V_DS is supplied, so this condition can be stated but a particular drain-source voltage cannot be invented.

VGS>VTN,VDS≥1V

忽略沟道长度调制，I_D=0.49855 mA≈0.499 mA（约0.50 mA）；题设恒流区要求V_DS≥1 V。Neglecting channel-length modulation, I_D = 0.49855 mA ≈ 0.499 mA (about 0.50 mA). The stated saturation region requires V_DS ≥ 1 V.

易错点Common errors

  • 式中已有1/2，不要因另定义K而再乘或再除一次2。The full equation already contains 1/2; do not multiply or divide by 2 again when introducing K.
  • 原题C_ox为76.7×10⁻⁹ F/cm²，不能误读成10⁻⁸。The original C_ox is 76.7 × 10⁻⁹ F/cm², not 10⁻⁸.

核验依据Verification

理想长沟道MOS平方律，忽略沟道长度调制；按题设处于恒流区。Ideal long-channel MOS square law, neglecting channel-length modulation, with saturation operation as stated.

第二次独立使用SI单位：μ_n=0.065 m²/(V·s)，C_ox=7.67×10⁻⁴ F/m²，代入同一物理模型得到0.00049855 A，与cm单位计算一致；并检查过驱动1 V为正。Independent SI-unit check: μ_n = 0.065 m²/(V·s) and C_ox = 7.67 × 10⁻⁴ F/m². Substitution gives 0.00049855 A, matching the cm-unit calculation; the overdrive is also positive at 1 V.

4.1.5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 / PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

栅漏短接：何时成立平方律“二极管”Gate–drain connection: when the square-law diode model applies

题目原文Transcribed question

接成“二极管”的MOS管如图题4.1.5所示。（1）试分别说明在什么情况下它们的i–v关系为i=K(v−|V_T|)²；（2）为什么可以称它们为“二极管”？（注：V_T表示V_TN或V_TP，K表示K_n或K_p。）图(a)为NMOS栅漏短接，图(b)为PMOS栅漏短接；端口电压上正下负，电流向下。The diode-connected MOS devices in Fig. 4.1.5 use voltage positive at the top and current downward. (1) State when i=K(v−|V_T|)² holds for each. (2) Explain why they are called diodes. V_T denotes V_TN or V_TP and K denotes K_n or K_p. (a) is gate–drain-connected NMOS; (b) is gate–drain-connected PMOS.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

(a)NMOS上端为栅/漏，下端为源及衬底；(b)PMOS上端为源及衬底，下端为栅/漏，两个端口均为上正下负、电流向下。(a) NMOS gate/drain is the upper terminal and source/body the lower. (b) PMOS source/body is upper and gate/drain lower. Both use downward port current and voltage positive at the top.

本题图在书第145页／PDF第178页。The source figure is on printed p. 145 / PDF p. 178.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
先把端口v转为每只管的v_GS、v_DS，再检查阈值与恒流区条件。栅漏短接本身不能让任意耗尽型MOS都自动满足恒流区平方律。Translate port v into v_GS and v_DS, then test threshold and saturation. A gate–drain connection alone does not put every depletion MOS in saturation.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1a）增强型NMOS(1a) Enhancement NMOS

V_TN>0，且v≥V_TN时，v_GS=v_DS=v。恒流区条件v_DS≥v_GS−V_TN自动满足；阈值以上有向下电流。For V_TN>0 and v≥V_TN, v_GS=v_DS=v. Saturation inequality v_DS≥v_GS−V_TN is automatic, giving downward current above threshold.

i=Kn(v−VTN)2=Kn(v−|VTN|)2(v≥VTN>0)

（1b）增强型PMOS(1b) Enhancement PMOS

V_TP<0，且v≥−V_TP时，v_GS=v_DS=−v。漏极流入电流i_D为负，但端口向下电流i=−i_D为正。For V_TP<0 and v≥−V_TP, v_GS=v_DS=−v. Drain-entering i_D is negative but downward port current i=−i_D is positive.

i=−iD=Kp(v+VTP)2=Kp(v−|VTP|)2(v≥|VTP|)

适用区间之外Outside the square-law range

在0≤v<|V_T|时，理想增强型沟道截止，不能把平方后的正数当成电流。耗尽型阈值符号相反，栅漏短接的正向工作通常在可变电阻区，不能直接套本式。反向v<0时还需考虑图示衬底与源短接所形成的体二极管，原题未给反向定量模型。For 0≤v<|V_T|, an ideal enhancement channel is off; squaring a negative overdrive does not create current. Depletion devices have the opposite threshold sign and generally operate in triode for this positive-port connection. Reverse v<0 additionally involves the source-tied-body diode; the problem supplies no quantitative reverse model.

（2）两端非线性器件(2) A two-terminal nonlinear device

栅漏短接后只剩两个独立端子；正向超过阈值有电流，阈值以下电流近似为零，因而有类似二极管的整流特性。这里的正向沟道特性是平方律，不是PN结指数律，也不是固定0.7 V压降。Connecting gate and drain leaves two independent terminals. Current flows above a forward threshold and is approximately zero below it, giving diode-like rectification. The forward channel follows a square law rather than a PN exponential or fixed 0.7 V drop.

(a)增强型NMOS且v≥V_TN>0；(b)增强型PMOS且v≥|V_TP|、V_TP<0。两者此时均在恒流区且i=K(v−|V_T|)²。因栅漏短接构成两端非线性整流器件，称MOS“二极管”。(a) Enhancement NMOS with v≥V_TN>0; (b) enhancement PMOS with V_TP<0 and v≥|V_TP|. Both then satisfy saturation and i=K(v−|V_T|)². Gate–drain connection creates a two-terminal nonlinear rectifying device.

易错点Common errors

  • 平方律有导通区间，不能延伸到阈值以下。The square law must not be extended below threshold.
  • PMOS端口电流与流入漏极的i_D符号相反。PMOS port current has the opposite sign to drain-entering i_D.

核验依据Verification

理想增强型长沟道沟道模型，忽略亚阈值电流与沟道长度调制；体二极管反向端口导通只作定性说明，不虚构固定压降。Ideal long-channel enhancement-channel model without subthreshold current or channel-length modulation; reverse-port body-diode conduction is qualitative, without an invented fixed drop.

按原接线分别代入NMOS与PMOS三端电流式，扫描正向端口电压核对工作区及端口电流符号；对耗尽型检验恒流区不等式以排除错误套式。Original three-terminal NMOS/PMOS equations are evaluated over a port-voltage sweep, checking operating region and current signs; depletion-device saturation inequalities are checked to reject an invalid extension.

4.2.1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 / PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

判断放大：先查直流通路，再查交流通路Check DC paths before AC signal paths

题目原文Transcribed question

试分析图题4.2.1所示各电路对交流信号有无放大作用，并简述理由（设各电路元件参数合适，电容对交流信号可视为短路）。图含(a)～(e)五个电路。For circuits (a)–(e) in Fig. 4.2.1, determine whether each amplifies an AC signal and briefly explain. Assume suitable component values and capacitors that are short circuits for AC.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

(a)NMOS偏置V_GG在输入耦合电容左侧；(b)PMOS源接V_DD，栅有电阻分压偏置；(c)NMOS栅直接接V_DD；(d)NMOS输入与V_GG串联后直接接栅；(e)增强型NMOS栅经电阻接地且源接地。(a) NMOS V_GG lies before the input coupling capacitor. (b) PMOS source is at V_DD with gate-divider bias. (c) NMOS gate is directly tied to V_DD. (d) NMOS gate is directly driven by input plus V_GG. (e) Enhancement NMOS gate is resistively grounded and source is grounded.

本题图在书第146页／PDF第179页。The source figure is on printed p. 146 / PDF p. 179.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
“元件参数合适”不能修复缺失的直流通路或被电源短路的交流输入。对每图先把电容开路找Q点，再把电源交流接地。Suitable values cannot repair a missing DC path or an AC input shorted by a supply. Open capacitors to find Q, then AC-ground the supplies.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（a）无可靠线性放大(a) No reliable linear amplification

直流时C_b1开路，V_GG被隔断；栅极没有直流偏置通路，理想模型下栅电位未定。不能建立确定的线性静态工作点；实际漏电或初始电荷不是题设偏置。C_b1 is open for DC and disconnects V_GG. The gate has no DC bias path and its ideal voltage is undetermined. No defined linear quiescent point is established; unspecified leakage or stored charge is not a bias design.

（b）可以：PMOS共源(b) Yes: PMOS common source

分压电阻给栅静态电位，源接正电源；合适参数使PMOS在恒流区。交流源极接地，栅压上升使PMOS下行电流减小，漏极电压下降，输出反相。The divider biases the gate and suitable values put the PMOS in saturation. Its source is AC-grounded. Rising gate voltage reduces downward PMOS current and lowers the drain voltage, giving inversion.

Av≈−gm(Rd∥ro)(unloaded output)

（c）无交流栅源输入(c) No AC gate–source excitation

栅极直接接理想V_DD，是交流地。C_b1把输入接到交流地，v_gs交流分量为0；即使直流有漏电流，也无所要求的信号电压放大。The gate is tied directly to ideal V_DD, an AC ground. C_b1 therefore connects the input to AC ground and the AC v_gs is zero. A possible DC drain current does not create signal amplification.

（d）可以：偏置直接送到栅极(d) Yes: gate receives DC bias directly

V_GG与输入串联，直流偏置不被电容隔断；适当Q点下输入直接改变v_GS，漏极经R_d将电流变化变为反相电压。V_GG is in series with the input and is not blocked by a capacitor. With a suitable Q point, input changes v_GS and R_d converts drain-current changes into an inverted voltage.

Av≈−gm(Rd∥ro)(unloaded output)

（e）无小信号线性放大(e) No small-signal linear amplification

图示为增强型NMOS。栅、源的直流电位均为0，V_GSQ=0<V_TN，管子截止且g_mQ=0。大信号可能产生半波式失真导通，但不能算围绕Q点的线性放大。The depicted device is enhancement NMOS. Both gate and source are zero for DC, so V_GSQ=0<V_TN and g_mQ=0. A large input may produce distorted partial-cycle conduction, not linear amplification about Q.

有线性交流放大作用的是(b)、(d)；(a)缺栅极直流偏置通路，(c)栅被电源交流接地，(e)增强型NMOS在零偏置处截止。(b) and (d) can amplify linearly. (a) lacks a gate DC-bias path; (c) has an AC-grounded gate; (e) has a cutoff enhancement NMOS at zero gate bias.

易错点Common errors

  • 耦合电容前的V_GG不会穿过电容提供直流栅偏置。V_GG before a coupling capacitor cannot bias the gate through it.
  • 静态有电流与交流有增益是两项独立检查。DC current and AC gain are separate checks.

核验依据Verification

图示增强型MOS，理想输入/偏置源；合适的线性Q点和小信号、无额外输出负载。浮置栅不假定未给定的漏电或初始电荷。Depicted enhancement MOS devices and ideal signal/bias sources; suitable linear Q points and small signals, without an extra output load. No unspecified leakage or initial charge is imposed on the floating gate.

逐图按原接线做直流连通性及交流接地检查；对(b)(d)用漏极节点KCL得到负增益，对(c)验证v_gs=0，对(e)用分段MOS模型验证g_mQ=0。Original wiring is checked for DC connectivity and AC grounding. Drain KCL produces negative gains for (b)/(d); (c) enforces zero AC v_gs and the piecewise MOS model gives g_mQ=0 for (e).

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 / PDF p. 178. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.2.2(1)(3)(5)(7)Assigned requirement: 4.2.2(1)(3)(5)(7)

MOS工作区：先判导通，再比较夹断边界MOS operating regions: check turn-on before the pinch-off boundary

题目原文Transcribed question

测量电路中MOS管的漏源电压、栅源电压值如下，它们的阈值电压也已知，试判断各管工作在什么区域（恒流区、可变电阻区、夹断点或截止区）。设MOS管的衬底电极均与源极并接在一起。 （1）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=2 V，V_TN=1 V；（2）V_DS=1 V，V_GS=2 V，V_TN=1 V；（3）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=1 V，V_TN=1.5 V；（4）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=-1 V，V_TN=-2 V；（5）V_DS=-3 V，V_GS=-2 V，V_TP=-1 V；（6）V_DS=3 V，V_GS=-2 V，V_TP=-1 V；（7）V_DS=-3 V，V_GS=-1 V，V_TP=-1.5 V。Measured MOS drain-source and gate-source voltages, together with known thresholds, are listed below. Determine whether each transistor is in saturation, the variable-resistance region, the pinch-off boundary, or cutoff. Each body is tied to its source. (1) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=2 V, V_TN=1 V. (2) V_DS=1 V, V_GS=2 V, V_TN=1 V. (3) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=1 V, V_TN=1.5 V. (4) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=-1 V, V_TN=-2 V. (5) V_DS=-3 V, V_GS=-2 V, V_TP=-1 V. (6) V_DS=3 V, V_GS=-2 V, V_TP=-1 V. (7) V_DS=-3 V, V_GS=-1 V, V_TP=-1.5 V.

7个小问均已核验；第（6）问给出附模型边界的条件化答案：按本教材式（4.1.11）为可变电阻区，但真实体源相连器件的漏-体结正偏，不能仅用四区近似描述整个器件。All seven parts are checked. Part (6) has a conditional answer with an explicit model limitation: textbook Eq. (4.1.11) classifies it as triode, while a real source-tied-body device has a forward-biased drain-body junction and cannot be described completely by the four-region approximation alone.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

NMOS/PMOS的带符号阈值；过驱动电压；体结偏置。Signed NMOS/PMOS thresholds; overdrive voltage; body-junction bias.
不能把NMOS公式直接套到PMOS上。对正常极性PMOS先改用V_SG、V_SD和|V_TP|；对反常漏源极性另查体结条件。Do not apply NMOS inequalities directly to PMOS. For normally biased PMOS use V_SG, V_SD and |V_TP|; separately inspect body junctions for reversed drain-source polarity.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

NMOS判断规则NMOS decision rule

在通常V_DS≥0的条件下，先看V_GS是否超过带符号V_TN；导通后再比较V_DS和V_GS−V_TN。For normal V_DS≥0, first compare V_GS with the signed threshold V_TN. Once on, compare V_DS with V_GS−V_TN.

VOV=VGS−VTN;VOV<0:cutoff;VDS=VOV:boundary;VDS>VOV:saturation

（1）（2）：同一过驱动，不同V_DS(1), (2): same overdrive, different V_DS

两题V_OV均为1 V。（1）3>1，恒流区；（2）1=1，处在夹断边界。Both have V_OV=1 V. (1) 3>1: saturation. (2) 1=1: pinch-off boundary.

(1)3>2−1=1;(2)1=2−1=1

（3）（4）：负阈值不能漏掉符号(3), (4): retain the sign of a negative threshold

（3）1<1.5，未形成沟道，截止。（4）虽V_GS=-1 V，但阈值-2 V更低，过驱动1 V，V_DS=3 V，故恒流区。(3) 1<1.5: no channel, cutoff. (4) V_GS=-1 V still exceeds the -2 V threshold; overdrive is 1 V and V_DS=3 V, giving saturation.

(3)VOV=−0.5V;(4)VOV=−1−(−2)=1V

（5）（7）：先改成PMOS的正量(5), (7): use positive PMOS magnitudes

（5）V_SG=2 V>|V_TP|=1 V，过驱动1 V，V_SD=3 V，恒流区。（7）V_SG=1 V<1.5 V，截止。(5) V_SG=2 V exceeds |V_TP|=1 V; its 1 V overdrive is below V_SD=3 V, so it is in saturation. (7) V_SG=1 V<1.5 V: cutoff.

(5)VSD=3>VSG−|VTP|=1;(7)VSG=1<1.5

（6）：按教材判据给出条件化答案，并核对体结(6): give a conditional textbook-model answer and check the body junction

按本教材第97页式（4.1.11）列出的可变电阻区判据，V_GS=-2 V≤V_TP=-1 V，且V_DS=+3 V>V_GS−V_TP=-1 V，因此在该简化判据下答“可变电阻区”。必须同时注明：题设衬底接源，实际PMOS的P型漏区比N型衬底高3 V，漏-体PN结正偏。此时不能仅用忽略体结的四区沟道模型描述整个器件；这个教材模型答案不是对真实器件正常偏置状态的无条件判断。原题的正V_DS和V_TP均保留，不擅自改号或改管型。Using the variable-resistance-region inequalities printed in textbook Eq. (4.1.11), p. 97, V_GS=-2 V≤V_TP=-1 V and V_DS=+3 V>V_GS−V_TP=-1 V. Thus the answer under that simplified criterion is the variable-resistance (triode) region. A qualification is essential: with body tied to source, the actual PMOS P-type drain is 3 V above its N-type body, so the drain-body PN junction is forward biased. A four-region channel model that neglects the body junction cannot by itself describe the complete device in this condition. The textbook-model answer is therefore not an unconditional claim about a normally biased real device. Preserve the printed positive V_DS and V_TP; do not silently change a sign or transistor type.

VGS−VTP=−2−(−1)=−1V;−2≤−1,3>−1⇒triode under Eq. (4.1.11);VDB=VD−VB=VDS=+3V

（1）恒流区；（2）夹断点；（3）截止区；（4）恒流区；（5）恒流区；（6）按本教材式（4.1.11）的简化判据为可变电阻区；真实体源相连PMOS在给定正V_DS下漏-体结正偏，须保留此模型适用范围说明；（7）截止区。(1) Saturation. (2) Pinch-off boundary. (3) Cutoff. (4) Saturation. (5) Saturation. (6) Triode under the simplified criterion of textbook Eq. (4.1.11); the real source-tied-body PMOS has a forward-biased drain-body junction at the stated positive V_DS, so the model limitation must accompany the answer. (7) Cutoff.

易错点Common errors

  • 负的V_GS不必然意味着截止；要与带符号阈值比较。Negative V_GS does not automatically mean cutoff; compare it with the signed threshold.
  • 保留原书第（6）问的V_TP和正V_DS，不擅自修题。Preserve the printed V_TP and positive V_DS in part (6); do not silently alter the problem.

核验依据Verification

（1）（2）（3）（4）（5）（7）采用本章正常漏源极性下的理想长沟道MOS区域模型。（6）的“可变电阻区”仅指采用本教材式（4.1.11）显式判据、忽略漏-体结电流和正偏体结对沟道近似的影响时的模型分类；真实体源相连的器件在给定+3 V漏源偏压下有漏-体结正偏，须另计体二极管及外电路条件。未假设原题印刷错误，也未确定教师的评分答案。Parts (1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(7) use the chapter's ideal long-channel MOS region model under normal drain-source polarity. The triode answer for (6) refers only to applying the explicit criterion of textbook Eq. (4.1.11), neglecting drain-body junction current and the effects of forward body-junction bias on the channel approximation. A real source-tied-body device at the given +3 V drain-source bias has a forward-biased drain-body junction and requires body-diode and external-circuit modeling. No printing error or instructor grading decision is assumed.

逐项独立核对沟道形成及夹断条件。第（6）问目视核对原题（印刷145–146页/PDF178–179页），再按印刷97页/PDF130页式（4.1.11）的显式代数判据复算；另对照印刷98页/PDF131页的衬底接最高电位、隔离PN结反偏要求，并用MIT课程讲义及Infineon官方应用笔记交叉核对PMOS体二极管方向。未使用外部习题答案。Independently checked channel formation and pinch-off for every part. For (6), visually verified the printed problem (pp. 145–146 / PDF pp. 178–179), then evaluated the explicit algebraic inequalities of Eq. (4.1.11), printed p. 97 / PDF p. 130. Separately checked the body-at-highest-potential and reverse-biased-isolation-junction requirement on printed p. 98 / PDF p. 131, and cross-checked PMOS body-diode orientation with MIT lecture notes and an official Infineon application note. No external exercise answer key was used.

固定分压共源极：算偏置后检查恒流区Divider-biased common source: compute bias, then check saturation

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.3.6b所示，设R_g1=90 kΩ，R_g2=60 kΩ，R_d=30 kΩ，V_DD=5 V，V_TN=1 V，K_n=0.1 mA/V²。试计算电路的V_GS和V_DS。For the circuit in Fig. 4.3.6(b), R_g1=90 kΩ, R_g2=60 kΩ, R_d=30 kΩ, V_DD=5 V, V_TN=1 V and K_n=0.1 mA/V². Find V_GS and V_DS.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

分压共源极直流电路：90 kΩ自+5 V至栅，60 kΩ自栅至地；源极及衬底接地，漏极通过30 kΩ接+5 V。原图标的是通用参数，数值以本题题干为准。DC common-source circuit: 90 kΩ from +5 V to gate, 60 kΩ from gate to ground, grounded source and body, and 30 kΩ from +5 V to drain. The source figure uses generic labels; use the values in this exercise.

本题图在书第109页／PDF第142页。The source figure is on printed p. 109 / PDF p. 142.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS栅极零直流电流；分压；恒流区平方律；KVL。Zero DC gate current; voltage division; saturation square law; KVL.
栅极分压不被MOS输入加载，先得V_GS，再假设恒流区算I_D和V_DS，最后检查假设。The MOS gate does not load the DC divider. Find V_GS, assume saturation to compute I_D and V_DS, then validate that assumption.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

栅源电压Gate-source voltage

源极接地，栅极电流为零，故下分压电阻60 kΩ上的电压就是V_GS。The source is grounded and gate current is zero, so V_GS is the voltage across the lower 60 kΩ divider resistor.

VGS=56090+60=2V

电流和漏源电压Current and drain-source voltage

采用本书K_n定义I_D=K_n(V_GS−V_TN)²，不额外乘1/2。Use the textbook convention I_D=K_n(V_GS−V_TN)²; do not insert an extra factor of 1/2.

ID=0.1(2−1)2=0.1mA;VDS=5−0.1×30=2V

回查区域Check the region

V_GS>V_TN，且V_DS=2 V超过过驱动1 V，恒流区假设成立。V_GS exceeds the threshold, and V_DS=2 V exceeds the 1 V overdrive, so saturation is consistent.

2>1,VDS=2>VGS−VTN=1V

V_GS=2 V，V_DS=2 V，I_D=0.1 mA，工作在恒流区。V_GS=2 V, V_DS=2 V, I_D=0.1 mA; saturation.

易错点Common errors

  • 本书K_n已含1/2；与SPICE参数KP不能直接等同。The textbook K_n already includes 1/2; it is not the same as SPICE KP.

核验依据Verification

理想长沟道NMOS，忽略沟道长度调制和栅极电流。Ideal long-channel NMOS, neglecting channel-length modulation and gate current.

用分压支路电流5 V/150 kΩ=33.333 μA独立回算栅电位；漏极KVL为2+0.1 mA×30 kΩ=5 V；漏端v_GD=0 V低于阈值，夹断条件成立。Independent divider-current check gives 5 V/150 kΩ=33.333 μA and the same gate voltage. Drain KVL is 2+0.1 mA×30 kΩ=5 V. Drain-end v_GD=0 V is below threshold, consistent with pinch-off.

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题4.2.4所示。已知MOS管K_p=4 mA/V²，λ=0，V_TP=−1.5 V，电源V_DD=18 V。现要求MOS管工作在恒流区，静态时I_DQ=1 mA（按图中向下电流），V_DSQ=−9 V，R_g1、R_g2支路电流为2 μA。（1）确定R_d、R_g1、R_g2；（2）若要保证静态工作在恒流区，R_d的最大值为多少？For Fig. 4.2.4, K_p=4 mA/V², λ=0, V_TP=−1.5 V and V_DD=18 V. Require saturation, downward quiescent current 1 mA, V_DSQ=−9 V and 2 μA in the gate-divider branch. (1) Find R_d, R_g1 and R_g2. (2) Find the maximum R_d compatible with saturation.

PMOS源和衬底接18 V；漏经R_d接地，栅由上端R_g2和下端R_g1分压，输入/输出均经电容耦合。PMOS source/body is at 18 V; drain connects through R_d to ground. R_g2 is the upper divider resistor and R_g1 the lower; input/output are capacitively coupled.

本题图在书第146页／PDF第179页。The source figure is on printed p. 146 / PDF p. 179.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
先定V_S=18 V、V_D=V_S+V_DS，再从电流求V_SG；图中R_g2在上、R_g1在下，别按名称猜位置。First set V_S=18 V and V_D=V_S+V_DS, then infer V_SG from current. R_g2 is above the gate and R_g1 below; use the actual diagram.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）漏极电阻(1) Drain resistor

静态电容开路，V_D=18−9=9 V；向下1 mA全部流过R_d。Capacitors are open for DC. V_D=18−9=9 V, and the downward 1 mA all passes through R_d.

Rd=9V1mA=9kΩ

栅压和分压电阻Gate voltage and divider resistors

由I=K_p(V_SG−|V_TP|)²得过驱动0.5 V，V_SG=2 V、V_G=16 V。栅不取电流，分压两电阻电流均2 μA。I=K_p(V_SG−|V_TP|)² gives 0.5 V overdrive, V_SG=2 V and V_G=16 V. With zero gate current, each divider resistor carries 2 μA.

Rg1=16V2μA=8MΩ,Rg2=18−162μA=1MΩ

（2）调R_d至恒流边界(2) Increase R_d to the saturation boundary

栅偏置不变、λ=0，在恒流区电流保持1 mA。恒流条件V_SD≥V_SG−|V_TP|=0.5 V，故漏电位最多17.5 V。With fixed gate bias and λ=0, current stays 1 mA in saturation. V_SD≥V_SG−|V_TP|=0.5 V limits the drain voltage to 17.5 V.

18−(1mA)Rd≥0.5V⇒Rd,max=17.5kΩ

R_d=9 kΩ，R_g1=8 MΩ，R_g2=1 MΩ。恒流区边界最大R_d=17.5 kΩ；严格留在恒流区内部应小于该值。R_d=9 kΩ, R_g1=8 MΩ and R_g2=1 MΩ. The saturation-boundary maximum is R_d=17.5 kΩ; strict interior operation needs a smaller value.

易错点Common errors

  • V_DS=−9 V不等于V_D=−9 V；源为+18 V。V_DS=−9 V does not mean V_D=−9 V; source is +18 V.
  • 增加R_d使漏极上升、V_SD下降，因此最终进入可变电阻区。Increasing R_d raises drain voltage and reduces V_SD, eventually entering triode.

核验依据Verification

理想长沟道PMOS，λ=0、栅电流0，衬底接源；2 μA分压电流独立于漏极支路。Ideal long-channel PMOS, λ=0 and zero gate current, body tied to source; the 2 μA divider current is separate from drain current.

由两电阻独立分压重算V_G=16 V，再用PMOS分段方程核对电流、原Q点及17.5 kΩ边界；节点KCL、供电与电阻/MOS功率平衡复核通过。An independent divider calculation gives V_G=16 V. The piecewise PMOS law verifies current, original Q and the 17.5 kΩ boundary; node KCL and supply/resistor/MOS power balance are checked.

4.2.5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第146页／PDF第179页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 146 / PDF p. 179. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

先读栅极接线，再解四个节点Read the gate connections before solving four nodes

题目原文Transcribed question

求图题4.2.5所示各电路所标节点的电压。已知所有MOS管K_n=0.25 mA/V²，λ=0，V_TN=0.8 V。图(a)：漏接+5 V、栅接地、源为V₁，向下10 μA电流源接−5 V；(b)：漏接+5 V、栅接地、源为V₂，向下1 mA电流源接−5 V；(c)：栅漏短接为V₃，源接地，上接来自+5 V的1 mA电流源；(d)：栅漏短接为V₄，源接地，V₄经400 kΩ接+5 V。Find the labeled voltages in Fig. 4.2.5 with K_n=0.25 mA/V², λ=0 and V_TN=0.8 V for all devices. (a) Drain +5 V, grounded gate and source V₁, 10 μA sink to −5 V. (b) Drain +5 V, gate grounded, source V₂, 1 mA sink to −5 V. (c) Gate/drain V₃, grounded source, 1 mA source from +5 V. (d) Gate/drain V₄, grounded source, 400 kΩ to +5 V.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

四个原电路保留±5 V电源、电流源箭头、400 kΩ和节点V₁～V₄；(a)栅接左侧地符号，源为V₁，二者未短接。Four source circuits retain ±5 V supplies, current arrows, 400 kΩ and nodes V₁–V₄. In (a), the gate connects to the left ground symbol; source V₁ is a different node.

本题图在书第147页／PDF第180页。The source figure is on printed p. 147 / PDF p. 180.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
(a)(b)的栅都接地，由电流决定正的V_GS，故源电位为负。每个代数根都必须回查V_GS>V_TN、饱和条件与电流源端电压。Both (a) and (b) have grounded gates: current sets positive V_GS, so the source voltage is negative. Check every root against conduction, saturation and available current-source voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（a）10 μA与接地栅极(a) A 10 μA current and grounded gate

原图栅极接左侧地符号，未接源极。由10 μA=0.01 mA，过驱动√(0.01/0.25)=0.2 V，V_GS=1 V；栅为0，所以V₁=−1 V。V_DS=6 V大于0.2 V，恒流区成立，电流源两端有4 V。The gate connects to the left ground symbol, not the source. With 10 μA=0.01 mA, overdrive is √(0.01/0.25)=0.2 V and V_GS=1 V. Grounded gate gives V₁=−1 V. V_DS=6 V exceeds 0.2 V overdrive and the sink has 4 V across it.

V1=−(0.8+0.01/0.25)=−1V

（b）先求V_GS再得源电位(b) Find V_GS, then source voltage

向下1 mA给V_GS=0.8+√(1/0.25)=2.8 V，栅为0故源为−2.8 V。V_DS=7.8 V大于过驱动2 V，满足恒流区；电流源剩2.2 V电压。A downward 1 mA requires V_GS=0.8+√(1/0.25)=2.8 V. Grounded gate gives V₂=−2.8 V. V_DS=7.8 V exceeds 2 V overdrive and the sink has 2.2 V across it.

V2=−2.8V

（c）栅漏短接(c) Gate–drain connection

源接地，V_GS=V_DS=V₃。1 mA给V₃=2.8 V；2.8≥2使恒流区成立，上方电流源两端为2.2 V。With grounded source, V_GS=V_DS=V₃. The 1 mA current gives V₃=2.8 V, satisfying 2.8≥2 V for saturation. The upper current source has 2.2 V.

V3=2.8V

（d）电阻负载线与有效根(d) Resistor load line and valid root

电阻电流与沟道电流相等。方程给1 V与0.59 V两个代数根；0.59 V低于阈值，不能用导通平方律，必须舍去。Equate resistor current to channel current. The algebraic roots are 1 V and 0.59 V; 0.59 V is below threshold and invalid for the on-state square law.

5−V4400kΩ=0.25mA/V2(V4−0.8)2⇒V4=1V,ID=10μA

(a)V₁=−1 V；(b)V₂=−2.8 V；(c)V₃=2.8 V；(d)V₄=1 V。(a) V₁=−1 V; (b) V₂=−2.8 V; (c) V₃=2.8 V; (d) V₄=1 V.

易错点Common errors

  • (a)栅极左下方的横线是地符号，未与源节点连接。The horizontal line below the gate in (a) is a ground symbol, not a wire to the source node.
  • 平方后的低于阈值代数根是伪解。A squared-law root below threshold is extraneous.

核验依据Verification

题给增强型NMOS的理想长沟道模型，λ=0，栅和体电流忽略，衬底与源相接；电流源理想，各解均核对可用端电压。Specified enhancement-NMOS ideal long-channel model, λ=0, zero gate/body current and body tied to source; ideal current sources, with available terminal voltage checked for each solution.

独立采用带截止分支的分段MOS函数，逐节点回代KCL与工作区；(d)另用单调负载线二分法求唯一有效根；(a)按栅极接地原拓扑回代V₁=−1 V，得到漏电流10 μA和零节点残差。An independent piecewise MOS law with cutoff checks each node’s KCL and region. A monotonic load-line bisection finds the unique valid root for (d); (a) is checked with the original grounded gate at V₁=−1 V, yielding 10 μA drain current and zero node residual.

4.4.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第147页／PDF第180页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 147 / PDF p. 180. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.4.1Assigned requirement: 4.4.1

源极负反馈：分开输入增益与源增益Source degeneration: distinguish input gain from source gain

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.4.6a所示。已知R_d=10 kΩ，R_si=R_s=0.5 kΩ，R_g1=165 kΩ，R_g2=35 kΩ，MOS管参数V_TN=0.8 V，K_n=1 mA/V²，λ=0。电路静态工作点处V_GS=1.5 V。试求电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i、源电压增益A_vs=v_o/v_s、输入电阻R_i和输出电阻R_o。For Fig. 4.4.6(a), R_d=10 kΩ, R_si=R_s=0.5 kΩ, R_g1=165 kΩ, R_g2=35 kΩ, V_TN=0.8 V, K_n=1 mA/V² and λ=0. At the bias point V_GS=1.5 V. Find A_v=v_o/v_i, A_vs=v_o/v_s, input resistance R_i, and output resistance R_o.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

源极带未旁路0.5 kΩ的NMOS共源电路，漏极10 kΩ到正电源；栅极由165 kΩ、35 kΩ偏置，信号源串0.5 kΩ，经耦合电容输入，输出经耦合电容从漏极取出。NMOS common source with an unbypassed 0.5 kΩ source resistor, 10 kΩ drain resistor, 165 kΩ/35 kΩ gate divider, 0.5 kΩ signal-source resistance and coupling capacitors at input and output.

本题图在书第114页／PDF第147页。The source figure is on printed p. 114 / PDF p. 147.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS互导；源极负反馈；输入分压；测试源法求输出电阻。MOS transconductance; source degeneration; input division; output-resistance test source.
R_s没有旁路，不能使用−g_mR_d。先在输入端v_i处求增益，再乘信号源内阻造成的分压求A_vs。R_s is unbypassed, so −g_mR_d is not the gain. First find the gain from actual input v_i, then include source-resistance division for A_vs.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由工作点求g_mFind g_m from the bias point

过驱动0.7 V。由本书平方律求I_DQ=0.49 mA，互导为1.4 mS。λ=0意味着r_ds→∞。The overdrive is 0.7 V. The textbook square law gives I_DQ=0.49 mA and g_m=1.4 mS. λ=0 makes r_ds infinite.

IDQ=1(1.5−0.8)2=0.49mA;gm=2Kn(VGSQ−VTN)=1.4mS

写源极反馈关系Write source-feedback equations

中频时电容短路，直流电源交流接地。i_d=g_m(v_i−v_s′)，源极交流电压v_s′=i_dR_s，输出v_o=−i_dR_d。At midband, capacitors are shorts and DC supplies are AC grounds. With source-node AC voltage v_s′, i_d=g_m(v_i−v_s′), v_s′=i_dR_s and v_o=−i_dR_d.

Av=−gmRd1+gmRs=−1.4×101+1.4×0.5=−14017≈−8.23529

输入电阻与源增益Input resistance and source gain

MOS栅极无电流，输入负载是两个偏置电阻并联。源增益还要考虑R_si=0.5 kΩ。The gate draws no current, so input loading is the parallel bias resistors. Source gain also includes R_si=0.5 kΩ.

Ri=165∥35=28.875kΩ;Avs=Av28.87528.875+0.5≈−8.09512

输出电阻Output resistance

求输出电阻时输入信号源置零。λ=0时漏端测试电压不会经r_ds影响源极，因此受控电流不因测试电压而变化，输出只见R_d。Set the input source to zero. With λ=0, a drain test voltage cannot feed back through r_ds to the source; the controlled current does not change with that test voltage. The output sees R_d alone.

Ro=Rd=10kΩ

A_v≈−8.2353，A_vs≈−8.0951，R_i=28.875 kΩ，R_o=10 kΩ。A_v≈−8.2353, A_vs≈−8.0951, R_i=28.875 kΩ, R_o=10 kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • R_s未旁路，分母中的1+g_mR_s不能省。R_s is not bypassed; retain 1+g_mR_s.
  • 输入端v_i位于R_si之后，A_v与A_vs定义不同。Input v_i is after R_si, so A_v and A_vs have different definitions.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号、题设恒流区工作点、λ=0，无外接负载。Midband small signal, the stated saturation bias point, λ=0, no external load.

独立给输入端1 V测试量，联立源极KCL得v_s′=7/17 V、v_gs=10/17 V、i_d=14/17 mA，输出−140/17 V；再独立将源信号1 V经过R_si与R_i分压回算A_vs。输出端1 V测试得0.1 mA。An independent 1 V input test and source-node KCL give v_s′=7/17 V, v_gs=10/17 V, i_d=14/17 mA and output −140/17 V. A separate 1 V source test including R_si and R_i reproduces A_vs. A 1 V output test gives 0.1 mA.

4.4.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第147页／PDF第180页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 147 / PDF p. 180. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

PMOS偏置与增益：先声明λ的处理PMOS bias and gain: state how λ is treated

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题4.4.2所示，设所有电容对信号而言都可视为短路。已知MOS管V_TP=−0.4 V，K_p=0.8 mA/V²，λ=0.02 V⁻¹。试求：（1）I_DQ和V_DSQ；（2）电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i。图中R_s=1.2 kΩ接+3 V，R_d=2 kΩ接−3 V，R_g=100 kΩ接地，源极有旁路电容C_s。For Fig. 4.4.2, all capacitors are shorts for signals. The MOS parameters are V_TP=−0.4 V, K_p=0.8 mA/V² and λ=0.02 V⁻¹. Find (1) I_DQ and V_DSQ and (2) A_v=v_o/v_i. R_s=1.2 kΩ connects to +3 V, R_d=2 kΩ to −3 V, R_g=100 kΩ to ground, and C_s bypasses the source.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

PMOS源经1.2 kΩ接+3 V并经C_s交流接地；栅由耦合电容接v_i，100 kΩ接地；漏经2 kΩ接−3 V并经电容输出v_o，i_D图示方向向下。PMOS source connects through 1.2 kΩ to +3 V and is AC-grounded by C_s. The gate is AC-coupled to v_i and grounded through 100 kΩ. The drain connects through 2 kΩ to −3 V and is AC-coupled to v_o; the indicated drain-branch current is downward.

本题图在书第148页／PDF第181页。The source figure is on printed p. 148 / PDF p. 181.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

PMOS电压参考；电容直流开路、交流短路；由器件电流偏导得到g_m和r_o。PMOS voltage references; capacitors open for DC and short for AC; g_m and r_o from terminal-current derivatives.
用正的源到漏电流I书写偏置，V_DS仍按漏减源为负。主结果在直流与小信号中一致保留题给λ；另列教材常用的直流忽略λ近似，不能混用两套模型的中间量。Write bias with positive source-to-drain current I while keeping V_DS negative. The main result consistently retains λ for both DC and small signals. The common DC-neglects-λ approximation is listed separately; do not mix intermediate values from the two models.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）原节点直流关系(1) Original DC node relations

直流耦合与旁路电容均开路，栅电位为0。以下I用mA、电阻用kΩ，电压自然为V。图中向下支路电流大小I为正，若定义流入PMOS漏极则i_D=−I。All capacitors are open for DC and V_G=0. Use I in mA and resistance in kΩ below, giving volts. Downward branch-current magnitude I is positive; a drain-entering PMOS current reference would be −I.

VS=3−1.2I,VD=−3+2I,VSG=3−1.2I,VSD=6−3.2I

保留λ求物理解Retain λ and select the physical root

采用I=K_p(V_SG−|V_TP|)²(1+λV_SD)。求根后必须满足V_SG>0.4且V_SD≥V_SG−0.4；其余两个三次方程根不符合正常偏置。Use I=K_p(V_SG−|V_TP|)²(1+λV_SD). Enforce V_SG>0.4 and V_SD≥V_SG−0.4 after root finding; the other two cubic roots are not valid normal-bias solutions.

I=0.8(2.6−1.2I)2[1+0.02(6−3.2I)]⇒I≈1.177498mA

回查工作区和极性Check region and polarity

得到V_S≈1.587003 V、V_D≈−0.645004 V，所以V_DSQ≈−2.232007 V。V_SG≈1.587003>0.4，V_SD≈2.232007大于过驱动1.187003 V，恒流区成立。V_S≈1.587003 V and V_D≈−0.645004 V give V_DSQ≈−2.232007 V. V_SG≈1.587003 exceeds 0.4 and V_SD≈2.232007 exceeds the 1.187003 V overdrive, confirming saturation.

IDQ≈1.177498mA downward,VDSQ≈−2.232007V

（2）电流偏导求小信号参数(2) Derive small-signal parameters from current derivatives

源极旁路使交流源电位为0，双电源都为交流地。保留同一模型的偏导：g_m=2K_pV_OV(1+λV_SD)，g_ds=λK_pV_OV²。r_o=(1+λV_SD)/(λI)，不是不加说明地当成精确1/(λI)。The bypassed source and both supplies are AC ground. Differentiate the same model: g_m=2K_pV_OV(1+λV_SD), g_ds=λK_pV_OV². Thus r_o=(1+λV_SD)/(λI); 1/(λI) alone is an approximation.

gm≈1.983985mS,gds≈0.02254361mS,ro≈44.35848kΩ

漏极KCL给反相增益Drain KCL gives inverting gain

输出没有额外负载，输入v_i直接为栅极交流电压。栅压上升使PMOS向下电流减小，输出漏压下降，所以增益为负。There is no extra output load and v_i is the gate’s AC voltage. Rising gate voltage reduces downward PMOS current and lowers the drain voltage, so gain is negative.

(1Rd+gds)vo+gmvi=0,Av=−gm(Rd∥ro)≈−3.796784

常用工程近似另列State the common engineering approximation separately

若静态计算忽略λ，则I≈1.162234 mA，V_DSQ≈−2.280850 V；再用g_m≈2K_pV_OV≈1.928510 mS与r_o≈1/(λI)≈43.02058 kΩ，得A_v≈−3.685675（约−3.7）。这是一套常用近似，并非前面完整含λ模型的同一精确结果。If λ is neglected in DC, I≈1.162234 mA and V_DSQ≈−2.280850 V. With g_m≈2K_pV_OV≈1.928510 mS and r_o≈1/(λI)≈43.02058 kΩ, A_v≈−3.685675 (about −3.7). This is a common approximation, not the exact result of the full λ model above.

一致保留λ：I_DQ≈1.177498 mA（按图向下），V_DSQ≈−2.232007 V，A_v≈−3.796784。若采用静态忽略λ的常用近似：1.162234 mA、−2.280850 V及约−3.685675；两套处理方式分别说明。Consistently retaining λ gives I_DQ≈1.177498 mA downward, V_DSQ≈−2.232007 V and A_v≈−3.796784. The explicitly separate DC-neglects-λ approximation gives 1.162234 mA, −2.280850 V and gain about −3.685675.

易错点Common errors

  • 图中PMOS向下电流为正的大小，与“流入漏极为正”的参考符号不同。The positive downward branch-current magnitude differs from a drain-entering current reference.
  • C_s旁路R_s只对交流有效；直流仍须经过R_s求偏置。C_s bypasses R_s only for AC; DC bias still includes R_s.
  • r_o不是R_s，也不是漏极电阻R_d。r_o is neither source resistor R_s nor drain resistor R_d.

核验依据Verification

教材长沟道PMOS模型；K_p已含1/2，衬底接源，栅电流0，电容为理想交流短路，主结果保留λ；r_o与g_m均由同一模型求导。未给频率和电容值，不估计实际带宽。Textbook long-channel PMOS, K_p includes 1/2, body tied to source and zero gate current. Capacitors are ideal AC shorts. Main values retain λ, with r_o/g_m derived from the same model. No actual bandwidth is inferred without capacitor values or frequency.

独立用区间二分及三次多项式全部根核对直流物理解，检查源/漏节点KCL与双电源功率；对完整端电流分别做栅压、漏压中央差分求g_m、g_ds，原漏极节点扰动给同一增益。另复算静态忽略λ的近似值。Independent bisection and all cubic roots identify the physical bias, with source/drain KCL and dual-supply power balance. Central differences of the full terminal current independently recover g_m/g_ds; original drain-node perturbations recover gain. The DC-neglects-λ approximation is separately recomputed.

只旁路R₂：看清分压节点与源极节点Only R₂ is bypassed: distinguish bias and source nodes

题目原文Transcribed question

已知电路参数如图题4.4.3所示，MOS管工作点上的互导g_m=1 mS，设r_ds≫R_d。（1）画出电路的小信号等效电路；（2）求电压增益A_v；（3）求电路的输入电阻R_i和输出电阻R_o；（4）设输入信号v_i为正弦波，其频率为1 kHz、幅值为10 mV，MOS管参数设置为K_P=110 μA/V²，W=40 μm，L=2 μm，V_TO=1.7 V，试用SPICE观测v_i、v_o波形。 图中：V_DD=20 V，R_d=10 kΩ，R_g1=300 kΩ，R_g2=100 kΩ，R_g3=2 MΩ，R₁=2 kΩ，R₂=10 kΩ，C₁=0.02 μF，C₂=4.7 μF，C=47 μF。Use the component values in Fig. 4.4.3, with bias-point g_m=1 mS and r_ds≫R_d. (1) Draw the small-signal equivalent. (2) Find voltage gain A_v. (3) Find input resistance R_i and output resistance R_o. (4) With sinusoidal v_i of frequency 1 kHz and amplitude 10 mV, use SPICE to observe v_i and v_o, setting K_P=110 μA/V², W=40 μm, L=2 μm and V_TO=1.7 V. Figure values: V_DD=20 V; R_d=10 kΩ; R_g1=300 kΩ; R_g2=100 kΩ; R_g3=2 MΩ; R₁=2 kΩ; R₂=10 kΩ; C₁=0.02 μF; C₂=4.7 μF; C=47 μF.

全题四问已完成。第（4）问已实际运行ngspice 47，并用保留电容的节点方程交叉核验；模型自行算得的g_m与前3问给定值稍有差异。All four parts are complete. Part (4) was executed in ngspice 47 and cross-checked by nodal equations retaining the capacitors. The model-derived g_m differs slightly from the given value in parts (1)–(3).

NMOS漏极接10 kΩ到20 V；源极经R₁=2 kΩ、R₂=10 kΩ串联接地，47 μF只旁路R₂。栅极通过2 MΩ接300 kΩ/100 kΩ偏置分压点。输入电容0.02 μF，输出电容4.7 μF。NMOS drain through 10 kΩ to 20 V; source through series R₁=2 kΩ and R₂=10 kΩ to ground, with 47 μF bypassing only R₂. Gate through 2 MΩ to a 300 kΩ/100 kΩ bias divider. Input capacitor 0.02 μF; output capacitor 4.7 μF.

本题图在书第148页／PDF第181页。The source figure is on printed p. 148 / PDF p. 181.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

交流等效；源极负反馈；偏置网络输入负载；SPICE参数定义。AC equivalent circuits; source degeneration; bias-network input loading; SPICE parameter conventions.
先沿原图连接找节点。C只旁路R₂；Rg3的下端接偏置分压点，它和R₁/R₂之间的节点没有连接。Trace the actual nodes first. C bypasses only R₂. The lower end of Rg3 connects to the bias divider, not the junction of R₁ and R₂.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）画小信号等效(1) Draw the small-signal equivalent

中频时三个电容短路，V_DD交流接地；R₂被旁路，保留源极R₁=2 kΩ。栅极经Rg3=2 MΩ和(Rg1∥Rg2)=75 kΩ串联接地；漏极为10 kΩ接地。MOS用漏到源受控电流源g_mv_gs代替，忽略r_ds。附图按这些节点绘制。At midband the three capacitors are shorts and V_DD is AC ground. R₂ is bypassed; R₁=2 kΩ remains. The gate connects to ground through Rg3=2 MΩ in series with Rg1∥Rg2=75 kΩ. The drain has 10 kΩ to ground. Replace MOS with the drain-to-source controlled current g_mv_gs and omit r_ds. The attached equivalent follows these nodes.

Rg1∥Rg2=300∥100=75kΩ

（2）求增益(2) Find gain

输入v_i就是交流栅电位。源极R₁造成局部反馈，交流漏电流为g_mv_i/(1+g_mR₁)。Input v_i is the AC gate voltage. Source resistor R₁ produces local feedback, giving AC drain current g_mv_i/(1+g_mR₁).

Av=−gmRd1+gmR1=−1×101+1×2=−103≈−3.33333

（3）求输入、输出电阻(3) Find input and output resistances

栅极不吸收电流，但Rg3中有流向偏置网络的输入电流，因此Ri要包含Rg3与并联分压电阻的串联。忽略r_ds时输出只见R_d。The gate draws no current, but Rg3 carries input current into the bias network. Therefore R_i includes Rg3 in series with the parallel divider. Neglecting r_ds, the output sees R_d.

Ri=2MΩ+75kΩ=2.075MΩ;Ro=10kΩ

（4）实际SPICE波形与解析交叉检查(4) Executed SPICE waveforms and analytical cross-check

使用下方原图网表实际运行ngspice 47（LEVEL=1，λ=0），得到V_GQ=5 V、V_SQ≈2.83645 V、V_DQ≈17.6363 V、I_DQ≈0.2363705 mA及g_m≈1.019819 mS。输入为1 kHz、10 mV峰值正弦波；对7–10 ms输出拟合基波，峰值约33.54885 mV，相位约−179.715°，近似反相。保留所有电容的1 kHz小信号AC结果为−3.35500−j0.0166784，独立节点方程得到相同结果。前3问按题给g_m=1 mS计算，第4问由指定模型自行产生Q点和g_m，不能强行令二者相同。图中为实际瞬态数据，拟合残差RMS约0.01414 mV，包含微小非线性与启动余量。The attached circuit was run in ngspice 47 (LEVEL=1, λ=0), producing V_GQ=5 V, V_SQ≈2.83645 V, V_DQ≈17.6363 V, I_DQ≈0.2363705 mA and g_m≈1.019819 mS. The input is a 1 kHz sine with 10 mV peak amplitude. A fundamental fit over 7–10 ms gives output peak amplitude about 33.54885 mV and phase about −179.715°, approximately inverted. AC analysis retaining every capacitor gives −3.35500−j0.0166784 at 1 kHz, reproduced by independent nodal equations. Parts (1)–(3) use the stated 1 mS; part (4) derives its own bias and g_m from the specified model. The plot contains actual transient data. The fit residual RMS is about 0.01414 mV, including slight nonlinearity and startup residue.

IDQ=1.1(5−12IDQ−1.7)2[IDQ in mA];Av(1kHz)≈−3.35500−j0.0166784;|vo1|≈33.54885mV

中频等效图：栅经2 MΩ串75 kΩ接地；源极2 kΩ接地；漏极10 kΩ接地，漏到源受控电流源g_mv_gs，输出在漏极。Midband equivalent: gate through 2 MΩ plus 75 kΩ to ground, source through 2 kΩ to ground, drain through 10 kΩ to ground, drain-to-source controlled current g_mv_gs, and output at drain.

ngspice 47实际瞬态波形，7–10 ms窗口；输入10 mV峰值、输出约33.55 mV峰值，1 kHz，近似反相。Actual ngspice 47 transient waveforms over 7–10 ms: input 10 mV peak, output about 33.55 mV peak, 1 kHz, approximately inverted.

（1）见小信号等效图；（2）A_v=−10/3≈−3.3333；（3）R_i=2.075 MΩ，R_o=10 kΩ；（4）已执行ngspice 47：1 kHz、10 mV峰值输入，输出基波峰值约33.54885 mV，相位约−179.715°，近似反相；见实际波形与网表。(1) See the equivalent. (2) A_v=−10/3≈−3.3333. (3) R_i=2.075 MΩ, R_o=10 kΩ. (4) Executed in ngspice 47: a 1 kHz, 10 mV peak input yields about 33.54885 mV output fundamental peak with phase about −179.715°, approximately inverted. See the actual waveforms and netlist.

易错点Common errors

  • Rg3不接R₁/R₂节点；Ri不是2 MΩ，也不是75 kΩ。Rg3 is not connected to the R₁/R₂ junction; R_i is neither 2 MΩ alone nor 75 kΩ.
  • SPICE KP是μC_ox；本书K_n还含W/(2L)。SPICE KP is μC_ox; textbook K_n additionally contains W/(2L).

核验依据Verification

第1–3问为中频小信号、g_m=1 mS，r_ds→∞；第4问采用题设SPICE参数、LEVEL=1、λ=0，无额外寄生参数。输出1 TΩ仅提供数值直流通路，相对10 kΩ对交流影响可忽略。Parts (1)–(3): midband, g_m=1 mS, r_ds→∞. Part (4): specified SPICE parameters, LEVEL=1, λ=0, no added parasitic parameters. A 1 TΩ output resistor supplies a numerical DC path with negligible AC loading relative to 10 kΩ.

第1–3问独立列源、漏节点KCL，1 V输入给v_s=2/3 V、i_d=1/3 mA、v_o=−10/3 V，输入电流1/2.075 MΩ A；输出1 V测试给0.1 mA。第4问实际ngspice 47直流、AC及瞬态运行均成功；以独立6节点复数导纳矩阵保留C1、C2、旁路C与Rg3/分压网络，得到1 kHz增益−3.35499766−j0.01667836，KCL残差小于7×10⁻18 A。瞬态输出7–10 ms用正弦、余弦及常数最小二乘拟合，基波幅值与AC×10 mV相差约0.0046%。Parts (1)–(3): independent source/drain KCL gives v_s=2/3 V, i_d=1/3 mA and v_o=−10/3 V for a 1 V input; input current is 1/2.075 MΩ A. A 1 V output test gives 0.1 mA. Part (4): actual ngspice 47 operating-point, AC and transient runs succeeded. An independent six-node complex admittance matrix retains C1, C2, bypass C and the Rg3/divider network, reproducing gain −3.35499766−j0.01667836 at 1 kHz with KCL residual below 7×10⁻18 A. A least-squares sine/cosine/constant fit over 7–10 ms differs from AC gain times 10 mV by about 0.0046%.

4.5.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第148页／PDF第181页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 148 / PDF p. 181. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.5.1（源电压增益不要求）Assigned requirement: 4.5.1 (source voltage gain not required)

源极跟随器：先剔除平方方程的无效根Source follower: reject the invalid square-law root first

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.5.1a所示，设电路参数为V_DD=12 V，R_g1=150 kΩ，R_g2=450 kΩ，R_s=1 kΩ，R_si=10 kΩ。MOS管参数为V_TN=1.5 V，K_n=2 mA/V²，λ=0。试求（1）静态工作点Q；（2）电压增益A_v和源电压增益A_vs；（3）输入电阻R_i和输出电阻R_o。For Fig. 4.5.1(a), V_DD=12 V, R_g1=150 kΩ, R_g2=450 kΩ, R_s=1 kΩ and R_si=10 kΩ. MOS parameters: V_TN=1.5 V, K_n=2 mA/V², λ=0. Find (1) the bias point Q; (2) voltage gain A_v and source voltage gain A_vs; (3) input resistance R_i and output resistance R_o.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

NMOS共漏极源极跟随器：漏极接12 V，源极经1 kΩ接地并取输出；栅极150 kΩ上拉、450 kΩ下拉，10 kΩ内阻信号源通过耦合电容接栅。NMOS source follower: drain at 12 V, source through 1 kΩ to ground with output at source, gate divider 150 kΩ upper/450 kΩ lower, and input through a coupling capacitor from a source with 10 kΩ resistance.

本题图在书第121页／PDF第154页。The source figure is on printed p. 121 / PDF p. 154.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

栅极分压；源极跟随器平方律偏置；过驱动正值；小信号KCL。Gate divider; square-law source-follower bias; positive overdrive; small-signal KCL.
先把I_D写成源极电压反馈后的平方方程。平方会产生不满足V_GS>V_TN的根，必须筛选。再由有效工作点求g_m。Write the square-law equation including source-voltage feedback. Squaring can produce a root with V_GS below threshold; reject it before finding g_m.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）分压及偏置方程(1) Divider and bias equation

栅极电位9 V，源极电位为I_D R_s。若I_D用mA表示，则V_GS=9−I_D。Gate voltage is 9 V and source voltage is I_D R_s. With I_D in mA, V_GS=9−I_D.

VG=12450150+450=9V;ID=2(7.5−ID)2[ID in mA]

选择物理根并核对恒流区Choose the physical root and check saturation

两根约5.79744、9.70256 mA。第二根使V_GS−V_TN<0，不能使用导通平方律，舍去。有效根给V_GS≈3.20256 V、V_DS≈6.20256 V；V_DS大于过驱动1.70256 V，恒流区成立。The roots are about 5.79744 and 9.70256 mA. The second has negative overdrive, so the on-state square law does not apply and that root is rejected. The valid root gives V_GS≈3.20256 V and V_DS≈6.20256 V, exceeding the 1.70256 V overdrive.

IDQ=31−614≈5.79744mA;VGSQ≈3.20256V;VDSQ≈6.20256V

（2）求两种增益(2) Find both gains

互导约6.81025 mS。源极跟随器同相且电压增益小于1。源电压增益另考虑10 kΩ信号源内阻。课程不要求源电压增益，但为完整覆盖教材小问仍给出。Transconductance is about 6.81025 mS. The source follower is non-inverting with gain below one. Source gain also includes the 10 kΩ source resistance. Although the course excludes A_vs for this exercise, it is included to complete the textbook part.

gm=2Kn(VGSQ−VTN)≈6.81025mS;Av=gmRs1+gmRs≈0.871963;Avs=Av112.5112.5+10≈0.800782

（3）求输入输出电阻(3) Find input and output resistances

输入是偏置电阻并联。求输出电阻时信号源置零、输入端栅极交流接地，在源极加测试电压，测试电流为v_t/R_s+g_m v_t。Input resistance is the parallel bias resistors. For output resistance, zero the source and AC-ground the gate. A source-node test voltage draws v_t/R_s+g_m v_t.

Ri=150∥450=112.5kΩ;Ro=Rs∥1gm=10001+6.81025≈128.037Ω

（1）I_DQ≈5.79744 mA，V_GSQ≈3.20256 V，V_DSQ≈6.20256 V；（2）A_v≈0.871963，A_vs≈0.800782；（3）R_i=112.5 kΩ，R_o≈128.037 Ω。(1) I_DQ≈5.79744 mA, V_GSQ≈3.20256 V, V_DSQ≈6.20256 V. (2) A_v≈0.871963, A_vs≈0.800782. (3) R_i=112.5 kΩ, R_o≈128.037 Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能只看到平方方程两根都为正就全保留；还要检查过驱动为正。Two positive roots are not both valid; require positive overdrive.
  • 求R_o时不能保留外部信号，也不能把源极R_s遗漏。Zero the signal when finding R_o and retain the source resistor R_s.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号、λ=0、无额外输出负载、衬底接源。Midband small signal, λ=0, no additional output load, body tied to source.

将有效I_D代回直流平方律、栅源电压和漏源KVL，残差在浮点精度内。独立用源节点测试KCL g_m(1−v_s)=v_s/R_s重求A_v，输出测试KCL重求R_o；0<A_vs<A_v<1，满足跟随器物理趋势。Substitution into the DC square law and gate/source/drain KVL gives floating-point residuals. Independent source-node KCL g_m(1−v_s)=v_s/R_s reproduces A_v, and an output test reproduces R_o. The ordering 0<A_vs<A_v<1 matches a follower.

4.5.5指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第149页／PDF第182页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 149 / PDF p. 182. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.5.5Assigned requirement: 4.5.5

共栅极：静态检查后求同相增益Common gate: check the bias point, then find non-inverting gain

题目原文Transcribed question

共栅极放大电路如图题4.5.5所示。电路参数为V_DD=V_SS=5 V，R_s=10 kΩ，R_d=5 kΩ，R_L=5 kΩ。MOS管参数K_n=3 mA/V²，V_TN=1 V，λ=0。（1）计算静态工作点Q；（2）求g_m；（3）求A_v=v_o/v_i。For the common-gate amplifier in Fig. 4.5.5, V_DD=V_SS=5 V, R_s=10 kΩ, R_d=5 kΩ and R_L=5 kΩ. MOS parameters: K_n=3 mA/V², V_TN=1 V, λ=0. (1) Find Q. (2) Find g_m. (3) Find A_v=v_o/v_i.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

NMOS共栅电路：栅接地，源极经10 kΩ接−5 V并经耦合电容接输入；漏极经5 kΩ接+5 V并经耦合电容接5 kΩ负载到地。衬底接源。NMOS common gate: grounded gate; source through 10 kΩ to −5 V and through a coupling capacitor to input; drain through 5 kΩ to +5 V and through a coupling capacitor to a 5 kΩ grounded load. Body tied to source.

本题图在书第149页／PDF第182页。The source figure is on printed p. 149 / PDF p. 182.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

双电源偏置；平方律选根；共栅极小信号模型。Dual-supply bias; square-law root selection; common-gate small-signal model.
静态时耦合电容断开，R_L不参与偏置；动态时负载经电容并到R_d上。输入v_i已经是实际源极交流电压，不再为R_s乘额外分压。At DC, coupling capacitors are open and R_L does not load the bias. At AC, R_L is in parallel with R_d. Input v_i is already the actual source-node voltage, so no extra R_s division is needed.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）列直流方程(1) Write the DC equation

栅极为0 V，源极V_S=−5+10I_D（I_D以mA计），故过驱动为4−10I_D。The gate is at 0 V and V_S=−5+10I_D with I_D in mA, so overdrive is 4−10I_D.

ID=3(4−10ID)2[ID in mA];VOV=481−160≈0.348862V

选择有效根并检查区域Choose the valid root and check the region

有效根I_D≈0.365114 mA；另一根约0.438220 mA使过驱动为负，舍去。源极约−1.34886 V，漏极约3.17443 V，因此V_GS≈1.34886 V、V_DS≈4.52329 V，远大于过驱动。The valid root is I_D≈0.365114 mA; the other, about 0.438220 mA, gives negative overdrive and is rejected. The source is about −1.34886 V and drain about 3.17443 V, giving V_GS≈1.34886 V and V_DS≈4.52329 V, well above overdrive.

IDQ≈0.365114mA;VGSQ≈1.34886V;VDSQ≈4.52329V

（2）求互导(2) Find transconductance

本书K_n已经含几何因子及1/2，故g_m=2K_n V_OV。The textbook K_n already contains geometry and 1/2, so g_m=2K_n V_OV.

gm=2(3)(0.34886187)≈2.09317mS

（3）求同相电压增益(3) Find non-inverting voltage gain

栅极交流接地，v_gs=−v_i。漏电流增量为−g_mv_i，输出v_o=−i_d(R_d∥R_L)，两次负号给同相增益。The gate is AC-grounded, so v_gs=−v_i and i_d=−g_mv_i. Output v_o=−i_d(R_d∥R_L), giving a positive gain.

Av=gm(Rd∥RL)=2.09317122×2.5≈5.23293

（1）I_DQ≈0.365114 mA，V_GSQ≈1.34886 V，V_DSQ≈4.52329 V；（2）g_m≈2.09317 mS；（3）A_v≈+5.23293，同相。(1) I_DQ≈0.365114 mA, V_GSQ≈1.34886 V, V_DSQ≈4.52329 V. (2) g_m≈2.09317 mS. (3) A_v≈+5.23293, non-inverting.

易错点Common errors

  • R_L被耦合电容隔离，不计入直流漏极电阻。The coupling capacitor isolates R_L at DC; omit it from the DC drain load.
  • V_SS=5 V表示负电源端为−5 V，不是源极电压固定−5 V。V_SS=5 V means the negative rail is −5 V; it does not fix the source node at −5 V.

核验依据Verification

长沟道MOS平方律；λ=0；中频耦合电容短路；衬底接源。Long-channel square-law MOS, λ=0, midband coupling capacitors shorted, body tied to source.

独立以过驱动x代替I_D，解30x²+x−4=0得到同一物理根。再代回R_s、R_d的直流欧姆定律及MOS平方律。交流用漏节点KCL v_o/R_d+v_o/R_L−g_m v_i=0独立得到增益。Independently solving in overdrive x gives 30x²+x−4=0 and the same physical root. Substitution verifies both resistor DC laws and the MOS square law. Independent drain-node KCL v_o/R_d+v_o/R_L−g_m v_i=0 reproduces the AC gain.

5.1.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第183页／PDF第216页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 183 / PDF p. 216. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5.1.1Assigned requirement: 5.1.1

由三端电位识别PNP与电极Identify a PNP and its terminals from three voltages

题目原文Transcribed question

测得某放大电路中处于放大状态的BJT的三个电极A、B、C的对地电位分别为V_A=−9 V，V_B=−6 V，V_C=−6.2 V，试分析A、B、C中哪个是基极b、发射极e、集电极c，并说明此BJT是NPN型管还是PNP型管。An amplifying circuit has a BJT operating in its forward-active region. Its terminal voltages relative to ground are V_A=−9 V, V_B=−6 V and V_C=−6.2 V. Identify the base b, emitter e and collector c among A, B and C, and determine whether the transistor is NPN or PNP.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT放大区：发射结正偏、集电结反偏；带负号电位排序。Forward-active BJT: forward-biased emitter junction, reverse-biased collector junction; ordering negative voltages.
先找只差约0.2 V的一对作为发射结，再用另一结必须反偏来排除错误极性。不能强加硅管0.7 V条件。First identify the pair separated by about 0.2 V as the emitter junction, then use reverse collector-junction bias to reject the wrong polarity. Do not impose a 0.7 V silicon drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

判断发射结Identify the emitter junction

B端−6 V比C端−6.2 V高0.2 V。若为PNP，较高电位的P区B端可作发射极，C端为N区基极，满足发射结正偏。这里字母B是题目端点标签，不是基极的缩写。Terminal B at −6 V is 0.2 V above terminal C at −6.2 V. For PNP, the higher P-type terminal B can be emitter and C the N-type base, forward-biasing the emitter junction. The capital letter B is only a terminal label, not the base designation.

VE=VB=−6V;Vb=VC=−6.2V;VEb=0.2V>0

检查集电结并排除NPNCheck collector bias and reject NPN

剩下A端−9 V是PNP的P区集电极，它比N区基极低2.8 V，集电结反偏。若把B作NPN基极、C作发射极，则A集电极低于基极，集电结正偏，不符合题设放大区。The remaining A terminal at −9 V is the PNP collector, 2.8 V below the N-type base, so the collector junction is reverse-biased. Assigning B as an NPN base and C as emitter would forward-bias the collector junction because A is below the base, contradicting forward-active operation.

VCb=VA−VC=−9−(−6.2)=−2.8V<0(PNP collector junction reverse-biased)

A为集电极c，B为发射极e，C为基极b；PNP型BJT。A is collector c, B is emitter e, C is base b; PNP BJT.

易错点Common errors

  • −6 V高于−6.2 V和−9 V；不能按绝对值排序。−6 V is above −6.2 V and −9 V; do not order by magnitude.
  • 题目的端点B不是基极b；大小写标签不可混用。Problem terminal B is not automatically base b; keep the labels distinct.

核验依据Verification

题设BJT处于正常放大区；不预设硅管固定0.7 V压降。The stated normal forward-active BJT condition; no assumed fixed 0.7 V silicon drop.

独立检查PNP两结偏置：V_E−V_b=+0.2 V，发射结正偏；V_c−V_b=−2.8 V，集电结反偏。检查NPN替代分配会使集电结正偏，故排除。未据0.2 V电压差断言具体材料。Independently checked both PNP junctions: V_E−V_b=+0.2 V gives forward emitter bias, and V_c−V_b=−2.8 V gives reverse collector bias. The alternative NPN assignment forward-biases the collector junction and is rejected. No material is inferred solely from the 0.2 V drop.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第183页／PDF第216页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 183 / PDF p. 216. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5.1.3Assigned requirement: 5.1.3

用同一组电流定义计算β与αCompute beta and alpha from consistent terminal currents

题目原文Transcribed question

设某BJT处于放大状态。（1）若基极电流i_B=6 μA，集电极电流i_C=510 μA，试求β、α及i_E；（2）如果i_B=50 μA，i_C=2.65 mA，试求β、α及i_E。A BJT operates in its forward-active region. (1) If i_B=6 μA and i_C=510 μA, find β, α and i_E. (2) If i_B=50 μA and i_C=2.65 mA, find β, α and i_E.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT电流KCL；β=i_C/i_B；α=i_C/i_E；单位换算。BJT current KCL; β=i_C/i_B; α=i_C/i_E; unit conversion.
先把电流统一单位，再用i_E=i_C+i_B；β与α分母不同。不要把第（2）问已知的i_C误读成i_E。First use consistent units and i_E=i_C+i_B. Beta and alpha have different denominators. Do not misread the given i_C in part (2) as i_E.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一定义Use consistent definitions

本章按正向放大状态的电流大小计算；发射极电流为基极与集电极之和。Use positive current magnitudes in forward-active operation. Emitter current is the sum of base and collector currents.

iE=iC+iB;β=iCiB;α=iCiE=β1+β

（1）计算(1) Calculate

两电流均以μA计，直接相加与相除。Both currents are in μA; add and divide directly.

iE=510+6=516μA;β=510/6=85;α=510/516=85/86≈0.988372

（2）先换单位(2) Convert units first

i_C=2.65 mA=2650 μA；加上50 μA得到发射极2.70 mA。i_C=2.65 mA=2650 μA. Add 50 μA to obtain emitter current 2.70 mA.

iE=2650+50=2700μA=2.70mA;β=2650/50=53;α=2650/2700=53/54≈0.981481

（1）β=85，α=85/86≈0.988372，i_E=516 μA；（2）β=53，α=53/54≈0.981481，i_E=2.70 mA。(1) β=85, α=85/86≈0.988372, i_E=516 μA. (2) β=53, α=53/54≈0.981481, i_E=2.70 mA.

易错点Common errors

  • 第（2）问原书给的是集电极i_C=2.65 mA，不是发射极。Part (2) gives collector current i_C=2.65 mA, not emitter current.
  • α小于1，而β通常远大于1；两者不要互换。Alpha is below one, while beta is typically much larger than one; do not interchange them.

核验依据Verification

正常放大区电流大小，忽略题中未给出的漏电流修正。Forward-active current magnitudes, with no unspecified leakage correction.

独立用α=β/(1+β)复算两组结果；再以i_E(1−α)恢复i_B为6 μA和50 μA，i_Eα恢复i_C为510 μA和2.65 mA。Independently recomputed both alpha values using α=β/(1+β). Then i_E(1−α) recovers base currents 6 μA and 50 μA, while i_Eα recovers collector currents 510 μA and 2.65 mA.

指定要求：5.2.2Assigned requirement: 5.2.2

开关偏置：先比较βI_B与负载限流Switched bias: compare beta times base current with load-limited current

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题5.2.2所示，设BJT的β=80，V_BE=0.6 V，I_CEO、V_CES可忽略不计，试分析当开关S分别接通A、B、C三位置时，BJT各工作在其输出特性曲线的哪个区域，并求出相应的集电极电流I_C。For Fig. 5.2.2, β=80, V_BE=0.6 V, and I_CEO and V_CES are negligible. For switch positions A, B and C, identify the BJT operating region and find collector current I_C.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

NPN发射极接地，集电极通过4 kΩ接+12 V；基极开关A经40 kΩ接+12 V，B经500 kΩ接+12 V，C经20 kΩ接−12 V。NPN emitter grounded, collector through 4 kΩ to +12 V. Switch A biases the base through 40 kΩ to +12 V, B through 500 kΩ to +12 V, and C through 20 kΩ to −12 V.

本题图在书第184页／PDF第217页。The source figure is on printed p. 184 / PDF p. 217.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT分段模型；基极回路KVL；集电极负载上限。Piecewise BJT model; base-loop KVL; collector load-current limit.
不能在所有状态都写I_C=βI_B。先算负载允许的最大集电极电流，再试放大区，超过上限就改为饱和。I_C=βI_B does not hold in every state. First compute the collector current allowed by the load, then test forward-active operation; exceeding the load limit implies saturation.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

集电极限流Collector-current limit

忽略饱和压降时，集电极降到0 V，4 kΩ电阻最大电流为3 mA。With negligible saturation voltage, the collector reaches 0 V and the 4 kΩ resistor limits current to 3 mA.

IC,sat=12/(4kΩ)=3mA

A：基极驱动过强，饱和A: excessive base drive, saturation

40 kΩ使基极电流0.285 mA，假设放大区会要求22.8 mA，远超3 mA，故饱和。实际I_C由负载决定。The 40 kΩ resistor supplies 0.285 mA base current. An active-state calculation would demand 22.8 mA, exceeding 3 mA, so the transistor saturates and the load sets I_C.

IB=(12−0.6)/40kΩ=0.285mA;βIB=22.8mA>3mA;IC=3mA

B：检查放大区B: check forward-active operation

500 kΩ给出22.8 μA基流，集电流1.824 mA。集电极4.704 V高于基极0.6 V，集电结反偏，放大区成立。500 kΩ gives 22.8 μA base current and 1.824 mA collector current. The collector is at 4.704 V, above the 0.6 V base, so the collector junction is reverse-biased.

IB=22.8μA;IC=80IB=1.824mA;VC=12−1.824×4=4.704V

C：反向偏置，简化模型截止C: reverse base bias, cutoff in the simplified model

C接−12 V，基极低于接地发射极，不满足发射结正偏；按题设忽略漏电流的截止模型，I_C=0。这个答案采用本题分段模型，不扩展到未给出的反向击穿参数。C connects to −12 V, placing the base below the grounded emitter, so the emitter junction is not forward-biased. Under the stated no-leakage cutoff model, I_C=0; no unspecified reverse-breakdown model is assumed.

IC=0(simplified cutoff model)

A：饱和区，I_C=3 mA；B：放大区，I_C=1.824 mA；C：截止区，I_C=0（题设简化模型）。A: saturation, I_C=3 mA. B: forward-active, I_C=1.824 mA. C: cutoff, I_C=0 under the stated simplified model.

易错点Common errors

  • 饱和区的实际I_C不能继续用βI_B计算。Do not use βI_B for actual collector current in saturation.

核验依据Verification

按题设恒定V_BE和忽略漏电流/饱和压降的分段BJT模型；开关C按无反向击穿的简化截止模型。Piecewise BJT model with stated constant V_BE and negligible leakage/saturation voltage; switch C uses the simplified cutoff model without reverse breakdown.

独立检查A的负载KVL为3 mA×4 kΩ=12 V；B的基极KVL为22.8 μA×500 kΩ+0.6=12 V，集电结反偏；C的简化截止解满足I_CEO=0。Independently checked A load KVL, 3 mA×4 kΩ=12 V; B base KVL, 22.8 μA×500 kΩ+0.6=12 V, with reverse collector bias; C follows the zero-I_CEO cutoff model.
