来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第184页／PDF第217页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 184 / PDF p. 217. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5.2.4Assigned requirement: 5.2.4

强射极退化的共射：输入电阻含(β+1)R_eDegenerated common emitter: input resistance includes (beta+1)Re

题目原文Transcribed question

在图题5.2.4电路中，设V_CC=V_EE=12 V，R_c=4 kΩ，R_e=6.2 kΩ，BJT的β=100，V_BEQ=0.7 V。（1）估算Q点；（2）求A_v、R_i和R_o。For Fig. 5.2.4, V_CC=V_EE=12 V, R_c=4 kΩ, R_e=6.2 kΩ, β=100 and V_BEQ=0.7 V. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Find A_v, R_i and R_o.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

NPN基极由理想信号源接地参考，集电极经4 kΩ接+12 V，发射极经6.2 kΩ接−12 V，输出在集电极。NPN base driven by an ideal ground-referenced source; collector through 4 kΩ to +12 V; emitter through 6.2 kΩ to −12 V; collector output.

本题图在书第185页／PDF第218页。The source figure is on printed p. 185 / PDF p. 218.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

双电源直流偏置；BJT电流KCL；r_be模型；未旁路发射极反馈。Dual-supply bias; BJT current KCL; r_be model; unbypassed emitter degeneration.
基极静态为0 V，先求发射极电流。交流时R_e未旁路，不能把输入电阻写成r_be，也不能把增益写成−βR_c/r_be。The DC base voltage is zero, so find emitter current first. R_e is unbypassed at AC; neither R_i=r_be nor A_v=−βR_c/r_be applies.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）直流工作点(1) DC operating point

V_BQ=0，V_EQ=−0.7 V，R_e上电压11.3 V。保留β有限时I_C=βI_E/(β+1)。V_BQ=0 and V_EQ=−0.7 V, so the emitter resistor sees 11.3 V. Retain finite beta using I_C=βI_E/(β+1).

IEQ=11.3/6.2kΩ≈1.82258mA;ICQ≈1.80454mA;VCEQ=24−IERe−ICRc≈5.48186V

检查放大区Check forward-active operation

集电极V_C≈4.78186 V，基极0 V，集电结反偏；发射结0.7 V正偏，工作点成立。若按I_C≈I_E估算，则得到I_C≈1.823 mA、V_CE≈5.410 V。Collector voltage is about 4.78186 V, above the 0 V base; the collector junction is reverse-biased and the emitter junction has 0.7 V forward bias. Using I_C≈I_E instead gives approximately 1.823 mA and V_CE≈5.410 V.

VC=12−4kΩIC≈4.78186V>VB=0

（2）小信号参数(2) Small-signal parameter

采用授课课件第5章第41页常用估算r_bb′≈200 Ω、室温V_T=26 mV。题目未给实际r_bb′，所报小信号数值依赖此课程模型。Use the course slide 41 convention r_bb′≈200 Ω and room-temperature V_T=26 mV. Actual r_bb′ is not given, so the reported small-signal values depend on this course model.

rbe≈200+(1+β)26mVIEQ≈1640.814Ω

输入电阻和增益Input resistance and gain

基极输入电压需同时承担r_be压降与发射极电阻上的(β+1)i_b R_e，故分母包含反馈电阻的放大反映。输出为−βi_bR_c。The base input supplies both i_b r_be and emitter drop (β+1)i_b R_e. The output is −βi_bR_c.

Ri=rbe+(1+β)Re≈627.841kΩ;Av=−βRcrbe+(1+β)Re≈−0.637104

输出电阻Output resistance

忽略晶体管输出电阻，输入源置零后输出测试电压不会改变基极电流，输出见R_c。Taking r_o→∞ (neglecting the Early effect), a collector test voltage with the input zeroed does not change base current; the output sees R_c.

Ro=Rc=4kΩ

保留有限β：I_CQ≈1.80454 mA，V_CEQ≈5.48186 V；按课件r_bb′≈200 Ω、V_T=26 mV：A_v≈−0.637104，R_i≈627.841 kΩ，R_o=4 kΩ。With finite beta: I_CQ≈1.80454 mA and V_CEQ≈5.48186 V. With course r_bb′≈200 Ω and V_T=26 mV: A_v≈−0.637104, R_i≈627.841 kΩ, R_o=4 kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • R_e没有旁路，计算交流通路时不能删掉。R_e is not bypassed and must remain in the AC circuit.

核验依据Verification

恒V_BE=0.7 V，保留有限β；中频、r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV、忽略晶体管输出电阻。Constant V_BE=0.7 V with finite beta; midband, r_bb′=200 Ω, V_T=26 mV, the Early effect neglected (r_o→∞).

独立以1 V基极输入列KCL：i_b=1/[r_be+(β+1)R_e]，i_e=(β+1)i_b，v_o=−βi_bR_c，与结果一致；直流分别验证两结偏置和双电源KVL。Independent KCL with a 1 V base test gives i_b=1/[r_be+(β+1)R_e], i_e=(β+1)i_b and v_o=−βi_bR_c. Both DC junction biases and dual-rail KVL also check.

5.2.7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第185页／PDF第218页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 185 / PDF p. 218. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5.2.7(1)(2)(3)Assigned requirement: 5.2.7(1)(2)(3)

PNP共射极：用带符号电压判断失真PNP common emitter: use signed voltage to classify clipping

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题5.2.7a所示，已知BJT的β=100，V_BEQ=−0.7 V。（1）试估算该电路的Q点；（2）画出小信号等效电路；（3）求该电路的电压增益A_v、输入电阻R_i、输出电阻R_o；（4）若v_o出现图题5.2.7b所示的失真现象，问是截止失真还是饱和失真？为消除此失真，应调整电路中的哪个元件？如何调整？ 图中：电源−12 V，R_b=300 kΩ，R_c=2 kΩ，R_L=4 kΩ；信号源内阻R_si未给数值。图b为输出负半周被削平。For Fig. 5.2.7(a), β=100 and V_BEQ=−0.7 V. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Draw the small-signal equivalent. (3) Find voltage gain A_v, input resistance R_i and output resistance R_o. (4) If v_o has the distortion in Fig. 5.2.7(b), determine whether it is cutoff or saturation distortion, and identify the component and adjustment needed to eliminate it. Figure values: −12 V rail, R_b=300 kΩ, R_c=2 kΩ and R_L=4 kΩ; source resistance R_si is unspecified. Figure (b) clips the negative output half-cycle.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

PNP发射极接地，基极通过300 kΩ接−12 V，集电极通过2 kΩ接−12 V；耦合电容输入与输出，输出负载4 kΩ接地。右图输出负半周削平。Grounded-emitter PNP, base through 300 kΩ to −12 V, collector through 2 kΩ to −12 V, input/output coupling capacitors, and 4 kΩ grounded output load. The right waveform clips on its negative half-cycle.

本题图在书第186页／PDF第219页。The source figure is on printed p. 186 / PDF p. 219.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

PNP带符号偏置；共射极小信号模型；截止/饱和边界。Signed PNP bias; common-emitter small-signal model; cutoff and saturation boundaries.
PNP电流大小先取正值算，再恢复V_CE的负号。交流增益仍反相；用含R_L的交流负载线判断削平方向，不能把有载中频波形的截止边界直接设为负电源电压。Compute positive PNP current magnitudes first, then restore the negative V_CE. The AC gain still inverts. Use the AC load line including R_L to classify clipping; do not set the cutoff boundary of the loaded midband waveform directly to the negative supply rail.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）Q点(1) Bias point

发射极0 V，基极−0.7 V，基极电阻上电压11.3 V。The emitter is at 0 V and base at −0.7 V, leaving 11.3 V across R_b.

|IBQ|=11.3/300kΩ=37.6667μA;|ICQ|=3.76667mA;VCEQ=−12+|IC|2kΩ=−4.46667V

检查两结偏置Check both junction biases

基极−0.7 V，集电极−4.46667 V，PNP集电极低于基极，集电结反偏，放大区成立。The PNP collector at −4.46667 V is below the −0.7 V base; its collector junction is reverse-biased, consistent with forward-active operation.

VCB=−4.46667−(−0.7)=−3.76667V<0

（2）小信号等效(2) Small-signal equivalent

中频电容短路，−12 V为交流地。发射极交流接地，基极r_be与R_b并联接地；集电极R_c与R_L并联接地。晶体管用r_be和从集电极到发射极的受控增量电流βi_b表示，i_b定义为流入基极的带符号增量。信号源保留串联R_si。At midband the capacitors are shorts and −12 V is AC ground. The emitter is grounded; r_be and R_b are parallel to ground at the base; R_c and R_L are parallel to ground at the collector. Model the transistor by r_be and controlled incremental current βi_b from collector to emitter, with i_b defined as the signed current increment entering the base. Retain source resistance R_si.

rbe≈200+101×26mV3.80433mA≈890.265Ω

（3）增益和电阻(3) Gain and resistances

A_v以实际输入v_i定义，不需要未给值的R_si；输入电阻需并联300 kΩ偏置电阻，不能只报r_be。A_v is defined from actual input v_i, so the unspecified R_si is not needed. Input resistance includes the 300 kΩ bias resistor in parallel, rather than r_be alone.

Av=−β(Rc∥RL)rbe≈−149.768;Ri=300kΩ∥890.265Ω≈887.631Ω;Ro=2kΩ

（4）带负载交流负载线：负向削平为截止(4) Loaded AC load line: negative clipping is cutoff

在中频近似下，输出耦合电容的直流电压约保持Q点值，故v_o=v_C−V_CQ。令I_CQ=3.76667 mA表示静态集电流大小，j_C为PNP从发射极流向集电极的瞬时电流大小，集电极KCL给j_C=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L)。截止时j_C=0，所以v_o约为−5.0222 V，为负向极限；对应瞬时v_C约−9.4889 V，并非−12 V。饱和端则是集电极趋近发射极，对应正输出。图b的负向削平因此是截止失真。减小R_b可提高静态电流、增加截止端的交流摆幅余量；调整后仍须检查饱和端余量。该负载线用于给定Q点附近的中频近似，题目未给信号幅度、频率和电容数值，不能据此精确预测大失真后的整个稳态波形。At midband, the output coupling capacitor approximately retains its quiescent DC voltage, so v_o=v_C−V_CQ. Let I_CQ=3.76667 mA denote the quiescent collector-current magnitude, and let j_C be the instantaneous PNP current magnitude flowing from emitter to collector. Collector KCL gives j_C=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L). At cutoff j_C=0, giving v_o≈−5.0222 V: the negative swing limit. The corresponding instantaneous collector voltage is about −9.4889 V, not −12 V. At the saturation end the collector approaches the emitter, producing positive output. The negative clipping in Fig. (b) is therefore cutoff distortion. Decreasing R_b raises bias current and increases cutoff-side AC headroom; recheck saturation-side headroom after adjustment. This is a midband load-line approximation about the stated Q point. Signal amplitude, frequency and capacitance values are unspecified, so it is not an exact prediction of the entire steady-state waveform after strong clipping.

Rac=Rc∥RL=43kΩ;jC=ICQ+voRac;vo,cut=−ICQRac≈−5.02222V;vC,cut=VCQ+vo,cut≈−9.48889V

共射极增量等效图：输入端r_be并R_b接地；输出端R_c并R_L接地，受控增量电流βi_b从集电极到交流接地发射极。Common-emitter incremental equivalent: r_be parallel R_b at the input, R_c parallel R_L at the output, and controlled incremental current βi_b from collector to AC-grounded emitter.

（1）|I_CQ|≈3.76667 mA，V_CEQ≈−4.46667 V；（2）见小信号等效图；（3）采用r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV：A_v≈−149.768，R_i≈887.631 Ω，R_o=2 kΩ；（4）截止失真，减小R_b提高偏置电流，并复查饱和余量。(1) |I_CQ|≈3.76667 mA, V_CEQ≈−4.46667 V. (2) See the equivalent. (3) With r_bb′=200 Ω and V_T=26 mV: A_v≈−149.768, R_i≈887.631 Ω, R_o=2 kΩ. (4) Cutoff distortion; decrease R_b to raise bias current, then recheck saturation headroom.

易错点Common errors

  • PNP的V_CE为负，不能只给其绝对值而不说明。PNP V_CE is negative; do not silently give only its magnitude.
  • R_i=r_be∥R_b；忽略R_b只是一种数值近似。R_i=r_be∥R_b; omitting R_b is only a numerical approximation.
  • 输出耦合电容隔直但传递交流，截止摆幅要用R_c∥R_L的交流负载线，不能直接用直流负载线的−12 V端点。The output coupling capacitor blocks DC but passes AC. Use the R_c∥R_L AC load line for cutoff swing; do not directly use the −12 V endpoint of the DC load line.

核验依据Verification

直流取恒V_BE=−0.7 V及有限β。交流取中频、r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV；忽略厄利效应，即晶体管r_o→∞。失真方向按含R_L、耦合电容近似保留Q点直流电压的交流负载线判断；不声称精确预测任意频率或强失真后的完整波形。DC uses constant V_BE=−0.7 V and finite beta. AC uses midband operation, r_bb′=200 Ω and V_T=26 mV; neglect the Early effect, taking transistor r_o→∞. Clipping direction uses the AC load line including R_L, with the coupling capacitor approximately retaining its quiescent DC voltage. This does not claim an exact complete waveform at arbitrary frequency or after strong distortion.

独立重算直流电阻KVL与PNP两结偏置；采用带符号的流入基极增量电流，r_be、βi_b方向与反相增益一致。交流以v_i=1 mV列集电极KCL回算A_v。失真方向改用含R_L的交流负载线复核：耦合电容保持Q点直流电压时j_C=(v_C+12)/R_c+v_o/R_L=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L)；令j_C=0得到v_o≈−5.02222 V、v_C≈−9.48889 V，原电路KCL残差为0，负向削平是截止。不能用V_C→−12 V代替有载中频波形的核验。Independently recomputed DC resistor KVL and both PNP junction biases. With the signed incremental current entering the base, the r_be and βi_b references are consistent with the inverting gain. A 1 mV AC test input and collector KCL reproduce A_v. Clipping direction was independently checked with the AC load line including R_L: with the coupling capacitor retaining its quiescent DC voltage, j_C=(v_C+12)/R_c+v_o/R_L=I_CQ+v_o/(R_c∥R_L). Setting j_C=0 gives v_o≈−5.02222 V and v_C≈−9.48889 V, satisfying the original collector KCL with zero residual and establishing negative clipping as cutoff. V_C→−12 V is not used as the loaded midband waveform check.

5.2.8指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第186页／PDF第219页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 186 / PDF p. 219. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5.2.8Assigned requirement: 5.2.8

射极偏置：基极加载不可在精确复核时漏掉Emitter bias: retain base loading in the checked solution

题目原文Transcribed question

射极偏置电路如图题5.2.8所示，已知β=60。（1）用估算法求Q点；（2）求BJT的输入电阻r_be；（3）用小信号模型分析法求电压增益A_v；（4）电路其他参数不变，如果要使V_CEQ=4 V，问基极上偏流电阻R_b1为多大？ 图中：V_CC=16 V，R_b1=60 kΩ，R_b2=20 kΩ，R_c=3 kΩ，R_e=2 kΩ，R_L=6 kΩ；输入、输出耦合电容各30 μF，射极旁路50 μF，BJT标为3DG4。For the emitter-biased circuit in Fig. 5.2.8, β=60. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Find transistor input resistance r_be. (3) Use the small-signal model to find voltage gain A_v. (4) With all other parameters unchanged, find the upper base-bias resistor R_b1 needed for V_CEQ=4 V. Figure values: V_CC=16 V, R_b1=60 kΩ, R_b2=20 kΩ, R_c=3 kΩ, R_e=2 kΩ, R_L=6 kΩ; input/output coupling capacitors 30 μF each, emitter bypass 50 μF, transistor 3DG4.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

NPN分压射极偏置：60 kΩ/20 kΩ基极分压，3 kΩ集电极电阻，2 kΩ射极电阻由50 μF旁路；输出耦合到6 kΩ负载。Divider-biased NPN: 60 kΩ/20 kΩ base divider, 3 kΩ collector resistor, 2 kΩ emitter resistor bypassed by 50 μF, and output coupled to 6 kΩ.

本题图在书第186页／PDF第219页。The source figure is on printed p. 186 / PDF p. 219.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

分压器戴维南等效；有限β的基极加载；旁路射极共射增益。Divider Thevenin equivalent; finite-beta base loading; bypassed-emitter common-emitter gain.
分压器戴维南电阻15 kΩ相对(β+1)R_e=122 kΩ并非完全可忽略。主解保留基极加载，并另给常见忽略加载估算，避免混用两组Q点。Divider resistance 15 kΩ is not entirely negligible beside (β+1)R_e=122 kΩ. The checked main solution retains base loading and separately identifies the common unloaded-divider estimate, avoiding mixed bias points.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）估算模型中保留分压加载(1) Retain divider loading in the estimate

取硅BJT恒V_BE≈0.7 V，分压等效V_TH=4 V、R_TH=15 kΩ。由基极回路求I_B，再得I_C、I_E。Use silicon constant V_BE≈0.7 V. The divider gives V_TH=4 V and R_TH=15 kΩ. Solve the base loop, then find I_C and I_E.

IB=4−0.715kΩ+61(2kΩ)≈24.0876μA;IC≈1.44526mA;IE≈1.46934mA

求V_CE并说明常见近似Find V_CE and identify the common approximation

保留加载时V_E≈2.93869 V、V_C≈11.66423 V，V_CE≈8.72555 V；两结偏置满足放大区。若课堂直接忽略基流对分压器的加载并取I_C≈I_E，则得I_C≈1.65 mA、V_CE≈7.75 V；这是一组精度较低的另一近似，不能拿它与主解的r_be交叉混用。With loading retained, V_E≈2.93869 V, V_C≈11.66423 V and V_CE≈8.72555 V; both junction biases satisfy forward-active operation. Ignoring divider loading and taking I_C≈I_E instead gives about 1.65 mA and 7.75 V. This lower-accuracy approximation must not be mixed with the main solution’s r_be.

VCEQ=16−3kΩIC−2kΩIE≈8.72555V

（2）求r_be(2) Find r_be

按课件常用r_bb′≈200 Ω、V_T=26 mV，始终使用主解的I_E。Use course r_bb′≈200 Ω and V_T=26 mV, consistently with the main solution’s I_E.

rbe≈200+61(26mV)1.46934mA≈1279.394Ω

（3）求增益(3) Find gain

中频射极旁路有效，发射极交流接地；负载并到集电极电阻，R_c∥R_L=2 kΩ。At midband, the emitter bypass grounds the emitter at AC. The collector load is R_c∥R_L=2 kΩ.

Av=−β(Rc∥RL)rbe=−60(2kΩ)1279.394Ω≈−93.7944

（4）先由目标V_CE反求I_B(4) Recover I_B from the target V_CE

保留β有限，V_CE=16−I_B[βR_c+(β+1)R_e]。目标4 V给出I_B≈39.7351 μA和V_B≈5.54768 V。With finite beta, V_CE=16−I_B[βR_c+(β+1)R_e]. The 4 V target gives I_B≈39.7351 μA and V_B≈5.54768 V.

IB=16−460(3kΩ)+61(2kΩ)=12302kΩ;VB=0.7+61IB(2kΩ)≈5.54768V

基极KCL求R_b1并回代Use base KCL for R_b1, then substitute back

上电阻电流必须同时提供下分压电流和基流。用目标V_B及I_B解R_b1，得到约32.96 kΩ。若忽略基极加载并取I_C≈I_E，常见粗略结果约38.18 kΩ，代回有限β模型不会得到精确4 V。The upper resistor must supply both lower-divider current and base current. Using target V_B and I_B gives about 32.96 kΩ. The common unloaded-divider estimate of about 38.18 kΩ does not reproduce exactly 4 V in the finite-beta model.

16−VBRb1=VB20kΩ+IB;Rb1≈32.9602kΩ

按V_BE=0.7 V并保留有限β加载：（1）I_CQ≈1.44526 mA，V_CEQ≈8.72555 V；（2）r_be≈1.27939 kΩ；（3）A_v≈−93.7944；（4）R_b1≈32.9602 kΩ。r_be和A_v另采用课件r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV。With V_BE=0.7 V and finite-beta loading: (1) I_CQ≈1.44526 mA, V_CEQ≈8.72555 V. (2) r_be≈1.27939 kΩ. (3) A_v≈−93.7944. (4) R_b1≈32.9602 kΩ. The small-signal values additionally use course r_bb′=200 Ω and V_T=26 mV.

易错点Common errors

  • 保留加载与忽略加载是不同精度模型，不能把两种结果混合。Loaded and unloaded divider calculations use different approximations; do not mix their results.
  • 设计R_b1时上电阻电流不等于下电阻电流，相差I_B。When designing R_b1, upper and lower resistor currents differ by I_B.

核验依据Verification

恒V_BE=0.7 V，有限β及分压加载；中频、r_bb′=200 Ω、V_T=26 mV，射极旁路有效；忽略厄利效应，即晶体管r_o→∞。Constant V_BE=0.7 V with finite beta and divider loading; midband operation, r_bb′=200 Ω, V_T=26 mV and an effective emitter bypass. Neglect the Early effect, taking transistor r_o→∞.

独立在基极直接写原网络KCL，核对(16−V_B)/60k=V_B/20k+I_B；直流两结偏置均满足放大区。第4问将新R_b1代回原分压网络重新求I_B和V_CE，回得4 V。交流以测试输入列集电极KCL复核增益。Independently checked original-network base KCL, (16−V_B)/60k=V_B/20k+I_B, and both forward-active junction biases. For part (4), re-solving the original divider with the new R_b1 recovers V_CE=4 V. A test-input collector KCL independently verifies the AC gain.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第348页／PDF第381页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 348 / PDF p. 381. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.1.1Assigned requirement: 8.1.1

追踪反馈通路：电容决定直流还是交流Trace feedback paths: capacitors determine DC versus AC feedback

题目原文Transcribed question

在图题8.1.1所示的各电路中，哪些元件组成了级间反馈通路？它们所引入的反馈是正反馈还是负反馈？是直流反馈还是交流反馈（设各电路中电容的容抗对交流信号均可忽略）？For every circuit in Fig. 8.1.1, identify the components forming interstage feedback paths, determine positive or negative feedback, and identify DC and/or AC feedback. Capacitor reactances are negligible for the AC signal.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R₂/R₁反馈到反相端；(b)A₂作电压跟随器，经R₃反馈到A₁反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R₆，其电压返回A₁同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R₁接地，并经R₂回反相求和点，漏极R_d输出；(e)三级共源极，R_f从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T₁与T₃共用R_e1，R_f1/R_f2之间有接地电容C₂，输出经C₃耦合。Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R₂/R₁ feedback to the inverting input; (b) A₂ voltage follower returns through R₃ to A₁ summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R₆ returning to A₁ non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R₁ and R₂ return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with R_f from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T₁/T₃ emitter resistor R_e1, and grounded C₂ at the R_f1/R_f2 junction, with C₃ output coupling.

本题图在书第349页／PDF第382页。The source figure is on printed p. 349 / PDF p. 382.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反馈通路；瞬时极性法；电容直流开路/交流短路。Feedback paths; instantaneous-polarity method; capacitors open at DC and short at AC.
先把输出量扰动，沿返回路径追踪净输入变化；不能只数反相级。含电容的图先分别画直流与中频通路。Perturb the output and trace how the return path changes the net input; counting inversions alone is insufficient. Analyze separate DC and midband circuits where capacitors appear.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) R₁、R₂(a) R₁ and R₂

输出电压增大使反相输入经R₂/R₁分压增大，运放输出及跟随器输出被压低，负反馈。反馈通路无隔直电容，直流、交流都存在。A higher output increases the inverting-input divider voltage, reducing the amplifier/follower output. This is negative feedback at both DC and AC; the return path has no blocking capacitor.

(b) A₂、R₃(b) A₂ and R₃

A₂自身为电压跟随器，输出电压经A₂缓冲、R₃返回A₁反相求和点；输出增大会使A₁输出下降，为负反馈，兼有直流与交流。A₂ is a voltage follower. The output returns through A₂ and R₃ to the inverting summing node of A₁. A positive output change drives A₁ output down: negative feedback at DC and AC.

(c) R₆及其返回导线(c) R₆ and the return connection

负载电流增大使R₆电压增大，A₁同相端增大使A₁输出增大；A₂为反相级，末级输出及负载电流反而减小，为负反馈。R₂、R₅分别是运放局部反馈，R₆构成跨级电流反馈；直流交流都有。Increased load current raises the R₆ voltage and A₁ non-inverting input, increasing A₁ output. A₂ inverts, reducing final output/current: negative feedback. R₂ and R₅ are local op-amp loops; R₆ supplies the interstage current feedback. It acts at DC and AC.

(d) R₁、R₂(d) R₁ and R₂

漏/源电流增大使源极取样电压增大，经R₂提高运放反相端，运放输出下降，抑制MOS电流，为负反馈。反馈通路对直流与交流都存在。Increased MOS drain/source current raises the source-sense voltage. R₂ raises the inverting input, lowering op-amp output and opposing the MOS-current increase. Negative feedback acts at DC and AC.

(e) R_f(e) R_f

末级输出升高经R_f使首级栅极升高，三级共源极放大总反相，末级输出被拉低，为负反馈。电路直接耦合，直流交流都有。A positive final output change raises the first gate through R_f. Three common-source stages invert overall, driving the final output down. Direct coupling permits DC and AC negative feedback.

(f) 两条通路必须分开(f) Separate the two paths

R_e1由T₁、T₃共用，末级电流改变首级射极电位，形成直流和交流的电流串联负反馈。R_f2、R_f1从末级集电极回首级基极，形成直流电压并联负反馈；中频C₂把二者中点交流接地，切断这条跨级交流返回通路，R_f1、R_f2只分别作为输入/输出交流负载。C₁、C₃为输入输出耦合电容。Shared emitter resistor R_e1 links T₁ and T₃, giving DC and AC negative current-series feedback. R_f2 and R_f1 return the final collector voltage to the first base, providing DC negative voltage-shunt feedback. At midband C₂ AC-grounds their junction, interrupting that interstage AC return; R_f1 and R_f2 separately load the input and output. C₁ and C₃ are coupling capacitors.

(a)R₁/R₂、(b)A₂/R₃、(c)R₆、(d)R₁/R₂、(e)R_f均引入负反馈，兼有直流与交流。(f)共用R_e1：直流和交流电流串联负反馈；R_f1/R_f2：仅直流跨级电压并联负反馈，交流被C₂隔断。(a) R₁/R₂, (b) A₂/R₃, (c) R₆, (d) R₁/R₂ and (e) R_f all give negative feedback at DC and AC. (f) Shared R_e1 gives DC/AC current-series negative feedback; R_f1/R_f2 give DC interstage voltage-shunt negative feedback, interrupted at AC by C₂.

易错点Common errors

  • (f)中C₂接地而非串联隔直，它通过交流短路中间节点切断R_f链的信号传输。C₂ in (f) shunts the middle node to AC ground; it is not a series blocking capacitor.
  • 局部反馈与跨级反馈要分清。Distinguish local feedback from interstage feedback.

核验依据Verification

器件处于小信号放大区，运放线性；按题设中频电容短路，直流电容开路。Small-signal active devices and linear op amps; capacitors short at midband and open at DC.

逐图使用输出扰动法，与输入扰动法交叉核对负反馈极性；(f)另按C₂直流开路/交流短路重新画连接，确认交流仍存在共享射极R_e1反馈。Cross-checked output-perturbation and input-perturbation sign tracing for every circuit. For (f), separately redrew C₂ open at DC and short at AC, confirming that shared-emitter R_e1 feedback remains at AC.

8.1.2指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第348页／PDF第381页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 348 / PDF p. 381. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.1.2Assigned requirement: 8.1.2

反馈组态：输出短路测试，加上输入求和方式Feedback topology: output-short test plus input mixing

题目原文Transcribed question

试判断图题8.1.1所示各电路中，级间交流反馈的组态。Determine the interstage AC-feedback topology for every circuit in Fig. 8.1.1.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R₂/R₁反馈到反相端；(b)A₂作电压跟随器，经R₃反馈到A₁反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R₆，其电压返回A₁同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R₁接地，并经R₂回反相求和点，漏极R_d输出；(e)三级共源极，R_f从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T₁与T₃共用R_e1，R_f1/R_f2之间有接地电容C₂，输出经C₃耦合。Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R₂/R₁ feedback to the inverting input; (b) A₂ voltage follower returns through R₃ to A₁ summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R₆ returning to A₁ non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R₁ and R₂ return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with R_f from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T₁/T₃ emitter resistor R_e1, and grounded C₂ at the R_f1/R_f2 junction, with C₃ output coupling.

本题图在书第349页／PDF第382页。The source figure is on printed p. 349 / PDF p. 382.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电压/电流取样；串联/并联混合；交流通路。Voltage/current sampling; series/shunt mixing; AC equivalent circuits.
输出短路后返回量消失的是电压取样，仍可由输出电流产生返回量的是电流取样；再看净输入是电压差还是电流和。If shorting the output removes the feedback signal, sampling is voltage-based. If current still produces feedback, it is current-based. Then identify voltage subtraction versus current summation at the input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)、(b)(a), (b)

(a)输出电压分压送反相端，与同相输入电压相减，是电压串联。(b)输出电压由A₂缓冲后经R₃返回同一个反相求和点，是电压并联。(a) A divided output voltage is subtracted from the non-inverting input: voltage-series. (b) A₂ buffers output voltage and R₃ returns current to the inverting summing node: voltage-shunt.

(c)、(d)(c), (d)

(c)R₆与负载电流串联取样，返回A₁另一个输入端形成电压差，是电流串联。(d)源极支路取样MOS电流，R₂把反馈电流送回与输入R₁共用的求和点，是电流并联。(c) R₆ samples load current and returns a voltage to the other A₁ input: current-series. (d) The source branch samples MOS current, with R₂ returning current to the same summing node as input R₁: current-shunt.

(e)、(f)(e), (f)

(e)R_f跨输出电压与输入栅极求和点，是电压并联。(f)C₂切断电阻链交流跨级返回，剩下共享R_e1取样末级电流并改变首级射极电位，与基极输入相减，是电流串联。(e) R_f connects output voltage to the input gate summing node: voltage-shunt. (f) C₂ interrupts the resistive interstage AC path; shared R_e1 samples final-stage current and changes the first emitter voltage, subtracting from base input: current-series.

(a)电压串联；(b)电压并联；(c)电流串联；(d)电流并联；(e)电压并联；(f)电流串联。各图均为负反馈。(a) Voltage-series. (b) Voltage-shunt. (c) Current-series. (d) Current-shunt. (e) Voltage-shunt. (f) Current-series. All are negative feedback.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要仅凭“反馈电阻接输出端”判断电压反馈，要看被取样的具体电流/电压。A resistor connected near an output does not by itself establish voltage feedback; identify the sampled quantity.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号，题设电容容抗忽略。Midband small signal with negligible capacitor reactance.

输出短路测试与输入混合关系分别核对六图；特别(c)(d)(f)输出短路并不消除各电流取样支路中的反馈信号，(a)(b)(e)则消除电压返回量。Applied output-short and input-mixing tests independently to all six circuits. In particular, shorting the output does not remove the current-sampling signals in (c), (d) and (f), but removes the voltage feedback in (a), (b) and (e).

8.1.7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第351页／PDF第384页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 351 / PDF p. 384. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.1.7Assigned requirement: 8.1.7

差分输入反馈：判断哪一支栅压抵消净输入Differential-input feedback: identify the opposing gate signal

题目原文Transcribed question

试判断图题8.1.7所示各电路中，级间交流反馈的极性及组态。Determine the polarity and topology of the interstage AC feedback in each circuit of Fig. 8.1.7.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

四图均以MOS差分级为输入。(a)T₂栅由末级T₃源电流经过R₃及R₁/R₂分压返回；(b)T₁栅接地，电流源输入T₂栅求和点，末级T₅源电流由R₂取样、经R₁返回；(c)输入T₁栅，T₃为PNP级，反馈由其集电极R₃及R₁/R₂送T₂栅，输出取T₃发射极；(d)末级源极输出直接送T₂栅。Four MOS differential-input circuits: (a) final T₃ source current is sampled by R₃ and divided by R₁/R₂ back to T₂ gate; (b) T₁ gate grounded, current-source input at the T₂ gate summing node, with final T₅ source current sensed by R₂ and returned through R₁; (c) PNP final T₃, collector current sampled through R₃ and R₁/R₂ to T₂ gate, with output at the emitter; (d) final source output directly returns to T₂ gate.

本题图在书第351页／PDF第384页。The source figure is on printed p. 351 / PDF p. 384.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

差分级电流转向；有源负载；电流取样与电压取样；输入混合。Differential current steering; active loads; current/voltage sampling; input mixing.
差分级的两个栅输入极性相反，不能把左右支路都当作普通共源反相级。先追踪电流转向，再追末级和返回信号。The two differential gates have opposite signal signs; do not treat both branches as ordinary common-source stages. Trace current steering, final-stage response, then the return signal.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 电流串联负反馈(a) Negative current-series feedback

T₁输入升高使T₁电流增大、T₂电流减小，T₂漏电压升高，使T₃电流增大。其源极取样电压经R₂/R₁使T₂栅升高，促使T₂电流回升，抵消原来的差分输入；输出电流取样、栅极电压差混合。Raising T₁ gate raises its current and lowers T₂ current, raising T₂ drain voltage and T₃ current. The source-sense voltage divided by R₂/R₁ raises T₂ gate and restores T₂ current, opposing the original differential input. Sampling is current-based and mixing is a gate-voltage difference.

(b) 电流并联负反馈(b) Negative current-shunt feedback

输入电流进入T₂栅求和节点，栅压升高使T₂漏极节点下降，末级T₅电流下降，R₂取样节点下降，经R₁送回的电流减小，抵消输入作用。反馈与输入在同一节点按电流求和。Input current enters the T₂ gate summing node. Increased gate voltage lowers its drain node and final T₅ current; the R₂ sense node falls and returns less current through R₁, opposing the input change. Input and feedback currents mix at one node.

(c) 电流串联负反馈(c) Negative current-series feedback

T₁栅升高使其漏极电压下降，PNP T₃基极下降，集电流大小增大；R₃上取样电压升高，经R₂/R₁提高T₂栅，抵消差分输入。输出取T₃发射极，但反馈取其集电流；不能仅看v_o端位置判断为电压反馈。Raising T₁ gate lowers its drain and the PNP T₃ base, increasing collector-current magnitude. The R₃ sense voltage rises and raises T₂ gate through R₂/R₁, opposing the differential input. The output is at T₃ emitter, but feedback samples collector current; the v_o terminal alone does not make this voltage feedback.

(d) 电压串联负反馈(d) Negative voltage-series feedback

T₁栅升高经差分有源负载使T₅栅升高，源极输出升高；输出直接提高T₂栅，减小差分净输入。输出电压直接取样，与T₁输入构成电压差。Raising T₁ gate raises the T₅ gate through the active-loaded differential stage, raising its source output. Direct return to T₂ gate reduces the differential input. This samples voltage and mixes a voltage difference.

(a)电流串联负反馈；(b)电流并联负反馈；(c)电流串联负反馈；(d)电压串联负反馈。(a) Negative current-series. (b) Negative current-shunt. (c) Negative current-series. (d) Negative voltage-series.

易错点Common errors

  • (c)取样端不是标注v_o的端点，必须检查实际反馈网络。In (c), sampling is not at the labeled v_o terminal; inspect the actual return network.

核验依据Verification

晶体管均工作于小信号放大区；恒流源为理想；差分有源负载按图中连接。All transistors in small-signal active regions, ideal current sources, active loads connected as drawn.

对每图独立做输入正扰动和反馈端正扰动，两者对差分净输入的作用相反；输出短路测试将(a)(b)(c)的电流取样与(d)电压取样区分开。Independently traced positive input and feedback-terminal perturbations; they oppose one another at the differential input. The output-short test separates current sampling in (a), (b), (c) from voltage sampling in (d).

8.2.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第352页／PDF第385页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 352 / PDF p. 385. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.2.1Assigned requirement: 8.2.1

负反馈方框图：分清输入、反馈与净输入Feedback block diagram: distinguish input, feedback and error

题目原文Transcribed question

某反馈放大电路的方框图如图题8.2.1所示，已知其开环电压增益A_v=2000，反馈系数F_v=0.0495。若输出电压v_o=2 V，求输入电压v_i、反馈电压v_f及净输入电压v_id的值。For the feedback amplifier in Fig. 8.2.1, open-loop voltage gain A_v=2000 and feedback factor F_v=0.0495. If v_o=2 V, find input v_i, feedback v_f and net input v_id.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

输入求和点v_id=v_i−v_f，前向增益A_v，输出经F_v返回负号端。Summing junction v_id=v_i−v_f, forward gain A_v, with output returned through F_v to the negative input.

本题图在书第352页／PDF第385页。The source figure is on printed p. 352 / PDF p. 385.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

负反馈方框图代数；反馈深度；增益定义。Feedback block algebra; feedback depth; gain definitions.
已知输出时先沿两条路径分别反求净输入和反馈，再用求和关系求外部输入，最不易混淆。With output known, separately recover error and feedback from the two paths, then use the summing relation for external input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由前向增益求净输入Recover error from forward gain

A_v乘的是净输入v_id，而非外部输入v_i。A_v multiplies net input v_id, not external input v_i.

vid=vo/Av=2/2000=0.001V=1mV

由反馈系数求反馈电压Recover feedback voltage

反馈系数定义v_f/v_o。The feedback factor is v_f/v_o.

vf=Fvvo=0.0495×2=0.099V=99mV

求和及闭环增益复核Sum and check closed-loop gain

负反馈v_id=v_i−v_f，所以外部输入是净输入与反馈之和。Negative feedback means v_id=v_i−v_f, so external input is their sum.

vi=vid+vf=0.100V;Avf=20001+2000(0.0495)=20

v_i=100 mV，v_f=99 mV，v_id=1 mV。v_i=100 mV, v_f=99 mV, v_id=1 mV.

易错点Common errors

  • v_id不是v_i；两者相差反馈电压99 mV。v_id is not v_i; they differ by the 99 mV feedback voltage.

核验依据Verification

线性静态方框图，图中负号连接，给定增益与反馈系数均为实数。Linear static block model with the shown subtractive junction and real stated gains.

独立代回：2000(0.100−0.099)=2 V，0.0495×2=0.099 V；闭环增益2/0.1=20与A/(1+AF)一致。Independent substitution gives 2000(0.100−0.099)=2 V and 0.0495×2=0.099 V. Closed-loop gain 2/0.1=20 matches A/(1+AF).

8.4.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第354页／PDF第387页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 354 / PDF p. 387. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.4.1（闭环电压增益）Assigned requirement: 8.4.1 (closed-loop voltage gain)

深反馈闭环增益：先定义输入输出量及电流方向Deep-feedback gains: define input/output quantities and current signs

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题8.1.1a、b、d、e、f所示，试在深度负反馈条件下，近似计算它们的闭环增益和闭环电压增益。For circuits (a), (b), (d), (e) and (f) of Fig. 8.1.1, approximately calculate their closed-loop gain and closed-loop voltage gain under deep negative feedback.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R₂/R₁反馈到反相端；(b)A₂作电压跟随器，经R₃反馈到A₁反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R₆，其电压返回A₁同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R₁接地，并经R₂回反相求和点，漏极R_d输出；(e)三级共源极，R_f从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T₁与T₃共用R_e1，R_f1/R_f2之间有接地电容C₂，输出经C₃耦合。Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R₂/R₁ feedback to the inverting input; (b) A₂ voltage follower returns through R₃ to A₁ summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R₆ returning to A₁ non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R₁ and R₂ return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with R_f from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T₁/T₃ emitter resistor R_e1, and grounded C₂ at the R_f1/R_f2 junction, with C₃ output coupling.

本题图在书第349页／PDF第382页。The source figure is on printed p. 349 / PDF p. 382.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

深反馈净输入趋零；四种闭环增益单位；节点KCL；反馈网络加载。Near-zero error under deep feedback; units of four gain types; nodal KCL; feedback-network loading.
电压并联的基本闭环增益是跨阻，电流串联是跨导；先定义量，才不会把不同单位的增益当成同一个数。电流取样支路会分流，需列KCL。Voltage-shunt feedback gives a transresistance; current-series feedback gives a transconductance. Define the quantities before comparing gains with different units. Current-sense branches divide current, so use KCL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 电压串联(a) Voltage-series

运放两输入端交流电位近似相等，反馈分压节点等于v_i，输出包含射极跟随器且由总环路校正。The op-amp inputs are nearly equal, so the feedback divider node equals v_i. The overall loop includes and corrects the emitter follower.

Af=Avf=vo/vi≈1+R2/R1

(b) 电压并联(b) Voltage-shunt

A₂为理想电压跟随器，送回R₃的电压为v_o。A₁反相求和点近似零，正输入电流i_i=v_i/R₁由R₃返回输出。A₂ is a voltage follower, returning v_o through R₃. The A₁ summing node is nearly zero; positive input current i_i=v_i/R₁ returns through R₃.

Af=voii≈−R3[Ω];Avf=vovi≈−R3R1

(d) 电流并联：必须保留R₂的反馈电流(d) Current-shunt: retain R₂ feedback current

定义i_i=v_i/R₁流入求和点，i_o=i_D沿漏极流入MOS。运放反相节点≈0，KCL给v_s=−R₂i_i。源极电流分到R₁与R₂两条通路，因此i_D=v_s(1/R₁+1/R₂)，不能只取v_s/R₁。输出v_o=−R_di_D。Define i_i=v_i/R₁ entering the summing node and i_o=i_D entering the MOS drain. The inverting node is nearly zero, so KCL gives v_s=−R₂i_i. Source current divides through both R₁ and R₂, giving i_D=v_s(1/R₁+1/R₂), not just v_s/R₁. Output is v_o=−R_di_D.

Af=iDii≈−(1+R2R1);Avf≈RdR1(1+R2R1)

(e) 电压并联(e) Voltage-shunt

三级放大使总开环反相增益很大，首级栅极求和点近似零，MOS栅电流为零。定义i_i=v_s/R_si，KCL给i_i=−v_o/R_f。电压增益以图中源电压v_s为输入，实际首级栅电压是净输入而非外部信号。With large inverting three-stage gain, the first gate summing node is nearly zero and gate current is zero. Define i_i=v_s/R_si; KCL gives i_i=−v_o/R_f. Voltage gain is referenced to the diagram’s source v_s; the actual first gate voltage is the error, not the external signal.

Af=voii≈−Rf[Ω];Avf=vovs≈−RfRsi

(f) 电流串联，中频输出负载包含R_f2(f) Current-series, with R_f2 loading the output at midband

C₂把电阻链中点交流接地，因此R_f2与R_c3共同加载输出；共享R_e1仍反馈末级电流。采用本章常见深反馈近似：忽略T₁射极增量电流相对T₃，并取T₃集电流≈射极电流，净输入v_be1≈0，故v_e1≈v_i。定义i_o为流入T₃集电极的带符号增量，i_o≈v_i/R_e1；输出v_o=−i_o(R_c3∥R_f2)。C₂ AC-grounds the resistive-chain junction, so R_f2 loads the output in parallel with R_c3. Shared R_e1 still feeds back final-stage current. Use the chapter’s usual deep-feedback approximation: neglect T₁ emitter-current increment relative to T₃, and approximate T₃ collector current by emitter current. Near-zero v_be1 gives v_e1≈v_i. With i_o defined as the signed increment entering the T₃ collector, i_o≈v_i/R_e1, and v_o=−i_o(R_c3∥R_f2).

Af=iovi≈1Re1[S];Avf≈−Rc3∥Rf2Re1

(a)A_f=A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁；(b)A_f≈−R₃ Ω，A_vf≈−R₃/R₁；(d)按所定义电流方向A_f≈−(1+R₂/R₁)，A_vf≈(R_d/R₁)(1+R₂/R₁)；(e)A_f≈−R_f Ω，v_o/v_s≈−R_f/R_si；(f)A_f≈1/R_e1 S，A_vf≈−(R_c3∥R_f2)/R_e1，后者另采用首级射极电流可忽略、末级β大近似。(a) A_f=A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁. (b) A_f≈−R₃ Ω, A_vf≈−R₃/R₁. (d) With defined current signs, A_f≈−(1+R₂/R₁), A_vf≈(R_d/R₁)(1+R₂/R₁). (e) A_f≈−R_f Ω, v_o/v_s≈−R_f/R_si. (f) A_f≈1/R_e1 S, A_vf≈−(R_c3∥R_f2)/R_e1, additionally neglecting first-stage emitter current and assuming large final-stage beta.

易错点Common errors

  • (d)R₂也承载取样电流；漏掉它会把1+R₂/R₁错写为R₂/R₁。R₂ in (d) also carries sense current; omitting it incorrectly changes 1+R₂/R₁ into R₂/R₁.
  • 电流增益正负号依赖所规定的i_o方向，本解已明确方向。Current-gain signs depend on the defined i_o direction, stated here.
  • (f)C₂交流短路后R_f2成为输出负载，不可从交流电路删除。After C₂ becomes an AC short, R_f2 loads the output and must remain.

核验依据Verification

中频深度负反馈，器件放大区、忽略Early效应与沟道长度调制，取器件输出电阻r_o/r_ds→∞；(f)另忽略首级射极电流并近似末级I_C≈I_E。Midband deep negative feedback, active devices and device output resistances r_o/r_ds→∞ (Early effect/channel-length modulation neglected); (f) additionally neglects first-stage emitter current and uses final-stage I_C≈I_E.

(a)(b)(d)(e)独立用理想输入条件列节点KCL，尤其(d)同时检查输入求和节点和MOS源节点；(f)用共享射极节点KCL及输出负载KCL验证所列近似，并明确忽略项。Independently wrote nodal KCL under ideal input conditions for (a), (b), (d), (e), checking both input and MOS-source nodes in (d). For (f), shared-emitter and output-load KCL verify the stated approximation, with neglected terms explicit.

8.4.3指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第355页／PDF第388页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 355 / PDF p. 388. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.4.3Assigned requirement: 8.4.3

按跨级环路判断深反馈，再核对加载Check global loop depth, then loading

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题8.4.3所示，试在深度负反馈的条件下，近似计算它的闭环电压增益。For Fig. 8.4.3, approximately calculate the closed-loop voltage gain under deep negative feedback.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

T₁为NMOS，漏极经R_d接V_DD并驱动PNP T₂基极；T₂发射极经R_e接V_DD，集电极为v_o。T₁源极经R₁接地，并经R₂接v_o；栅极为v_i且R_g接地。NMOS T₁ drain through R_d to V_DD drives PNP T₂ base. T₂ emitter through R_e to V_DD, collector at v_o. T₁ source connects through R₁ to ground and R₂ to v_o. Input v_i is at the gate, with R_g to ground.

本题图在书第355页／PDF第388页。The source figure is on printed p. 355 / PDF p. 388.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS源极KCL；PNP带射极电阻的小信号输入；深反馈近似的适用条件。MOS-source KCL; emitter-degenerated PNP input model; conditions for deep-feedback approximations.
本题问跨级深度负反馈下的近似增益，考试结论为1+R₂/R₁。要把“跨级环路很深”与“仅MOS互导很大”区分；后者单独不能保证反馈分压不被源极电流加载。The requested deep global-feedback approximation gives the exam result 1+R₂/R₁. Distinguish a large interstage loop gain from merely large MOS transconductance; the latter alone does not ensure negligible source-current loading of the divider.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

考试主线：跨级深负反馈的电压增益Exam route: voltage gain with deep global feedback

T₁共源与T₂共射两次反相，输出升高经R₂提高T₁源极，减小净输入v_gs1，为电压串联负反馈。按授课课件的跨级深反馈近似，v_s≈v_i，且首级源极电流相对跨级反馈电流可忽略，R₁/R₂形成近似不加载的反馈分压。因此以实际栅极电压v_i定义的闭环增益如下，R_g不引入额外源分压。Common-source T₁ and common-emitter T₂ invert twice. A higher output raises the T₁ source through R₂ and reduces v_gs1, giving negative voltage-series feedback. Under the course’s deep global-feedback approximation, v_s≈v_i and first-stage source current is negligible relative to interstage feedback current, so R₁/R₂ form an approximately unloaded feedback divider. The gain below is referred to actual gate voltage v_i; R_g adds no source-divider factor.

Fv≈R1R1+R2;Avf≈1Fv=1+R2R1

保留加载：从原图列有限参数KCLRetain loading: finite-parameter KCL from the original

取V_DD为交流地，T₁源极为v_s，T₂带符号基流i_b2定义为流入基极的增量；Z_b=r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e。漏极/基极节点给i_b2=−i_D/(1+Z_b/R_d)，输出节点给(v_o−v_s)/R₂+β₂i_b2=0，源节点给v_s/R₁+(v_s−v_o)/R₂=i_D。再用i_D=g_m1(v_i−v_s)，得到有限参数下的一般增益。With V_DD at AC ground, let v_s be the T₁ source voltage and define signed incremental i_b2 entering the T₂ base. Set Z_b=r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e. Drain/base KCL gives i_b2=−i_D/(1+Z_b/R_d); output KCL gives (v_o−v_s)/R₂+β₂i_b2=0; source KCL gives v_s/R₁+(v_s−v_o)/R₂=i_D. Combining these with i_D=g_m1(v_i−v_s) gives the finite-parameter gain.

D=β21+Zb/Rd;m=gm1R1;r=R2R1;G=m[1+D+Dr]1+m(1+D)

用跨级环路增益核对“深度”条件Check depth using the interstage loop gain

把源极局部退化吸收到前向通道，令a=m/(1+m)、T_global=aD。一般式可严格重写为下式。T_global≫1时趋于考试答案1+r；而T_global≤D，所以跨级环路足够深本身要求D很大，源极电流的加载修正随之变小。不是只检查g_m1R₁(1+D)≫1就足够。Absorb local source degeneration into the forward path and set a=m/(1+m), T_global=aD. The general gain rewrites exactly as below. For T_global≫1 it approaches the exam result 1+r. Since T_global≤D, deep interstage feedback itself requires large D, making the source-current loading correction small. Merely checking g_m1R₁(1+D)≫1 is insufficient.

a=m1+m;Tglobal=aD;G=a+Tglobal(1+r)1+Tglobal;(1+r)−G=1+r−a1+Tglobal

拓展检查：仅增大MOS互导的极限Further check: increasing MOS transconductance alone

若只令g_m1→∞而D保持有限，会得到1+rD/(1+D)，其中保留了源极电流加载。这个结果描述v_gs1很小的局部极限，不能当成“跨级全局深反馈”的替代答案。若需评估实际器件误差，使用一般有限参数式；题目没有给数值参数，不据此虚构数值增益。If only g_m1→∞ while D stays finite, gain becomes 1+rD/(1+D), retaining source-current loading. This is a local small-v_gs1 limit, not a replacement for the deep global-feedback answer. Use the general finite-parameter expression to assess a real device’s error. No numerical gain is invented because the problem supplies no device values.

limgm1→∞G=1+R2R1β2β2+1+[rbe2+(β2+1)Re]/Rd

按本题跨级深度负反馈近似，A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁，为同相增益。条件为跨级环路T_global=[g_m1R₁/(1+g_m1R₁)]·β₂/[1+(r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e)/R_d]≫1；仅g_m1很大不等于满足此条件。有限参数加载修正见推导。Under the requested deep interstage negative-feedback approximation, A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁, a noninverting gain. The condition is T_global=[g_m1R₁/(1+g_m1R₁)]·β₂/[1+(r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e)/R_d]≫1; large g_m1 alone does not establish it. See the derivation for finite-parameter loading corrections.

易错点Common errors

  • 考试主线用题设跨级深反馈条件，不要用仅g_m1→∞的有限D极限替代它。Use the stated deep interstage-feedback condition for the exam answer; do not substitute the finite-D limit obtained by g_m1→∞ alone.
  • MOS栅极电流为零，不代表源极电流恒为零；加载能否忽略要由环路与电流比验证。Zero gate current does not imply zero source current. Check loop gain and current ratios before neglecting loading.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号，两管具有正确偏置并处于放大区；忽略Early效应与沟道长度调制，取r_o/r_ds→∞。考试近似另要求跨级T_global≫1；一般式保留有限g_m1、β₂、r_be2与电阻加载。Midband small signal with both devices correctly biased in active operation; r_o/r_ds→∞, neglecting Early effect and channel-length modulation. The exam approximation additionally requires interstage T_global≫1. The general expression retains finite g_m1, β₂, r_be2 and resistor loading.

依据课件第8章第47、70、80页关于1+AF≫1的深反馈定义；独立按原图源极、漏极/基极、T₂发射极及输出节点列MNA，与一般有限参数式交叉核验。再把局部源极退化并入前向，代数上严格重写为[a+T_global(1+r)]/(1+T_global)，证明真正跨级T_global≫1时趋向1+R₂/R₁。有限D、g_m1→∞的加载式仅标为另一极限，不用于替代题设答案。合成参数检查不冒充教材数据；未使用外部标准答案。Used the course slides, chapter 8 slides 47, 70 and 80, defining deep feedback by 1+AF≫1. Independent original-node MNA at source, drain/base, T₂ emitter and output agrees with the general finite-parameter expression. Absorbing local source degeneration into the forward path rewrites it exactly as [a+T_global(1+r)]/(1+T_global), proving convergence to 1+R₂/R₁ for deep interstage T_global≫1. The finite-D, g_m1→∞ loading expression is identified only as a different limit, not substituted for the requested answer. Synthetic checks are not presented as textbook values; no external answer key was used.

参考模型依据Model references

  • COCOA · Introduction to Feedback (loading and return-ratio analysis)

10.2.3指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第434页／PDF第467页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 434 / PDF p. 467. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.2.3Assigned requirement: 10.2.3

先高通分压，再乘同相增益High-pass division followed by noninverting gain

题目原文Transcribed question

图题10.2.3所示为一阶高通滤波器电路，设A为理想运放，试推导电路的传递函数，并画出其幅频响应波特图，求−3 dB截止角频率ω_L。Figure 10.2.3 is a first-order high-pass filter. With ideal op amp A, derive its transfer function, draw its magnitude Bode plot and find the −3 dB cutoff angular frequency ω_L.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

输入v_i经串联电容C接运放同相端，同相端经R接地；反相端经R₁接地、经R_f接输出v_o。Input v_i reaches the noninverting input through series C, with R from that input to ground. The inverting input connects through R₁ to ground and R_f to output v_o.

本题图在书第434页／PDF第467页。The source figure is on printed p. 434 / PDF p. 467.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

复阻抗分压；理想运放虚短/虚断；同相放大；−3 dB定义。Complex-impedance division; ideal op-amp input conditions; noninverting gain; the −3 dB definition.
电容在输入串联支路，低频时隔断信号。先求同相端v_p，再求运放比例，不能把R误当作R₁。Series input C blocks low-frequency signals. Find v_p first, then the amplifier gain; R and R₁ are different components.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

输入RC高通分压Input RC high-pass division

运放输入电流为零，同相端只由串联C、对地R分压决定。Zero op-amp input current leaves a series C and shunt R divider.

Vp(s)Vi(s)=RR+1/(sC)=sRC1+sRC

同相放大与总传递函数Noninverting amplification and total transfer

反相节点电压等于同相节点，R₁与R_f的电流相等。定义高频通带增益A₀=1+R_f/R₁。The inverting and noninverting voltages are equal; R₁ and R_f carry equal currents. Define high-frequency passband gain A₀=1+R_f/R₁.

Av(s)=Vo(s)Vi(s)=(1+RfR1)sRC1+sRC;Av(jω)=A0jω/ωL1+jω/ωL

幅频、截止频率和波特图Magnitude, cutoff and Bode plot

幅值从直流0趋向高频A₀。截止处幅值为通带的1/√2，约低3.0103 dB。低频渐近线斜率+20 dB/十倍频，高频水平于20log₁₀A₀。附图纵轴减去了通带分贝值。Magnitude rises from zero at DC to A₀ at high frequency. At cutoff it is A₀/√2, about 3.0103 dB below passband. The low-frequency asymptote rises at +20 dB/decade; the high-frequency level is 20log₁₀A₀. The plot subtracts the passband dB level.

|Av(jω)|=A0ωRC1+(ωRC)2;ωL=1RC;fL=12πRC

一阶高通归一化幅频波特图；纵轴相对通带增益，横轴ω/ω_L。Normalized high-pass Bode magnitude relative to passband gain, versus ω/ω_L.

A_v(s)=(1+R_f/R₁)sRC/(1+sRC)，ω_L=1/(RC) rad/s。低频+20 dB/十倍频，高频增益1+R_f/R₁，截止点相对通带−3.0103 dB。A_v(s)=(1+R_f/R₁)sRC/(1+sRC), ω_L=1/(RC) rad/s. The low-frequency slope is +20 dB/decade; high-frequency gain is 1+R_f/R₁, with cutoff 3.0103 dB below passband.

易错点Common errors

  • ω_L是角频率；若求Hz需再除2π。ω_L is angular frequency; divide by 2π for Hz.
  • −3 dB相对通带增益，而非固定输出增益−3 dB。The −3 dB level is relative to passband, not an absolute gain of −3 dB.

核验依据Verification

理想运放线性负反馈、零输入电流、无限开环增益；R、R₁、R_f、C均为正，忽略真实运放带宽限制。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, zero input current and infinite open-loop gain; positive R, R₁, R_f and C. Real op-amp bandwidth limits are excluded.

从原图分别列同相端jωC(v_p−v_i)+v_p/R=0、反相端v_n/R₁+(v_n−v_o)/R_f=0及v_n=v_p，直接数值解节点，在归一化频率0.01、0.1、1、10、100处与传递函数一致；截止处归一化模平方恰为1/2；直流和高频极限相符。Independently solved the original noninverting-node equation jωC(v_p−v_i)+v_p/R=0, inverting-node equation v_n/R₁+(v_n−v_o)/R_f=0 and v_n=v_p. Direct node solutions at normalized frequencies 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 and 100 agree with the transfer function; normalized magnitude squared is exactly 1/2 at cutoff, and both endpoint limits agree.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第435页／PDF第468页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 435 / PDF p. 468. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.3.4Assigned requirement: 10.3.4

按储能元件和连接判断阶数Determine order from storage elements and connections

题目原文Transcribed question

设A为理想运放，试写出图题10.3.4所示电路的传递函数，指出这是一个什么类型的滤波电路。With ideal op amp A, write the transfer function of Fig. 10.3.4 and identify the filter type.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

v_i经R₁、电容C串联接运放反相端；反相端经R_f接输出，同相端接地。Input v_i passes through series R₁ and C to the inverting input. R_f connects that input to the output; the noninverting input is grounded.

本题图在书第435页／PDF第468页。The source figure is on printed p. 435 / PDF p. 468.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相运放；输入复阻抗；低频和高频极限。Inverting op amp; complex input impedance; low/high-frequency limits.
输入阻抗是R₁+1/(sC)，不是并联。题目位于高阶滤波章节，但本图只有一个独立储能电容，传递函数是一阶。Input impedance is R₁+1/(sC), not a parallel combination. Although placed in the higher-order-filter section, this figure has one independent capacitor and a first-order transfer function.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写反相端KCLWrite inverting-node KCL

虚地v_n=0，运放输入电流为零；输入串联支路电流全部流过R_f。The inverting node is at virtual ground, v_n=0, with zero op-amp input current. All input-branch current flows through R_f.

Vi(s)R1+1/(sC)=−Vo(s)Rf

化为标准高通形式Put into standard high-pass form

分子在s=0有零点，分母为一次式。直流被隔断，高频时电容短路而恢复普通反相比例放大。There is a zero at s=0 and a first-order denominator. DC is blocked; at high frequency C becomes a short, recovering an ordinary inverting amplifier.

Av(s)=−sCRf1+sCR1=−RfR1s/ωL1+s/ωL;ωL=1R1C

由端点核对滤波类型Check filter type using endpoint limits

直流增益0，高频增益−R_f/R₁，故为反相一阶高通，R_f决定通带增益，R₁C决定截止频率。DC gain is zero and high-frequency gain is −R_f/R₁. It is therefore an inverting first-order high-pass filter. R_f sets passband gain while R₁C sets cutoff.

Av(0)=0;Av(∞)=−RfR1

A_v(s)=−sCR_f/(1+sCR₁)，是一阶反相高通滤波电路；ω_L=1/(R₁C)。A_v(s)=−sCR_f/(1+sCR₁), an inverting first-order high-pass filter, with ω_L=1/(R₁C).

易错点Common errors

  • 不能根据章节名称直接断言本题是二阶滤波。Do not infer second order from the chapter heading.
  • R₁与C串联，不能把输入阻抗写成R₁∥1/(sC)。R₁ and C are in series; input impedance is not R₁∥1/(sC).

核验依据Verification

理想运放线性负反馈、正电阻电容、零初始条件的拉普拉斯传递函数。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, positive resistors/capacitor and zero-initial-condition Laplace transfer function.

独立保留R₁/C之间节点v_x：列(v_x−v_i)/R₁+jωCv_x=0、−jωCv_x−v_o/R_f=0，并与传递函数做多频点复数对照；单极点−1/(R₁C)位于左半平面，直流0和高频−R_f/R₁均回代成立。Retained the original intermediate node v_x between R₁ and C and independently solved (v_x−v_i)/R₁+jωCv_x=0 and −jωCv_x−v_o/R_f=0. Complex solutions agree across multiple frequencies. The sole pole −1/(R₁C) is in the left half-plane; DC zero and high-frequency gain −R_f/R₁ both check.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第441页／PDF第474页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 441 / PDF p. 474. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.8.2Assigned requirement: 10.8.2

先比较v₂−v₁，再沿交点画输出Compare v₂−v₁ and switch at each intersection

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题10.8.2a所示，其输入电压的波形如图题10.8.2b所示，已知输出电压v_o的最大值为±10 V，运放是理想的，试画出输出电压v_o的波形。The circuit and its input waveforms are shown in Fig. 10.8.2(a) and (b). The output limits are ±10 V and the op amp is ideal. Draw output waveform v_o.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

v₁接反相端、v₂接同相端，各有5.1 kΩ对地电阻；输出负载5.1 kΩ。图b中v₁先于v₂，起点v₁=0且v₂<0，两条近似同幅正弦曲线依次相交，未给数值幅值、周期或相位差。v₁ drives the inverting input and v₂ the noninverting input, each with 5.1 kΩ to ground; load is 5.1 kΩ. In Fig. (b), v₁ leads v₂, initially v₁=0 and v₂<0. The roughly equal-amplitude sinusoidal sketches cross repeatedly; no numerical amplitudes, period or phase difference are specified.

本题图在书第441页／PDF第474页。The source figure is on printed p. 441 / PDF p. 474.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想比较器；同相/反相输入符号；两信号大小比较。Ideal comparators; input polarities; comparison of two signal levels.
这是开环比较器，不能套用虚短。输出符号由同相端减反相端决定，即v₂−v₁。This is an open-loop comparator, so virtual-short analysis does not apply. Output sign follows noninverting minus inverting input, v₂−v₁.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写比较规则Write the comparison rule

理想运放无输入电流，5.1 kΩ对地电阻不改变理想电压源给定的输入。输出在题给±10 V间切换。The ideal op amp draws no input current. The grounded 5.1 kΩ resistors do not change input voltages imposed by ideal sources. Output switches between the specified ±10 V limits.

v2>v1⇒vo=+10V;v2<v1⇒vo=−10V

在图b标出交点Mark the intersections in Fig. (b)

按时间从左向右把输入交点记为t₁、t₂、t₃。起始v₂<v₁，输出−10 V；第一交点后v₂>v₁，输出+10 V；第二交点后回−10 V；第三交点后再+10 V。附图是定性重绘，交点定义切换时刻，不添加原题没有给出的时间、相位数值。Label the successive input intersections t₁, t₂, t₃. Initially v₂<v₁, giving −10 V; after t₁, v₂>v₁ gives +10 V; after t₂ output returns to −10 V; after t₃ it returns to +10 V. The attached reconstruction is qualitative: intersections define switching times, without adding numerical time or phase data absent from the problem.

交点及理想模型的边界Intersection values and ideal-model boundary

恰好v₁=v₂时，理想无偏置比较器不唯一规定输出电平；画竖直跳变即可，不应硬指定为0 V。真实器件会受输入失调、延迟等影响，题目不要求这些参数。At exactly v₁=v₂, the ideal zero-offset comparator does not uniquely determine an output level. Draw a vertical transition rather than assigning 0 V. Real offsets and delays lie outside the stated problem.

定性重绘输入与输出：t₁、t₂、t₃为输入交点，输出依次−10、+10、−10、+10 V；未假设原题未给的数值相位。Qualitative reconstruction: t₁,t₂,t₃ are input intersections; output levels are −10,+10,−10,+10 V. No numerical source phase is assumed.

v₂>v₁时v_o=+10 V，v₂<v₁时v_o=−10 V；图示初始为−10 V，之后在相邻输入交点依次切换为+10、−10、+10 V。v_o=+10 V for v₂>v₁ and −10 V for v₂<v₁. The shown waveform starts at −10 V, then switches to +10, −10 and +10 V at successive input intersections.

易错点Common errors

  • 反相端接v₁，不能按v₁−v₂决定输出正负。v₁ is the inverting input; do not determine output sign from v₁−v₂.
  • 未给数值相位或周期，只能依据交点给出定性波形。Numerical phase and period are unspecified; the waveform is defined qualitatively by intersections.

核验依据Verification

理想开环比较器，输入为题给理想电压波形，输出限幅±10 V；忽略传播延时与失调，输入相等时不唯一。Ideal open-loop comparator driven by the given ideal voltage waveforms, output limited to ±10 V. Delay and offset are neglected; equal inputs do not determine a unique level.

逐段对照原图两条输入曲线的上下关系，并在每个交点左右检查v₂−v₁的符号。输出电平严格采用题给±10 V，不误用电源±12 V；原图起点及交点顺序与定性输出一致。Checked which original input curve is higher in each interval and the sign of v₂−v₁ on both sides of every intersection. Output levels use the specified ±10 V rather than ±12 V supply rails; initial sign and switching order match the original sketch.

10.8.4指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第441页／PDF第474页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 441 / PDF p. 474. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.8.4Assigned requirement: 10.8.4

正反馈产生两个门限：随输出状态分别求Positive feedback gives two state-dependent thresholds

题目原文Transcribed question

设运放为理想器件，试求图题10.8.4所示电压比较器的门限电压，并画出它的传输特性（图中V_Z=9 V）。With an ideal op amp, find the comparator thresholds and draw the transfer characteristic for Fig. 10.8.4, where V_Z=9 V.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

反相端接地；v_i经R₁=5 kΩ到同相节点v_p；输出v_o经R₂=15 kΩ反馈到v_p。运放输出经R₃=5 kΩ到限幅后的v_o，双向稳压管将v_o限制在±V_Z=±9 V。Inverting input is grounded. Input v_i reaches noninverting node v_p through R₁=5 kΩ; v_o returns through R₂=15 kΩ. The op-amp output reaches the clamped output v_o through R₃=5 kΩ; the bidirectional limiter holds v_o at ±V_Z=±9 V.

本题图在书第441页／PDF第474页。The source figure is on printed p. 441 / PDF p. 474.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

正反馈比较器；节点KCL；稳态一致性；滞回方向。Positive-feedback comparators; nodal KCL; state consistency; hysteresis direction.
输出返回同相端，所以有记忆、两个门限。先固定输出为+9 V或−9 V，再令v_p=v_n=0求翻转边界；不要先套线性运放虚短。Output returns to the noninverting input, producing memory and two thresholds. Fix output at +9 or −9 V, then set v_p=v_n=0 only at the switching boundary. Do not apply a linear virtual short throughout.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

同相端KCLNoninverting-node KCL

输入电流为零，v_p由v_i与限幅后v_o加权决定。反馈取样点在R₃之后，因此门限用±9 V。Zero input current makes v_p the weighted average of v_i and the clamped v_o. Feedback samples after R₃, so thresholds use ±9 V.

vp−vi5kΩ+vp−vo15kΩ=0⇒vp=3vi+vo4

上升输入的上门限Upper threshold for increasing input

此前输出为低电平−9 V。输入上升至v_p=0时满足3v_i−9=0，于+3 V跳到+9 V。Starting from low output −9 V, increasing input reaches v_p=0 when 3v_i−9=0. At +3 V output switches upward to +9 V.

VT+=−R1R2(−9)=+3V

下降输入的下门限Lower threshold for decreasing input

此前输出为高电平+9 V。输入下降至3v_i+9=0，于−3 V跳到−9 V。两个门限之间两种状态都可自洽，取决于历史。Starting from high output +9 V, decreasing input reaches 3v_i+9=0 and switches down at −3 V. Both output states are consistent between thresholds, so history determines the state.

VT−=−R1R2(+9)=−3V;ΔVT=VT+−VT−=6V

画同相滞回传输特性Draw the noninverting hysteresis characteristic

上升扫描：保持−9 V到+3 V后跳到+9 V。下降扫描：保持+9 V到−3 V后跳到−9 V。v_i>3 V唯一高电平，v_i<−3 V唯一低电平；中间保持先前状态。Increasing sweep: stay at −9 V until +3 V, then jump to +9 V. Decreasing sweep: stay at +9 V until −3 V, then jump to −9 V. Above +3 V only high output is consistent; below −3 V only low output is consistent; between thresholds retain the previous state.

同相滞回特性：上升输入在+3 V由−9跳到+9 V，下降输入在−3 V由+9跳到−9 V。Noninverting hysteresis: rising input switches −9 to +9 V at +3 V; falling input switches +9 to −9 V at −3 V.

同相滞回比较器；上门限V_T+=+3 V，下门限V_T−=−3 V，滞回宽度6 V。输出±9 V；上升输入在+3 V由低跳高，下降输入在−3 V由高跳低。Noninverting Schmitt comparator: upper threshold +3 V, lower threshold −3 V, hysteresis width 6 V and output ±9 V. Rising input switches low-to-high at +3 V; falling input switches high-to-low at −3 V.

易错点Common errors

  • 门限来自±9 V限幅输出，而非未给出的运放饱和电压。Use the ±9 V clamped output, not an unspecified op-amp saturation voltage.
  • −3<V_i<3 V时输出与先前状态有关，不是一个单值线性函数。For −3<V_i<3 V, output depends on history; it is not a single-valued linear function.

核验依据Verification

按图中双向限幅±V_Z=±9 V建模，不另外加未给出的正向压降；理想比较器零输入电流，忽略延时，门限等值时为切换边界。Use the drawn bidirectional clamp ±V_Z=±9 V without adding an unspecified forward drop. Ideal comparator has zero input current and no delay; exact threshold equality is the switching boundary.

独立逐状态检查比较器一致性：v_o=+9时v_p>0要求v_i>−3；v_o=−9时v_p<0要求v_i<+3。边界分别−3和+3 V；以离散上升/下降输入扫描，检查每个稳态同时满足节点KCL、限幅及比较器符号，得到图示滞回方向。Independently checked state consistency: v_o=+9 requires v_p>0, hence v_i>−3; v_o=−9 requires v_p<0, hence v_i<+3. Boundaries are −3 and +3 V. Discrete rising/falling input sweeps satisfy node KCL, clamping and comparator sign in every stable state, reproducing the plotted hysteresis direction.
